derived_eng_desc1: Covers construction cost estimation, feasibility studies, bidding strategies, and budget control for construction projects.

eng_name: Social Responsibility and Sponsorship Management in Sport
eng_desc: The sponsorship concept history. Sports sponsorship theory and sponsorship types and characteristics. Selling sponsorship and sponsorship evaluation. Sport sponsorship as a strategic corporate social responsibility. Social responsibility in sports business and sports volunteering.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on sports sponsorship, corporate social responsibility, and business management in sport, aligning with business administration.

eng_name: Professionals in the Translation and Interpretation Industry
eng_desc: Theoretical knowledge and practical skills essential for professionals in the translation and interpretation (T&I) industry; techniques in user experience (UX) design and search engine optimization (SEO); introduction to translation and localization project management; issues of ethics and sustainability in the T&l industry.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on professional skills for the translation and interpretation industry, including project management, UX design, and SEO.

eng_name: Facility and Event Management in Sports
eng_desc: Theory and concept in managing sports venue and facilities.Criteria in selecting tools and facilities for sports management Format of sports organizing committee Strategy of sports management Analyzing and planning in sports management .Organizing sports event in actual location
derived_eng_desc1: Covers theory and concepts in managing sports venues, facilities, and organizing sports events.

eng_desc: This course aims to examine the evolution of legal philosophical thinking from the ancient time to the present time. Problems in relation to foundations of law will also be dealt with.
derived_eng_desc1: Examines the evolution of legal philosophical thinking and the foundations of law.

eng_desc: This course emphasizes models for sequencing and scheduling activities including: static and dynamic problems, deterministic and stochastic models, single machine processing, parallel machine processing, flow-shop and job-shop scheduling, project scheduling, workforce scheduling, exact and heuristic solution methods, and applications in manufacturing environments.
derived_eng_desc1: Emphasizes operations scheduling models, sequencing activities, and applications in manufacturing.

eng_desc: This course examines problems of important in labour law with a view to a greater insight and greater ability in analysing those problems thoroughly and properly on the basis of academic footing, which will in turn lead to further viewpoints and approaches to appropriate revision of law and enforcement of law in the interest of greater justice and benefits to employers, employees and society. Examples of problems to be examined include problems with regard to the protection of female labour and child labour, problems with regard to labour relations in State enterprise, problems with regard to roles and co-ordination of State agencies in respect of the mediation and settlement of labour disputes, or other problems as the instructor deems appropriate for discussion.
derived_eng_desc1: Examines labour law problems, focusing on legal frameworks for employers, employees, and society.

eng_desc: This course examines the challenge of technology and its influence on the development of law in relation to the regulation and technological consequences on practice and legal application. Some important topics include ethics, regulation of technology and contractual and tortious liability.
derived_eng_desc1: Explores the intersection of law and technology, focusing on regulation, ethics, and liability.

eng_desc: This course examines the law relating to online contracting, e-signature, and digital ID. It further explores selected topics of consumer protection in electronic commerce, including online dispute resolution, as well as relevant e-commerce regulations.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers law on electronic transactions, e-commerce, digital ID, and consumer protection.

eng_desc: This course explores international cooperation and principles of international environmental law concerning transborder water and air pollution, sea pollution, transborder waste and hazardous substance transportation, change of global atmosphere caused by the greenhouse effects and diminution of Ozone. The protection of biological diversity, nearly extinct plant divisions and animal species, and relevant international organizations' roles are also discussed.
derived_eng_desc1: Explores international environmental law, focusing on pollution, biodiversity, and international cooperation.

eng_name: Law and the Greater Mekong Sub-region (GMS) Economic Development
eng_desc: This course explores laws, regulations and related policies in both sub-regional and domestic aspects of the six countries of the Greater Mekong Sub-region namely Thailand, Laos, Myanmar, Cambodia, Vietnam and South China in order to provides student a well-rounded understanding of the economic development in the sub-region. For this purpose, historical backgrounds, social and cultural factors of the sub-region such as the Greater Mekong Sub-region project supported by the Asian Development Bank (ADB) are to be studied.
derived_eng_desc1: Examines laws, regulations, and policies related to economic development in the Greater Mekong Sub-region.

eng_desc: This course explores legal principles regulating the standard of food and medical products, process of licensing, controlling and regulating and problems arisen from law enforcement, especially in the case of entrepreneur's liability on damage suffered by consumers, mediation, compensation and liability insurance.
derived_eng_desc1: Examines legal principles regulating food and drug standards, licensing, and consumer liability.

eng_name: Laws on Mass Communication and Telecommunication Business
eng_desc: This course explores principles of right and freedom of expression, structure and environment of mass communication and telecommunication business, fundamental legal principles prescribed to control telecommunication business such as newspaper, radio broadcasting, television broadcasting, internet or other forms of mass communication as appeared in the constitution. Furthermore, legal liability of telecommunication companies including liability on defamation and other related laws such as consumer protection law, law concerning frequency channel management, laws concerning telecommunication business and morals of these business players is also described.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers laws on mass communication, telecommunication business, freedom of expression, and liability.

eng_desc: This course explores the actuality and scopes of legislation applicable as a means to control the operation of industries and pollution generated by the operation of industries.
derived_eng_desc1: Examines industrial law, legislation controlling industries, and pollution regulation.

eng_desc: This course explores the relationship between law and economics and discusses the employment of economic methods in tacking and analyzing legal issues. The focus will be on the economic function of contracts and, when contracts fail or are not feasible, the role of legal remedies to resolve disputes. This course encourages students to discuss at some length the choice between encouraging private parties to initiate legal actions to correct externalities and governmental actors, such as regulatory authorities. Attention will be given to the economics of litigation, and to how private incentives to bring lawsuits differ from the social value of litigation.
derived_eng_desc1: Explores the relationship between law and economics, applying economic methods to analyze legal issues, contracts, and litigation.

eng_desc: This course focuses on basic concepts of health law, the structure of public and private organizations relating to the health systems, national health policy, an overview of health insurance systems, and national health insurance systems. The course also includes issues of health ethics, legal liabilities arising from provisions of health care, compensational procedure for damage suffered as a result of the violation provisions of health services, and legal problems arising from the health systems.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on health law concepts, health systems, national policy, insurance, ethics, and legal liabilities in healthcare.

eng_desc: This course provides an account of medical science that relates to the application of law, in particular, evidential proof for criminal and civil proceedings.
derived_eng_desc1: Explores medical science in relation to legal application, focusing on evidential proof for criminal and civil proceedings.

eng_name: Seminar on Law and State Policy on Children and Youth
eng_desc: This course provides an analytical study of the legal evolution, State's policies and measures in connection with the protection, support and development of children and the youth, powers and duties of the National Commission on the Promotion and Co-ordination of the Youth Affairs as well as other State agencies concerned, legal problems and obstacles encountered in the administration of State affairs, functions and roles of families towards physical, mental, emotional and social development of children and the youth. Attempts will be made for comparing legal development in other jurisdictions as guidance for revision of law, with a view to achieving the protection of children and the youth along the lines of such principles internationally recognised as, in particular, established in the United Nations Convention on the Rights of the Child.
derived_eng_desc1: Analyzes legal evolution and state policies for the protection and development of children and youth.

eng_desc: This course provides an introductory account of information technology, development of information technology and computer, electronic information, and fundamental principles of laws on information technology, such as electronic transaction law and computer crime law. It covers impacts of information technology on intellectual property, protection of privacy information, and freedom of expressions. Contemporary legal issues relating to the enforcement of information technology law is also a subject of this course.
derived_eng_desc1: Introduces laws on information technology, covering electronic transactions, computer crime, intellectual property, and privacy.

eng_desc: This course provides an overview of children’s rights using a human rightsapproach in the context of globalisation and the child, family, community and societal context inAsia. Starting with an understanding of current knowledge and research in childhood and childdevelopment, the course seeks to provide a comprehensive understanding of the historicalevolution of the rights of children, discuss the main principles and provisions of the UnitedNations Convention on the Rights of the Children (UN-CRC) – including monitoring and reporting;current issues and challenges faced in countries in Asia in relation to child rights (social policy,social protection, education, urban-rural child labour and child protection) and the key childrights institutions and movements that have developed in the region over the past years.
derived_eng_desc1: Overview of children's rights, human rights approach, UN Convention, and related social policies in Asia.

eng_desc: This course provides students with fundamental principles of economics and an understanding of functions of laws upon an economic system as well as the interaction between law and economics. Accordingly, this course offers general concepts of micro-economic and macro-economic, such as economic basic problems, elements used to prescribe supply and demand of goods, consumer's behavior, qualifications of perfect and defect competitive market, calculation of GDP, banking and finance, international trade and so forth. The connection between law and an economic system, especially the application of laws as a fundamental instrument for implementing economic policies or for intervening and controlling private economic activities is also at the core of this course. In addition, problems of law enforcement that significantly affect the fulfillment of economic policies will also be discussed.
derived_eng_desc1: Explores fundamental economic principles and the interaction between law and economic systems for lawyers.

eng_name: Seminar in Socio-Historical and Philosophical Studies of Law
eng_desc: This course requires a presentation of a report and stimulating discussions on issues related to sociology of law, history of law, comparative law or philosophy of law, as instructed by the instructor or as published in advance for the purpose of each semester.
derived_eng_desc1: Seminar on socio-historical and philosophical studies of law, including sociology, history, and comparative law.

eng_name: Seminar on Law and State Policy on the Disable
eng_desc: This course seeks to provide an account of the legal evolution and State's policies in regard to the provision of aids and the improvement the quality of life in the interest of the disable in comparison with positions in other jurisdictions, with particular emphasis on the United Nations' Charter in respect of the disable, legislation and directive principles of fundamental State policies as regards social welfare, rehabilitation of the capacity of the disable and the elevation of the quality of life of the disable.
derived_eng_desc1: Examines legal evolution and state policies concerning the disabled, social welfare, and rehabilitation.

eng_desc: This course studies law concerning mega industrial project development, utility, and basic infrastructure in Thailand. It explores how to finance these projects and agreements relating to major project development. Several acts covered in this course includes Public-Private Partnership Act B.E. 2562 (2019) and Eastern Economic Corridor Act B.E. 2561 (2018). Relevant agreements such as land acquisition agreement, engineering, procurement and construction contract (EPC), operation and management agreement (O&M), and financing agreement and security documents will also be discussed.
derived_eng_desc1: Studies law concerning project development, infrastructure, financing, and related agreements and acts.

eng_desc: This course will develop a framework on which management and ethical issues can be developed. Topics covered will include management issues such as: management of innovation engineering project planning and control human factors patents technical strategy In addition, the following ethics topics will be covered: introduction to ethics workable ethical theories morality of breaking the law privacy public information and records and related topics
derived_eng_desc1: Develops management and ethical frameworks, covering innovation, project planning, and ethical theories.

eng_desc: Time value of money. Engineering project analysis using economic approach. Replacement analysis. Depreciation. Tax. Analysis and decision making under tax consequences. Analysis and decision making when considering risk and uncertainty.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on economic analysis for engineering projects, time value of money, and financial decision-making, aligning with business.

eng_desc: Privacy law and policy is one of the most important and rapidly expanding (and changing) fields in the world today. derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on social enterprise development, business models, financial management, and marketing, aligning with business and administration.

eng_name: Administrative Law, State, and Public Services
eng_desc: Summary of concepts and principles of administrative law; administrative and public authority; state property; administrative act; the relation between public services and administrative law; and the role of administrative court in Thailand.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on administrative law, public authority, state property, and public services, aligning with business, administration, and law.

eng_desc: Supply chain fundamentals An introduction to supply chain planning processes and the need for them Planning processes and methods including: forecasting, aggregate planning, MRP, Capacity Management, Theory of constraints (TOC), JIT (kanban), inventory management, IS/IT support for planning, ERP systems Planning through the supply chain - examining the challenges in different contexts.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on supply chain and operations planning, including forecasting, inventory, and ERP systems, aligning with business and administration.

eng_name: Accounting for Environmental and Social Responsibility
eng_desc: Sustainable development concepts, corporate environmental and social responsibility; negative impacts of business activities on the environment and natural resources; environmental management process; identification, collection, and analysis of environment-related costs and earnings information; environmental reporting, and sustainability reporting.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on accounting, corporate responsibility, environmental costs, and sustainability reporting in business.

eng_desc: Technology viability assessment. Legal issues associated with forming a new company. Competitive positioning. Market analysis and market opportunity assessment. Product life-cycle planning. Marketing strategy. Organization management. Intellectual property management. Patenting. Technopreneurship. Business plan. Venture capital. Entrepreneurial ethics.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers entrepreneurship, business development, market analysis, and management, fitting business administration.

eng_desc: Thai constitution and local government; relations between central, regional, and local governments; decentralization to local government organizations in Thailand, in comparison with foreign countries, e.g. France, Britain.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on law, local government, constitutional aspects, and decentralization, fitting administration and legal studies.

eng_desc: Thai society and world society at present Current trends and issues in Thai and global society Consistency of the law with Thai social trends and world social trends Concept of law and society, rights, liberties and equality of persons under international law and Thai law. Fundamentals of Civil and Criminal Liability of Persons in Thai Law . Thai justice process related to livelihood and society Laws relating to vulnerable people and social welfare Copyright and Intellectual Property Laws environmental law Laws on personal data protection and other laws that are consistent with the current global context and Thai society.
derived_eng_desc1: Explores the relationship between law and society, covering civil, criminal, intellectual property, and environmental law.

eng_desc: Thailand's Legal System. The relationship between law, economy, and politics. Applying economic theory to analyze reasons for the existence of property rights, civil, and commercial law. The effects of law on economic behavior and on economic outcomes.
derived_eng_desc1: Analyzes the relationship between law, economy, and politics, applying economic theory to legal concepts.

eng_desc: The aim of this course is to equip the students with the basic building blocks of financial management that together can help them making a proper decision in terms of investment and value creation. These include 1] Financial statements analysis, 2] Cashflow Projection & Discounted Cashflow, 3] Investment Project Appraisal and Risk 4] Financing Strategies. Indeed, these four modules in tandem with the selected case studies that they will work on throughout a semester, are expected to assist them develop a financial acumen and become more confident with a language of finance.
derived_eng_desc1: Teaches financial management, investment, cashflow, risk appraisal, and financing strategies for social entrepreneurs.

eng_desc: The analysis of business data and problems from selected business organizations and design of business strategies and solutions for such organizations. The analysis may cover an identification and verification of data source and type, an integration of different analytic tools, a visualization of analysis, a determination of business implications and a design of business strategies and solutions for businesses.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on analyzing business data to design strategies and solutions for business organizations.

eng_desc: The application of econometrics method to finance and macroeconomics data. Applications of regression models. Applications of Probit-Logit model to financial risk assessments. Characteristics and properties of time-series based financial data. Univariate Time-Series Model. Regression with the long-run relationship and short-run dynamics. Volatility Model. Training in statistical software, emphasizing the application of tools suitable for research and study in finance-related issues
derived_eng_desc1: Applies econometric methods and statistical software to analyze financial and macroeconomic data for risk assessment.

eng_name: Future of Real Estate Development Design
eng_desc: The architectural design course method integrates with the real estate development process. Starting with the conceptual idea, customer demands to macroeconomic analysis will allow students to see the whole system of real state investment. The objective is to respond to the fast-growing development and limitation of resources then answer with a suitable investment design for the future.
derived_eng_desc1: Integrates architectural design with real estate development, investment, and macroeconomic analysis for future design.

eng_desc: The basic laws related to the production and dissemination of art, copyright and intellectual property laws, methods of contract documentation, and tax management, analyzing the role of the state in legislating to promote and sponsor art, considering examples from case studies both domestically and internationally.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers legal issues, copyright, intellectual property, contracts, and tax management in arts administration.

eng_desc: The basic principles of financial management for business, the responsibilities of financial managers, maximization of enterprise value, axioms of finance, analysis of financial reports, cash flows, fundamental analysis on risk and rates of returns, the time value of money, working capital policies, capital budgeting techniques, financing mix, short-term and long-term sources of funds, distributions to shareholders, the costs of capital, and an introduction to developments in the financial industry, such as sustainable finance, digital assets.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on financial management principles, financial reports, capital budgeting, and financing in business.

eng_desc: The central theme of this course is a study of concepts and theories of behavioral analysis to understand consumers and their behaviors. The content includes traditional thinking, which emphasizes psychological and behavioral theory for the purchasing decision-making process, and contemporary alternative theories from sociology and anthropology, which emphasizes understanding consumers from social and cultural dimensions. The course also covers different perspectives on ethical issues, including unethical business conduct and the dark side of consumer behavior. The content also focuses on the practical applications of consumer behavior analysis in marketing.
derived_eng_desc1: Studies consumer behavior, psychological and sociological theories, and their application in marketing.

eng_desc: The central theme of this course is a study of concepts and ways of doing international marketing, including importing and exporting, foreign direct investment, marketing strategy in globalization, and factors affecting international marketing through in-class assignments, case studies, and group projects. The content includes gaining consumer insights across international markets and translating them into appropriate marketing programs, linkages of the dynamic international environments, international opportunities, and international marketing strategies through an international marketing manager.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on international marketing strategies, importing, exporting, and foreign direct investment in global markets.

eng_desc: The central theme of this course is a study of creating marketing strategies in the business market. The content includes different and intertwined business marketing and consumer market, vision in the business market, analyzing market environments in business marketing, procurement and service design for the business market, business purchasing behavior, government purchasing behavior, marketing opportunities, marketing strategy, product development and management, business marketing channels, marketing communications, digital marketing for the business market, sales management, selling techniques, pricing and negotiation, marketing evaluation, and customer satisfaction.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers business-to-business marketing strategies, procurement, product development, digital marketing, and sales management.

eng_desc: The central theme of this course is a study of retail business management, based on shopper behavior understanding in order to determine effective retailing strategy and retail marketing mix so that the store can compete in the retail business, covering on-site, online, and Omni retail. The content includes retail concept development, location selection, store design and decoration, and category management, including determining the breadth and depth of product categories, purchasing, store layout, product display, retail pricing, promotion, and retail human resources.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on retail business management, strategies, marketing mix, store design, and category management.

eng_desc: The central theme of this course is an individual project basis. During the course, the student conducts research on a particular problem or topic in marketing under the supervision of an advisor in accordance with the ethical and professional norms in marketing.
derived_eng_desc1: Individual research project on a specific marketing problem or topic under supervision.

eng_desc: The central theme of this course is concepts, principles, and approaches to integrated marketing communications in response to the marketing challenge. The content includes an integrated marketing communications plan in terms of message and seamless contact point (digital and physical) integration and evaluation, based on the understanding of consumer and brand, especially brand positioning.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers integrated marketing communications, planning, digital integration, and brand positioning.

eng_desc: The central theme of this course is customer-centricity and customer relationships enabled by a customer data platform (CDP), which collects and unifies customers' data from various sources and touchpoints. The content includes different data collection and analytics of such customer data to inform marketing and business decisions, gain customer insight and behavioral patterns, which use to map the customer journey, predict customers' behaviors and design customer experience. The course also covers the customer lifetime value concept in customer relationship management programs. Students will learn how to develop customer acquisition, expansion, and retention strategies, which will enable them to achieve optimized customer lifetime value and delightful customer relationships.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on customer analytics, data platforms, customer relationship management, and marketing decisions.

eng_desc: The central theme of this course is food product marketing and food innovation. The content includes challenging environmental factors affecting the food industry, such as trends and consumers' social and behavioral characteristics, which drive food consumption decisions and behavior. The course also covers searching and understanding the food technologies enablers in developing a competitive value proposition for food products and practicing creating food marketing strategies.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers food product marketing, food innovation, and strategies for the food industry.

eng_desc: The central theme of this course is how responsible marketing management can contribute to sustainability and discussing the adverse impact of conventional business and marketing mindsets and practices. The content includes changes from the organizational level by employing sustainability-related concepts and conducts, strategic management tools, and technology to create competitive business advantage with the responsibility to stakeholders and commitment to overall sustainability, which later influences changes in marketing management from creating sustainable value, targeting, branding, to other key marketing strategies. The course also covers marketing applications for not-for-profit organizations and social enterprises.
derived_eng_desc1: Explores responsible marketing management, sustainability, strategic tools, and marketing for social enterprises.

eng_desc: The central theme of this course is the introduction of the marketing definition and its importance as a vital business function. The content includes modern marketing concepts, the shift in marketing in the digital era, its role, and the major influences of marketing on the economy, society, environment, and consumer behavior. The course also covers the traditional marketing mix and the digital one, introductory marketing management, preparation of a basic marketing plan, and ethics of marketers.
derived_eng_desc1: Introduces marketing principles, concepts, digital marketing, marketing mix, and ethical considerations.

eng_desc: The central theme of this course is the marketing research process from a marketer's perspective. The content includes the importance of marketing research, research skill development in seeking, analyzing, and synthesizing information to formulate marketing problem statements from which research questions are derived, integrating marketing problems with the research question, marketing research designs including qualitative, quantitative research, and mixed methods. The course also covers the development of data collection tools, fieldwork, analyzing and reporting research results to answer the research question, and developing a marketing strategy to solve marketing problems.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers marketing research process, data collection, analysis, and strategy development for decision making.

eng_desc: The central theme of this course is to build decision-making-related skills emphasizing the use of data and marketing metrics to create impactful decisions in various landscapes and perspectives via a hands-on approach with assignments, projects, and case studies. The content includes data acquisition, analysis, visualization, obtaining various types of data used in marketing from multiple data sources, and cleaning and storing them for easy access and interchange. Students will learn how to conduct online data (web) scraping and import data from other primary and secondary data sources. The course also covers various approaches to marketing data analysis and their application across multiple marketing situations, equipping students with the art of visualizing data in a way that aids businesses in making effective decisions.
derived_eng_desc1: Develops decision-making skills using data, marketing metrics, data analysis, and visualization for business.

eng_desc: The central theme of this course is to educate students to understand how to apply digital technologies to craft marketing strategies in responding to consumer and business markets in a digital era. The content includes issues and challenges of digital technologies in the competitive marketing landscape, leveraging digital technologies to gain competitive advantage, formulating digital marketing strategy, and designing metrics to measure the success of digital marketing strategy.
derived_eng_desc1: Teaches applying digital technologies to craft and measure effective digital marketing strategies.

eng_desc: The central theme of this course is to educate students to understand the digital advertising planning process that aligns with the digital marketing plan via a hands-on approach with assignments and projects. The content includes digital advertising channel selection, communication strategy, execution in different digital advertising platforms, and performance measurement.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers digital advertising planning, channel selection, communication strategy, and performance measurement.

eng_desc: The central theme of this course is to integrate marketing theories, concepts, and knowledge to develop marketing strategies and plans via a learning-by-doing approach. The content includes developing a comprehensive marketing plan, using marketing simulation, or a consultative project for a real firm to develop skills in marketing decision-making and marketing performance analysis in a dynamic and competitive environment.
derived_eng_desc1: Integrates marketing theories to develop comprehensive marketing strategies, plans, and decision-making skills.

eng_desc: The central theme of this course is to study the modern concept of sales management that requires internal and external data usage. The content includes the use of internal and external information for situation analysis and qualitative and quantitative data to plan and determine sales strategies to satisfy target customers and purchase decisions. This course also studies how to build effective sales teams and ethical sales management under the proper use of technology.
derived_eng_desc1: Studies modern sales management concepts, strategies, team building, and ethical practices using data.

eng_name: Managing Growing Business and Family Business
eng_desc: The concept of managing businesses growing from small to large dimensions in Thailandinvolves catch-up industrialization, including rent seeking, conglomerate creation, innovativecombinations, tech savvy, and business transformation. Other factors are family business management,office succession and inheritance, family constitutions, holding company establishment, pyramidal andcross shareholding, interlocking directorates, and managerial enterprise development as well assurvival strategies during such challenges as the 1997 Asian financial crisis and Novel Coronavirus 2019(COVID-19) pandemic, while transcending the middle-income trap.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers managing growing businesses, family business management, succession, and survival strategies.

eng_desc: The concept of marketing strategy; Industry analysis and competitive advantage; Marketing mix strategies; Product life cycle strategies; Market segmentation and target market; Customer data base utilization; Marketing channel transformation strategy, Traditional marketing channel and digital marketing channel integration management; Marketing strategies and implementation; evaluation and control strategies.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on entrepreneurial marketing strategies, industry analysis, market segmentation, and digital channel integration.

eng_desc: The concept, scope, and process of facility management enhance the quality of life of building occupants and the quality of the environment and increase the organization's competitiveness by maximizing the utilization of resources through strategic planning under human relations, working environment, and processes. Also, analyze the organization's needs and occupants' behaviors, energy efficiency assessment, building environment, and safety. Including investigating the privatization process of property for maximum benefit, focusing on buildings that may need improvement, change in usage, or creating the value of existing assets to generate the most returns
derived_eng_desc1: Covers facility management concepts, strategic planning, energy efficiency, and property value maximization.

eng_desc: The course addresses the general principles of civil, criminal, and administrative procedural law. It also provides basic rules concerning the law of evidence.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers general principles of civil, criminal, and administrative procedural law, including basic rules of evidence.

eng_desc: The course aims for students to build knowledge and understanding of organizational management in practice and for students to apply this knowledge to real life work. Students will complete a work placement at a government office, state enterprise or any organisation related to relevant issues as designated by the instructor. The goal is for students to practise their skills and build experience in working with others.
derived_eng_desc1: Internship focused on organizational management and public administration in government or state enterprises, building practical skills.

eng_desc: The course aims for students to build knowledge and understanding of organizational management in practice and for students to apply this knowledge to real life work. Students will complete a work placement at a government office, state enterprise or any organization related to relevant issues as designated by the instructor to correspond to the selected module of academic concentration. The goal is for students to practice their skills and build experience in working as organization assets to be responsible and accountable to the performance and tasks committed for future careers of preferences.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on integrated practices in public administration and organizational management through work placement in government or state enterprises.

eng_desc: The course aims to provide an introduction of social, economic and political phenomena (which are relevant or connected to the concept of development) to the field of public law. In doing so, public law as a field of study is furthered developed to match with the dynamics of constant social change. Examples of these issues include: constitutional mechanisms for developing countries during transitional period; a new generation of rights and freedom following societal changes; the functions of the state and public law in a modern sharing economy.
derived_eng_desc1: Introduces public law in the context of social, economic, and political changes, including constitutional mechanisms and rights.

eng_desc: The course discusses the definitions and fundamental concepts of aliens, as provided under international law and Thai law. It also covers rights, duties, liability of aliens and alien-related criminal offences according to Thai law. It also explores the process of judicial proceedings involving aliens in the area of civil, criminal and public law.
derived_eng_desc1: Discusses international and Thai law concerning aliens, including rights, duties, liabilities, and judicial proceedings.

eng_desc: The course emphasizes on fundamental concepts applied in the process of land utilization for real estate development, which give students an insight into real estate business and its inter-connectedness with urban economic development. The course pays attention to the process of investment and development comprising of conceptual design, project planning, the examination of legal papers and consumer behavior, marketing and financial feasibility and tax payment. Principles of management, which are varied according to project types e.g. commercial and residential, are also included
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on real estate development and management, covering business, investment, project planning, marketing, and financial feasibility.

eng_desc: The course familiarizes students with the market microstructure of equity markets and the work process of sell-side and buy-side analysts in the valuation and recommendation of listed equity securities. There is emphasis on top down fundamental analysis starting with economic, industry, to company analysis. Mainstream valuation approaches (discounted cash flows, relative valuation, and residual income) are highlighted with hands-on approach to class delivery. Valuation of ESG and digital initiatives are included along with applications of simulations to evaluate asset price sensitivity.
derived_eng_desc1: Familiarizes students with equity markets, valuation, fundamental analysis, and financial techniques for listed equity securities.

eng_desc: The course focuses on issues central to innovation and the development of new products in the services industry; business issues in service industry; developing product prototypes; demonstrating and showcasing innovation and products
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on innovation and new product development in the services industry, addressing business issues and prototyping.

eng_name: Business Continuity Management in Service Industry
eng_desc: The course focuses on the principle of Business Continuity Plan (BCP); understanding organization context; business impact analysis; risk analysis; risk identification; risk assessment; risk management; risk control; business continuity management strategy; developing and Implementing BCM response
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on Business Continuity Management (BCM) principles, including risk analysis, assessment, and strategy development for service industries.

eng_desc: The course introduces concepts of sustainable financial management and sustainable investment, which emphasizes roles of environment, social and governance (ESG) and their associated risk, responsible investment, new financial instruments related to sustainable finance, ethics and best practice for finance people.
derived_eng_desc1: Introduces sustainable financial management and investment concepts, emphasizing ESG, responsible investment, and new financial instruments.

eng_desc: The course introduces financial risks that corporates necessarily take for value creation. These risks are measured, analyzed, and managed using financial and non-financial techniques so that risk levels satisfy corporate risk appetite and tolerance.
derived_eng_desc1: Introduces financial risk analysis and management for corporates, covering measurement, analysis, and management techniques.

eng_name: Project Management for Social Innovation and Social Entrepreneurship
eng_desc: The course introduces students to the ten indispensable areas of knowledge of project management: Human Resource Management, Cost Management, Risk Management, Quality Management, Procurement Management, Schedule Management, Scope Management, Communication Management, Stakeholder Management and Integration Management, as defined by the internationally-recognized PMBOK (Project Management Body of Knowledge). Students learn through the alternance of lectures and practice in teams, both in class and through home assignments.
derived_eng_desc1: Introduces project management knowledge areas (PMBOK), including human resource, cost, risk, quality, and stakeholder management.

eng_desc: The course introduces theoretical models for calculating fair values of financial instruments, especially derivatives and embedded derivatives, estimating impairment values of credit assets, and analyzing hedging for risk management. The results serve as inputs for financial reports under accounting standards.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on financial instruments, accounting, risk management, and financial reporting.

eng_desc: The course is seminar-based and encourages students' critical thinking toward problems and complications regarding business laws which are fundamentally related to the domestic economic system and the dynamic international system. This provides a broad approach in finding solutions for business law difficulties.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on business laws, their complications, and solutions within economic systems.

eng_desc: The course presents a formal analysis of entrepreneurship in theory and practice leading on to a consideration of creativity and business concept generation. The course concludes with the practical application of these theories and concepts in business planning and business concept presentation.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on entrepreneurship, business concept generation, business planning, and practical application.

eng_desc: The course provides student with opportunities to develop their legal research skills. Students will learn legal research methodologies and research ethics in this course. Each student will pick the topic of his/her independent study and produce an independent study report at the end of the course in conformity with legal research methodologies and research ethics and under the supervision of a supervisor. The length of the independent study is between 15-30 pages.
derived_eng_desc1: Develops legal research skills, methodologies, and ethics for independent legal study.

eng_desc: The course studies the strategic management process, the decision making, and the actions that determine the long-term performance of the social enterprises. The strategic management process includes the environmental scanning of the social enterprise, the strategy formulation and implementation, and the evaluation and control to ensure the achievement of the social contributions and its sustainability. It also explores the processes of social innovation, entrepreneurship, leadership as part of the strategy process. The learning is based on the combination of theory, case studies, and possible project works with practitioners. At the end of the course, the students are expected to produce a business plan for a social enterprise.
derived_eng_desc1: Studies strategic management, entrepreneurship, and business planning for social enterprises.

eng_desc: The course will examine accounting for service, merchandising business, manufacturing business and for corporation's models. Students will develop business plans and use accounting information for decision making, record transactions, prepare financial statements and perform ratio analysis.
derived_eng_desc1: Examines accounting principles, financial statements, and business plans for decision making.

eng_desc: The course will introduce the students to the significance of the pro bono service and skills required to provide legal aids in forms of pro bono service. The students will have opportunities to study social problems in practical world and provide legal solutions to such problems.
derived_eng_desc1: Introduces pro bono service, legal aids, and providing legal solutions to social problems.

eng_desc: The design, analysis, and implementation of enterprise-wide resource planning and control systems; demand forecasting, aggregate planning, decision support models for production planning, master scheduling, shop floor control; application of information technologies, such as ERP and MRP II, to operations planning and control.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on enterprise resource planning, control systems, production planning, and operations management.

eng_desc: The emergence of digital economy: opportunities for entrepreneurs, creation of new business models, innovations, data driven. The nature of business developments: the context of new business startups, the concepts of innovation, creativity, the roles play in entrepreneurship. The essential attributes of an entrepreneur. Develop a business plan for their startup firm. Presentation in business pitch. Explore different kinds of IT startup. Traditional IT business through case studies. Digital marketing strategy. Implementation.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on entrepreneurship, business models, startups, business plans, and digital marketing strategies in the digital economy.

eng_desc: The examination of current and influential issues that are related to the development of concept and practice in business approaches and the consequences on the development of design and technology.
derived_eng_desc1: Examines current issues related to business approaches, concepts, and practices, and their consequences on design and technology.

eng_desc: The fundamental concepts of business operation and the key knowledge required for operation of innovative business and industry. The contents concern finance, accounting, marketing, and management, business strategies and technical knowledge that leads to design innovation.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on fundamental concepts of business operation, finance, accounting, marketing, management, and business strategies for innovative industries.

eng_desc: The fundamental definition, concepts and theories of logistics management through keyactivities such as purchasing, warehousing, inventory management, physical distribution, transportationmanagement and other logistics issues
derived_eng_desc1: Introduces fundamental concepts and theories of logistics management, including purchasing, warehousing, inventory, and transportation.

eng_name: Principles of Business and Organizational Management
eng_desc: The fundamentals of designing and implementing organizational strategies. Knowledge about key business functions including marketing, operations, management, accounting, technology and databases. The importance of working collaboratively among those functions to drive business strategies and strengthen organizational competitive advantage.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on principles of business and organizational management, including strategies, marketing, operations, accounting, and technology.

eng_desc: The fusibilities of real estate businesses and their process as well as the their impacts. Influential factors in the demand and supply forecast, income and expense forecast, rate of return and their evaluation analysis are also included.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on real estate business feasibility studies, including demand/supply forecasts, financial analysis, and rate of return evaluation.

eng_desc: The global environments of international business, including the globalization process, regional economic cooperation, social, cultural, and political environments. Evolutions of international business, international trade and foreign direct investment. Key theories in international business. Roles and impacts of multinational enterprises.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on the global environment of international business, including globalization, economic cooperation, trade, and multinational enterprises.

eng_desc: The intersection of design and business is emphasized. The principles of business and the impacts of design solution heighten awareness of design as an essential part of business strategy. The emphasis is on the implementation and integration of design function in business contexts to generate innovative business opportunities. Case studies in Thailand and abroad are investigated.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on the intersection of design and business, emphasizing business strategy and opportunities.

eng_desc: The meaning, characteristics and structure of business including the basic principles of administration which consist of management, marketing, finance and accounts. Aside from these topics, the course focuses on the study of economic, political, social, and cultural factors, which affect businesses and can be applied to the study of other disciplines.
derived_eng_desc1: Directly focuses on business administration, management, marketing, finance, and accounts.

eng_name: Logistic and Supply Chain in China and GMS
eng_desc: The meaning, structure, characteristics, as well as the importance and management of logistics and supply chain, for managing the circulation and transfer of goods and services. Including various information between institutes that provides time and cost efficiency in response to the competitive advantage.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers logistics, supply chain management, and efficiency in goods/services transfer, fitting business administration.

eng_name: Accounting and Finance for Service Innovation Management
eng_desc: The objectives of the course cover the fundamentals of accounting principles; the various branches of accounting; the different service business structures; the construction and content of the financial statements; the balance sheet; the income statement; the statement of cash flows; the statement of retained earnings; the analysis and interpreting the financial statements; terminology used in finance; time value of money; various methods of financial management; making basic managerial and investment decisions
derived_eng_desc1: Covers accounting principles, financial statements, finance, and managerial decisions, core to business administration.

eng_desc: The objectives of this course is to enable the students to understand the strategies for effectively managing the hotel, conference center capacity and service related facilities; revenue management cover all areas of operations; yield management; forecasting and demand management; strategic pricing; revenue optimizing design.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on revenue and yield management strategies for hospitality and service operations, fitting business administration.

eng_desc: The organizational management system that emphasizes design, professional practices in design, trends and examples of design work, marketing strategies, consumer behavior and preferences towards products, organizational challenges and obstacles, labor and designers, cost estimation for design work, the importance of intellectual property laws, regulations, and the process of patent registration. The use of modern media to promote product design marketing is also included. Case study analysis of organizational management and design work.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on design management, marketing strategies, intellectual property, and business aspects of design.

eng_desc: The problems relevant to the application of international law to current situations in international society in accordance with theories and principles of law discussed in Public International Law I such as the principle of non-use of force, the principle of non-discrimination under WTO Law, the principle of sovereign equality and the principle of right to self-determination.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers public international law, including WTO Law and principles of international society.

eng_desc: The process of business building and organizational management of fashion branding factors and conditions that affect to brand building to the procedure of fashion product management. Expenditure planning the proportion of each product that relate to fashion industries. Field trips are included.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on fashion branding, merchandise management, business building, and financial planning in the fashion industry.

eng_desc: The process of business building and organizational management of fashion branding factors and conditions that affect to brand building to the procedure of fashion product management. Expenditure planning the proportion of each product that relate to fashion industries. Field trips are included.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on fashion branding, merchandise management, business building, and financial planning in the fashion industry.

eng_desc: The relationship and differences between accounting income and taxable income; and the recording of those differences; Personal income tax; Corporate income tax; Withholding tax; Value-added tax, Specific business tax and Accounting for income taxes; Tax responsibilities; Professional ethics; Authority of tax officers in tax assessment and collection.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers tax accounting, various types of income tax, business tax, and tax responsibilities.

eng_desc: The role and importance of cost accounting; cost terminology and cost accumulation systems, cost calculation under job order costing, cost calculation under process costing; manufacturing overhead cost allocation, joint cost allocation and accounting for by-product, variable costing and absorption costing system, standard costing system and cost variance analysis, costing system for just-in-time production.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers cost accounting principles, systems, and analysis, directly falling under business and administration.

eng_desc: The scope and importance of operations management in both service and manufacturing businesses. IT and Knowledge management to support operations. Competitive operations; strategies for success in manufacturing operations, the links with other business functions. Planning the provision; forecasting and planning, including location and layout of facilities, in the context of the globalised economy, and infrastructure development. Managing the supply chain; competitive advantage through the supply chain, models of the extended and virtual enterprise. Logistics and distribution issues. Timely provision of products and services; methods and techniques used to schedule and control business and manufacturing operations, including inventory and materials management. Achieving quality and freedom from waste; quality management, improvement techniques, cultural issues, measurement of quality performance, service quality. The content will be explored using a variety of management games.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers operations management, supply chain, logistics, and quality management in business, directly fitting business administration.

eng_desc: The scope of this unit is to study a wide range of issues concerning the use of laws to regulate natural resources. This includes but not limit to the following matters; the definition and importance of natural resources, the evolution, and concepts regarding natural resource cases.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on laws and regulations concerning natural resources, directly aligning with legal studies.

eng_desc: Theoretical concepts in international business. Academic research and articles on key issuesin international business.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers theoretical concepts and academic research on key issues in international business.

eng_desc: Theoretical concepts of corporate financial management and their applications to resolving real-world financial problems that financial managers regularly encounter, management of asset structure and financial mix, applications of financial models and instruments on managing assets, liabilities, and equity, valuation, the cost of capital, capital structure, capital budgeting under uncertainty, leasing, concepts of agency problems and corporate governance. Sustainable finance and its effects on firm valuation.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers theoretical concepts and applications of corporate financial management, including asset management, capital structure, and valuation.

eng_name: Human Resource Development in Organization and Social Contexts
eng_desc: Theoretical concepts of human resource development in organizational and social contexts. Designing human resource development activities in administrative and social contexts. The role of human resource developers. Human resource development experience training.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers human resource development in organizational and social contexts, including designing activities and training.

eng_name: Communication for Career Advancement and Professional Development
eng_desc: Theories and practices of professional communication for employment success.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on professional communication for career advancement and employment success, aligning with business and administration.

eng_name: Real Estate Marketing and Brokerage Management
eng_desc: Theories and principles on real estate marketing and brokerage management by analyzingeach marketing procedures from planning, implementing, controlling and evaluating. Study marketingstrategies in order to make feasible of real estate projects.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on real estate marketing, brokerage management, and strategies, aligning with business and administration.

eng_desc: Theories and process in business valuation. Using existing financial information and applying to the process of valuing business and stocks. Analyzing different aspects of finance and how to conduct reports. Valuing good will and other business rights.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on business valuation, financial information, and finance, aligning with business and administration.

eng_desc: Theories and tools are applicable for analysis of business problems and solutions, such as the application of economic concepts to forecast economic and industrial conditions, determination of business strategy, marketing, production, organization, human resource management, and decision-making.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on applying economic concepts to business problems, strategy, and management, aligning with business and administration.

eng_desc: Theories of Organisational Behaviour, Human Interactions in organisation, interpersonal communication skills in the workplace, teamwork skills, Innovation in organization management, Learning design for human capacity development
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on organizational behavior, management, and human capacity development, aligning with business and administration.

eng_desc: Theories of management and related concepts of planning, organizing, team building, leadership and controlling in textile industry.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on administration and management concepts applied to the textile industry, aligning with business and administration.

eng_desc: Theories, concepts, and process of strategic communication planning; audience identification: stakeholders, consumers, public, and others; media use for organization's marketing and business objectives; effective and efficient organizational management and communication.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on strategic communication planning, marketing, and organizational management, aligning with business and administration.

eng_desc: Theories, principles of sports business; sports business in international and local level; types of sports business owner, sports marketing, principles of finance management in sports business; and writing sport business proposal
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on sports business, marketing, and financial management, directly aligning with business and administration.

eng_desc: Theories, tools, techniques, and technologies to manage transportation, warehouse, and logistics systems. Introduction to logistics management. Supply chain drivers. Roles of logistics in supply chain. Transportation modes: motor, railroad, air, water, and intermodal modes. Inventory models with transportation choices. Global transportation. Designing of distribution networks. Information technology in transportation. Logistic strategies and other advanced topics in logistics and supply chain management. Fundamentals of warehouse managements, such as warehousing, warehouse technology, and best practice of modern warehouse operations.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on managing transportation, warehouse, and logistics systems within a business and supply chain context.

eng_desc: Theory and practice of modern portfolio management. Portfolio construction. Capital market expectations. Portfolio performance evaluation. Passive and active equity portfolio management. Factor investing. Bond portfolio management. Mutual fund business and empirical evidence in mutual funds. Contemporary issues in asset management. Financial modeling using actual market data in Excel program.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on modern portfolio and asset management, including financial modeling and capital market analysis.

eng_desc: Theory, concept, model in managing, analyzing, and planning in human resources, marketing, public relations, finance, facilities, and business management for team sport e.g. Football, Volleyball, Basketball etc.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers management, human resources, marketing, finance, and business for sports teams.

eng_desc: Theory, principles, and concepts in sports risk management. To study and analyze the environment, identify, evaluate, and respond to sports risks. To study rules, regulations, and laws including sports ethics to determine appropriate strategies for managing risks in various areas and risks planning preparation.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on theory and principles of risk management in sports, including legal and ethical aspects.

eng_desc: This course accommodates both theoretical and practical issues of importance in the law of evidence. For this purpose, comparative analyses are to be conducted of important decisions of the Supreme Court and certain evidentiary principles embodied in the Civil Procedure Code, the Criminal Procedure Code and other relevant laws, in order to provide students with better understanding of those legal principles as well as their application.
derived_eng_desc1: Seminar on theoretical and practical issues in the law of evidence, including civil and criminal procedures.

eng_name: Constitutional Procedural Law and Administrative Procedural Law
eng_desc: This course addresses the procedural rules of the Constitutional Court and Administrative Courts. It discusses the functions and jurisdictions of the Constitutional Court and Administrative Courts as well as types of constitutional cases and types of administrative cases. It also explores causes of action, procedural rules, decision-making process, provisional protection measures, effect of judgments and executions of judgments with respect to Constitutional Court and Administrative Courts.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers procedural rules of Constitutional and Administrative Courts, including case types and judgment execution.

eng_desc: This course addresses the questions about knowledge economy. How will it change the current global and local economies? Students will learn what “knowledge” is, and how to strategize its capture and dissemination within and across organizations, to maximize the respective performances of both collaborators and organizations. Students will learn why knowledge is critical asset of an organization, and how a sound knowledge management leads to an increased performance, more creativity and innovations, more profit, and more sustainability. They will understand that knowledge is a core competitive advantage for countries, organizations, and individuals alike. The 3-credit course delivery includes lectures, simulation exercises, high-level guest lecturers, group discussions, team work, debates, and in-depth reading assignments.
derived_eng_desc1: Addresses knowledge management strategies for organizations to enhance performance, innovation, and sustainability.

eng_desc: This course aims at discussing the relationship between the law and the practice of medicine with particular emphasis on modern developments in the latter. This course provides a basis for concentration on fundamental or generally applicable issues in medicine as a field that raises many moral issues. It covers several controversial areas, particularly importance being laid on current concepts of consent to and refusal of medical treatment, human rights, and negligence.
derived_eng_desc1: Discusses the relationship between law and medical practice, focusing on consent, human rights, and negligence.

eng_desc: This course aims on creating the realization of the importance of the pro bono service as well as developing relevant necessary skills for providing pro bono service of students. 15-hour classes on pro bono service learning are to provide for students in order to help them to understand the concept of pro bono service and to have other necessary information and know-hows. Student who enroll in this course can opt to practice pro bono legal service providing under the supervision of the Faculty of Law, Thammasat University or under lawyers or organizations designated by the Faculty of Law for 60 hours or to create a social service project that studies real-life social problems and aims on tackling with such problems or offering solutions especially from a legal aspect under the supervision of faculty' academic staff.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on pro bono legal service learning, developing skills for addressing social problems from a legal aspect.

eng_desc: This course aims on developing students' legal writing skills and their understanding towards legal writing methodologies, as well as legal reasoning and systematic writing, including legal academic writing, legal advice and how to articulate answers to legal examination questions.
derived_eng_desc1: Develops legal writing skills, legal reasoning, and methodologies for legal academic writing and advice.

eng_desc: This course aims to deliver an introduction to basic principles and concepts, policies, laws, and relevant regulations used to regulate the energy industry, including energy from petroleum, natural gas, renewable sources, legal measures for promoting investment in the renewable energy industry, and dispute resolution in the energy sector.
derived_eng_desc1: Introduces principles, policies, and laws regulating the energy industry, including renewable sources and dispute resolution.

eng_name: Professional Practice for Real Estate Development and Sustainability
eng_desc: This course aims to discuss in the current economic, social, culture, technology, energy, and environmental trends, including investment, operation, and management in the successful real estate business. Students will learn the value of the professional practice of real estate development through analytical thinking, problem-solving, discussion with guest speakers, and holding small seminars for sharing and discussing knowledge, know-how, and ideas, to prepare for professional practice in the future.
derived_eng_desc1: Discusses professional practice in real estate development and sustainability, covering investment, operation, and management.

eng_desc: This course aims to provide a general understanding of the concept, principle, and development of Thai legal frameworks concerning cultural management, which is of local, national, and international significance, namely cultural rights, cultural heritage, and cultural organizations. In addition to the national legislation, the international cultural law influencing Thai cultural policies will be taken into account. This course is also intended to address the issue regarding the interpretation of the Thai legal instruments pertaining to the cultural management.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on legal frameworks, legislation, and cultural management, aligning with legal studies.

eng_desc: This course aims to provide an account of the development of science and technology which directly or indirectly affect legal thoughts, legal statutes which may consequently affect laws in various areas such as contract law, family law, criminal law, procedural law and law of evidence. Its impacts on individual identity or public moral are also discussed.
derived_eng_desc1: Explores the impact of science and technology on various legal areas like contract, family, and criminal law.

eng_desc: This course aims to provide students with an overview of the theory and concept of domestic and foreign direct and portfolio investments. It also discusses investment policy and regulatory frameworks governing investment activities within the territory of Thailand, offshore investments made from Thailand, encouragement of investment and investment incentives, State administration of investment activities. This course discusses law concerning business organizations in Thailand, establishment and management of business organizations, financing in various processes, mergers and acquisitions, and basic legal documents and contracts used in different stages, such as shareholder agreement, share purchase agreement, business purchase agreement, loan agreement and legal due diligence. The course will also examine the role of municipal investment law and domestic dispute resolution and how it interacts with international investment treaty law and dispute resolutions.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers investment law, regulatory frameworks, business organizations, financing, and legal documents.

eng_desc: This course aims to provide students with an overview of the theory and concept of domestic and foreign direct and portfolio investments. It also discusses investment policy and regulatory frameworks governing investment activities within the territory of Thailand, offshore investments made from Thailand; encouragement of investment and investment incentives; State administration of investment activities. The course will also examine the role of municipal investment law and domestic dispute resolution and how it interacts with international investment treaty law and dispute resolutions. Investment-related legal documents and contracts, e.g., shareholder agreement, share purchase agreement, business purchase agreement, loan agreement, and legal due diligence, will also be explored.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on investment laws, regulatory frameworks, business administration, and legal documents related to investments.

eng_desc: This course aims to pursue a comparative study of administrative law, comparing and contrasting issues of particular importance in the administrative law of Thailand and those of other jurisdictions.
derived_eng_desc1: A comparative study of administrative law across different jurisdictions.

eng_desc: This course allows students to put their legal skills into practice and prepares them for their future professional careers through professional skills training sessions and internship. They will have the opportunity to choose to intern at a law firm, an international organization or other organizations which perform legal work. The minimum working duration required for students taking this course is 135 hours.
derived_eng_desc1: Develops essential legal skills and prepares students for professional careers as lawyers.

eng_desc: This course attempts to focus on general environment of sport business, especially professional sport and stadium service provider, and entertainment business including movies, dramas or other shows on television. Music industry, entertainment spot business, theme parks, entertainment convergence centers and relevant legal issues including contract law (Agency, Hire of work, Employment), intellectual property law, taxation law and other specific laws are also subjected to this course's exploration so that the students can understand how this business runs and roles of legal consultants in representing this kind of business.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on legal issues, contract law, intellectual property, and taxation within the sport and entertainment industries.

eng_desc: This course attempts to provide an account of legislation applicable to the operation of international trade and foreign investment by business operators and also offers a forum for discussions on related legal issues. management, laws regarding the conservation and management of forest, wildlife, biodiversity, land, marine resources, water resources, and minerals resources, and the role of judicial authorities in reviewing natural resources cases.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on legislation, international trade, foreign investment, and legal issues for business operators.

eng_desc: This course comparatively and historically explores fundamental principles of private law in selected civil and common law jurisdictions including Thai law.
derived_eng_desc1: Explores fundamental principles of private law in civil and common law jurisdictions.

eng_desc: This course compares and contrasts civil law of Thailand with civil law of other civil law and common law jurisdictions as well as backgrounds, philosophical foundations and juristic methods in civil law.
derived_eng_desc1: Compares and contrasts civil law across different jurisdictions, including philosophical foundations.

eng_desc: This course compares and contrasts criminal law in the civil law and common law jurisdictions.
derived_eng_desc1: Compares and contrasts criminal law in civil and common law jurisdictions.

eng_name: History and Theory of International Law
eng_desc: This course comprises 2 parts. The first part deals with the historical developments of the international legal system since the classical period before the Second World War. Focus will be placed upon the development in how European states in the modern period used international laws in their relations. In the second part, the course will deal with fundamental theoretical issues of international law such as the bindingness of international legal obligations, and the theories in some prominent schools of thought such as legal positivism, natural law, and the New Haven school.
derived_eng_desc1: Explores the historical development and theoretical issues of international law and legal systems.

eng_desc: This course covers accounting treatments for business combinations, joint arrangements, Investments in associates and joint ventures, Investments in subsidiaries, consolidated financial statements and separate financial statements, effects of changes in foreign exchange rates in translation of foreign entities, disclosures of interests in other entities, related party disclosures, operating segments, and foreign currency transactions.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers advanced financial accounting treatments for business combinations and financial statements.

eng_desc: This course covers accounting treatments for financing actiies, both debt and equity financing in accordance with Thai Financial Reporting Standards, i.e., accounting for financial liabilities, equity and earnings per share. This course also covers accounting for revenue recognition, deferred income tax, employee benefits, derivatives and hedge accounting, presentation of financial statements, and interim financial reporting.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on intermediate financial accounting, including financing activities, revenue, and financial statements.

eng_desc: This course covers key legal principles in real estate development, ranging from an overview and business practices in real estate development projects including real estate transactions. The examples include the discussion of the Land Code, real estate tax, laws on building control, land use law, and laws related to Real Estate Investment Trusts.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers legal principles in real estate development, transactions, and related laws.

eng_desc: This course covers legal principles relating to contracts of sale, hire of property, hire-purchase, agency, loan of money, and hire of work under the Civil and Commercial Code.
derived_eng_desc1: Examines legal principles of commercial contracts under the Civil and Commercial Code.

eng_desc: This course covers the conceptual framework for financial reporting and accounting treatments for investing activities in accordance with Thai Financial Reporting Standards., i.e., accounting for property plant and equipment, intangible assets, investment property, borrowing cost, impairment of assets, leases, and financial assets.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on financial reporting and accounting treatments for investing activities.

eng_desc: This course covers the law relating to negotiable instruments under the Civil and Commercial Code, including the law regarding bills of exchange and cheque default liabilities.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers law on negotiable instruments, bills of exchange, and cheque liabilities.
