eng_desc: This course covers the principles and concepts of double-Entry accounting system and recording in accounting cycle and preparation and presentation of financial statements in accordance with Thai Financial Reporting Standards. This course focuses on accounting for transactions that related to operating activity, a preparation of statement of cash flows, accounting changes and error corrections and events after the reporting period. Professional ethics and professional rules and regulations are also covered.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers fundamental financial accounting principles, financial statements, and professional ethics.

eng_name: International and Comparative Intellectual Property Law
eng_desc: This course covers two main topics: 1) international treaties and agreements concerning intellectual property, including the Paris and Berne Conventions, the TRIPs Agreement, the agreements of the World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO), and the Free Trade Agreements (FTAs) relating to intellectual property issues; 2) comparative law discussions of important features of the major national IP systems in the world on selected topics, such as copyright, trademark, patent, traditional knowledge, geographical indication, database and other forms of intellectual property. Controversial issues involving intellectual property rights and other legitimate concerns will also be discussed in this course, for instance, issues of access to medicines and the rights of indigenous people to benefit from their traditional knowledge.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers international and comparative intellectual property law, including treaties, copyright, and patents.

eng_name: Analysis Techniques for Complex Supply Chain Management Problems
eng_desc: This course deals with real-world complex supply chain management (SCM) problems from both the individual and integrated viewpoints of the SCM components. Well-known heuristic and meta-heuristic techniques, such as greedy heuristics, genetic algorithms (GA), simulated annealing (SA), ant colony optimization (ACO), etc. are introduced. Selected SCM problems are illustrated and their solution approaches are explained.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers analysis techniques for complex supply chain management problems and optimization.

eng_desc: This course discusses juristic acts, the general principles of contracts, the legal capacity of persons, and the legal effects of voidable and void acts as stipulated in the Civil and Commercial Code. The course further focuses on the fundamental doctrines of contracts as they appear in unfair contract terms law, consumer protection law, electronic transactions law and other specific laws, as well as current issues in contract law.
derived_eng_desc1: Discusses contract law principles, juristic acts, and consumer protection law.

eng_desc: This course discusses on theoretical accounts and development of legal methodology in light of linguistic, philosophical and historical conceptions in order to create understandings towards emergences and existences of legal systems in the world. It aims to examine legal methods, having originated in and evolved since the ancient past in continental European countries, as “Model” for the study of legal science. In these respect, it traces, from the classical period (Greco-Roman world) of Europe, by analyzing thoroughly general background and local particularities, the theories of knowledge in legal intellect. This course also includes some of contemporary issues of the historico-institutional approach, generally discussed until the late 20th century to explore, in conclusion, a comparative view on different contexts and, consequently, to equip learners with a legal method appropriate to our context.
derived_eng_desc1: Discusses legal methodology, historical legal systems, and comparative law.

eng_desc: This course discusses the Charter and other international legal instruments of Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) as well as the structures and organs of ASEAN. This course also studies other sets of international law which can be useful to creation of understandings towards ASEAN law such as such international law on international organizations, international economic law and those relevant to integration of states which can serve as a model of development for ASEAN such as European Union law. The comparative study of certain important areas of domestic law of ASEAN state members is also a subject of study of this course.
derived_eng_desc1: Discusses international law relating to ASEAN integration, international organizations, and economic law.

eng_desc: This course discusses the fundamental issues with respect to procedural rules of Administrative Courts namely jurisdictions, types of administrative case, causes of action for constitutional cases, Administrative Courts' proceedings, provisional measures before the issuance of judgements, judgments, as well as their effects and enforcement mechanisms.
derived_eng_desc1: Discusses administrative procedural law, administrative courts, and legal proceedings.

eng_desc: This course discusses the issues with respect to procedural rules of the Constitutional Court, namely its structure, types of constitutional cases, causes of action for constitutional cases, the Constitutional Court's proceedings, judgments as well as their effects and enforcement mechanisms.
derived_eng_desc1: Discusses constitutional procedural law, the Constitutional Court, and legal proceedings.

eng_desc: This course discusses the rules of international law concerning the sovereign's regulations on financial and monetary matters, and the roles of the international financial institutions that regulate and supervise the global financial governance, especially the International Monetary Fund (IMF). It also gives theoretical and practical ideas of banking and financial supervisions. The course also provides an account of some global economic crises and sovereign defaults. Some interesting aspects of private transactions are also included in the syllabus.
derived_eng_desc1: Discusses international financial and monetary law, financial institutions, and banking supervisions.

eng_desc: This course enables students to use their analytical skills in discussing interesting legal debates. It covers domestic, foreign, and international legal issues.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers current legal issues, including domestic, foreign, and international law.

eng_desc: This course encourages students to reflect on the fundamental and current issues concerning general principles of private law and legal reasoning in the context of private law.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on fundamental and current issues in private law and legal reasoning.

eng_name: Law on credits and secured transactions
eng_desc: This course examines credit providing transactions including current accounts. It also explores secured transactions such as suretyship, mortgage, pledge, business collateral contract, and project finance.
derived_eng_desc1: Examines law on credit and secured transactions, including mortgage, pledge, and project finance.

eng_desc: This course examines current legal issues in connection with State policies in criminal matters, criminal proceedings and others related to the administration of criminal justice as well as issues of particular importance in criminal procedure.
derived_eng_desc1: Examines current legal issues in criminal justice, criminal proceedings, and procedure.

eng_desc: This course examines general principles of the law of obligations under the Civil and Commercial Code and contemporary problems in the law of obligations.
derived_eng_desc1: Examines general principles of the law of obligations under the Civil and Commercial Code.

eng_desc: This course examines how to set up, manage and develop a business within the limits of the law. The law regulates and provides protection and value to every aspect of the business and its activities. In a step by step method, using case studies, students will be exposed to the ideas and concepts which make up the ingredients of a successful business. Identifying the business opportunity; developing the concept; setting up the vehicle to conduct the business, securing premises; equipment and employees; dealing with creditors, suppliers customers and the government; and protecting the assets of the business are all covered in this course.
derived_eng_desc1: Examines setting up, managing, and developing a business within legal frameworks.

eng_desc: This course examines issues arisen from merger and acquisition in different forms including taxation laws, business judgment. However, the legal aspect is the priority especially laws concerning the establishment of business organizations, securities laws and taxation law. Legal consultant's roles in practice with regard to the design of the construction of merger and acquisition, due diligence, evaluation of asset value, financing, negotiation to make an agreement, problems and measures used to prevent hostile takeovers and undue acquisitions.
derived_eng_desc1: Examines laws on merger and acquisition, including taxation, securities, and business organizations.

eng_desc: This course examines law of civil procedure that has special or distinguish characters including petty case, simple case, labour case, family and juvenile case, consumer protection case, taxation case and class action.
derived_eng_desc1: Examines specific procedural laws, including civil procedure, labor, family, and consumer protection cases.

eng_desc: This course examines legal concepts and issues regarding wealth and estate management. Its focus includes will drafting, family business management, estate holding by trusts and holding companies, and tax planning, especially income, land, and gift and inheritance tax. The course also seeks to explore other related legal issues concerning wealth management.
derived_eng_desc1: Examines legal concepts in wealth and estate management, including will drafting and tax planning.

eng_name: Law on contract of carriage by air
eng_desc: This course examines legal principles on carriage of persons and goods by air under international conventions and Thai laws. It also explores legal issues in relation to air passengers' rights including the events of denied boarding, long delay of flights or cancellation, the rights of passengers with special needs and the issues on advertising rules for airline tickets.
derived_eng_desc1: Examines law on contract of carriage by air and air passengers' rights.

eng_desc: This course examines legal problems and theoretical arguments observed in the German legal system. The students are required to do research and present their research results to the class under the supervision of instructors.
derived_eng_desc1: Examines legal problems and theoretical arguments within the German legal system.

eng_name: Customer Base Management for Value Creation
eng_desc: This course examines modern development and practice in the management of relationships between business and customers under the principle that customers are assets, in line with the concept of market based assets. This is done by the integral development of marketing, finance and management for the purpose of measuring and evaluating customer base value, as well as calculating important indexes beneficial for determining strategy, design and evaluation of the extent to which customer relationship management activities for creating value are worthwhile to business in the short and long term.
derived_eng_desc1: Examines customer base management, marketing, finance, and customer relationship management for value creation.

eng_desc: This course examines principles of law related to bills and other negotiable instruments.
derived_eng_desc1: Examines principles of law related to negotiable instruments, fitting business and regulatory frameworks.

eng_desc: This course examines principles of law related to carriage, deposit, loan for consumption, loan of money, warehousing, compromise, and gambling and betting.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on commercial contract law, including carriage, deposit, and loans, aligning with business and law.

eng_desc: This course examines principles of law related to contracts of sale, gift, hire of property, hire-purchase, hire of work, agency, and brokerage.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers principles of commercial contract law, including sales, hire, and agency, relevant to business and law.

eng_name: Law on risk management and insurance
eng_desc: This course examines risks and risk management. It also examines principles of law related to insurance, automobile insurance, life insurance, and non-life insurance.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on law related to risk management and various types of insurance.

eng_desc: This course examines tax law issues relating to carrying on businesses. Its focus will be placed on personal income tax, corporate income tax, value-added tax, and other related taxes.
derived_eng_desc1: Examines tax law issues for businesses, including income tax and VAT.

eng_desc: This course examines the concept, objectives and development processes and evaluation of the feasibility of business plans both of newly established and fully operational enterprises. The content covers enterprise modelling, the different components comprising the various elements of business planning, forming a vision, (13), goals, analyzing the situation, business strategy, marketing plans, production/operations planning, management planning, financial planning and contingency planning. The design of all these elements relies on both off-line and on-line landscapes. The focus will be on development of skills in integration of knowledge of duties in different business work areas in order to carry out business in a recognizable form.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers business planning, strategy, marketing, and financial planning for enterprises.

eng_desc: This course examines the emergence and evolution of the civil law system from the Roman period, the Medieval Period through the emergence of the French Civil Code and of the German Civil Code as well as the development of the codification in the present time. The study also embraces fundamental concepts as to sources of law, juristic methods and substantive principles of law in certain areas.
derived_eng_desc1: Examines the evolution and fundamental principles of the civil law system.

eng_desc: This course examines the foundations and general knowledge that is important and essential for communication, contact and appropriate behaviour in business circles, focusing on personality development, taking meeting minutes, project presentations, business negotiations, socializing and giving opinions in public.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on business culture, etiquette, communication, and negotiation skills.

eng_desc: This course examines the general principles of criminal law under the Penal Code, Part I and important offences under the Penal Code.
derived_eng_desc1: Examines general principles of criminal law and offences under the Penal Code.

eng_desc: This course examines the general principles of the law of obligations under the Civil and Commercial Code and contemporary problems in the law of obligation.
derived_eng_desc1: Examines general principles of the law of obligations under the Civil and Commercial Code.

eng_desc: This course examines the history, evolution, definition and types of constitutions. It explores the creation of states, and important theories of constitutional systems, such as the separation of powers and judicial review. Philosophical foundations of government systems, constitutional rights and freedoms, and political organs will also be discussed. In addition, it examines the history and general concepts of administration and administrative law. It also covers the sources of administrative law and the interpretation of administrative law. The administrative acts and administrative contracts will also be studied.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers constitutional and administrative law, including government systems, rights, and legal principles.

eng_desc: This course examines the law relating to business organizations, especially that dealing with partnerships, companies, joint ventures, and consortiums. It concentrates on their establishment, characteristics, management, the rights and duties of employees and representatives, winding-up and liquidation. State roles in controlling and supporting business transaction are also within the course's coverage.
derived_eng_desc1: Examines law related to business organizations, including partnerships, companies, and management.

eng_desc: This course examines the principles and concepts used to develop performance management in business by analyzing the relationship between strategy and performance management in determining ways of creating value for businesses both in the short and long term. Students will also compare the appropriateness and effects of applying various models of thought presented in the course to different size enterprises or different industries.
derived_eng_desc1: Examines performance management, business strategy, and value creation for enterprises.

eng_name: Extradition Law and Mutual Legal Assistance in Criminal Matters
eng_desc: This course examines theories about applying criminal law in relation to the international level, general principles of jurisdiction in extradition, principles of extradition of Thailand under the Extradition Act B.E. 2551, and other treaties concluded by Thailand and other states. International cooperation in criminal procedure and in prescribing international criminal offences are also discussed.
derived_eng_desc1: Examines extradition law, international criminal law, and mutual legal assistance.

eng_desc: This course examines theories and fundamental principles of laws applied to prevent and deter economic crimes affecting a nation's economic security, such as laws concerning public cheating and fraud, laws concerning financial institution, laws concerning securities and securities market, laws concerning prevention and deterrence of money laundering, criminal offences of business entities as well as problems with respect to the application of laws and international cooperation on the prevention and deterrence of such crime.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers laws on economic crimes, financial institutions, securities, and money laundering.

eng_desc: This course examines various types of taxes related to business planning. The issues range from choices of business entities; business operations, such as remuneration and employee benefits, choices of corporate distributions, property transfers, and business restructurings (e.g. mergers and acquisitions and business transfers).
derived_eng_desc1: Examines taxation for business planning, including entity choices and corporate restructuring.

eng_desc: This course explores a survey of Thai tax law under the Revenue Code of Thailand and other related laws. It has two main objectives: (i) to provide fundamentals of Thai tax system and structure; (ii) to serve as foundation for more advanced tax courses.
derived_eng_desc1: Introduces Thai tax law, covering the tax system and structure.

eng_desc: This course explores fundamental principles of legal counseling, trial, and case preparation. It also provides training to students on writing memorials and submissions as well as presenting oral arguments before courts and tribunals. The course provides an opportunity for students to apply domestic law and international law in mock court cases or moot arbitration.
derived_eng_desc1: Provides training in legal counseling, trial preparation, and oral arguments for mock courts.

eng_desc: This course explores international legal principles in space law including the liability principle, jurisdictions of States in space activities, the rescue of astronaut and the return of space objects as well as the roles of international organizations to regulate and monitor space activities. The course also addresses laws concerning space applications such as telecommunication satellites, remote sensing satellite, national space legislations, etc. The legal problems from space activities like space debris and space resources are mentioned. The course additionally gives an account to legislative process for space activity in national and international institutions by governments and private sectors.
derived_eng_desc1: Examines international space law, covering liability, jurisdiction, and space applications.

eng_desc: This course explores law of criminal procedure that has special or distinguish characters including criminal case where culprits are juvenile, criminal case in district court, case concerning violence in family, criminal case concerning politicians and extradition case.
derived_eng_desc1: Explores specific criminal procedural law, including juvenile and family violence cases.

eng_desc: This course explores legal issues on the economic integration of ASEAN, the evolution of ASEAN Economic Community, and the transformation of ASEAN to ASEAN Community, which consists of three pillars: ASEAN Political-Security Community (APSC), ASEAN Economic Community (AEC) and ASEAN Socio-Cultural Community. The scope of this course embraces the nature and structure of the organization, sources of ASEAN law and its external relations with contracting states and international organizations.
derived_eng_desc1: Explores legal issues of ASEAN economic integration and the structure of ASEAN law.

eng_desc: This course explores legal issues related to corporate mergers and acquisitions. The topics covered include key drivers of M&A, valuation, deal structures and process, shareholder voting and appraisal rights, fiduciary duties, securities law requirements, tax issues, and antitrust considerations.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers legal issues in corporate mergers and acquisitions, including valuation and securities law.

eng_desc: This course explores public international law concerning international trade relationships. It focuses upon international trade issues, the legal principles governing international trade, various trade disputes between countries, as well as the specific work and law of relevant international organizations, including the World Trade Organization (WTO).
derived_eng_desc1: Explores international trade law, legal principles, trade disputes, and WTO regulations.

eng_desc: This course explores the fundamental concepts, objectives, and principles of financial markets, the establishment of financial institutions, the practices of financial services providers, the laws and regulations applicable to the organization of financial institutions, and the roles of financial institutions in relation to services at domestic and international levels to maintain the financial and economic stability of the country.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers banking and finance law, financial markets, institutions, and regulations.

eng_desc: This course explores the fundamental concepts, rationales, and principles of consumer protection law. It examines the work of relevant consumer protection organizations, legal mechanisms used for consumer protection, consumer assistance, as well as remedies. It also covers special legal procedural rules when dealing with consumer protection cases.
derived_eng_desc1: Explores consumer protection law, legal mechanisms, and remedies for consumers.

eng_name: Introduction to the Chinese Legal System
eng_desc: This course explores the fundamental structure and operation of the Chinese legal system, offering a critical perspective on the development of law in China and providing students with the basic training necessary to work with Chinese law on a deeper and practical level. The course covers the historical development of the Chinese legal system, the relevant institutions responsible for the formation and application of law in China (and associated legislative and judicial processes) and issues of Chinese law, society and culture.
derived_eng_desc1: Introduces the Chinese legal system, its historical development, and institutions.

eng_desc: This course explores the history and evolution of the constitution, state organs, rights and liberties, fundamental theories of constitutionalism such as the separation of powers, judicial review, general legal principles of public finance and fiscal disciples and philosophical foundations of constitutional theories.
derived_eng_desc1: Explores constitutional law, including state organs, rights, and judicial review.

eng_desc: This course explores the history of Constitutional Court. It explains the rule of law and democracy with regard to Constitutional Court as well as the structure and system of Constitutional Court. It also addresses the elements and selection process of Judiciary of the Constitutional Court. The scope of study also includes the power of Constitutional Court in scrutinizing legislative and executive branches as well as important organs under the Constitution and activities of political parties.
derived_eng_desc1: Examines the Constitutional Court, its history, structure, and role in democracy.

eng_desc: This course explores the history of the German legal system, in particular, the emergence of the German Civil Code. Emphasis is placed on juristic methods and important institutions in the German legal system. The study embraces important legal principles in, for example, juristic acts, obligations, torts and property and also recent development subsequent to the preparation of the German Civil Code.
derived_eng_desc1: Introduces the German legal system, its history, and key legal principles.

eng_desc: This course explores the legal concepts and principles underlying the practice of tax assessment and the settlement of a tax dispute between the state and a taxpayer. In particular, the course is aimed to take students through the process of administrative appeals and subsequent proceedings in court.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers tax dispute settlement, administrative appeals, and court proceedings.

eng_desc: This course explores the meaning and significance of financial institutions, the State's policies and roles of the Bank of Thailand in exercising control and supervision of financial institutions both in the public and private sectors, the law and regulations applicable to the organisation of financial institutions, roles of financial institutions in relation to deposits, credit extension and other services at domestic and international levels. Problems and recommendations in connection with the control and development of financial institutions and other aspects are also attempted.
derived_eng_desc1: Examines law concerning financial institutions, state policies, and regulations.

eng_desc: This course explores the nature and purposes of customs law, the evolution and backgrounds of customs law, liability for customs duties, customs formalities, liability and penalties under customs law, principles related to customs tariffs, interpretation of customs tariffs, powers and duties of customs officials, customs cases, exemption and returns of customs duties, the relationship between customs law and promotion of investment, industrial estates and other laws as well as customs-related international agreements.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers customs law, global trade, duties, tariffs, and international agreements.

eng_desc: This course explores the nature of media, entertainment, and sports business and industry including the principle of freedom of expression and media freedom, regulation of different media including newspaper, radio, television and social media, legal issues in entertainment business, and sports law.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on legal issues, regulation, and business aspects within media, entertainment, and sports industries.

eng_desc: This course explores the nature of telecommunication business as well as its context and discusses legal and regulatory issues in telecommunication industry. The topics may include licensing, competition, consumer protection and the roles of National Broadcasting and Telecommunication Commission (NBTC) in regulating the industry.
derived_eng_desc1: Explores legal and regulatory issues in the telecommunication business, including licensing, competition, and consumer protection.

eng_desc: This course explores the principle and concept of sustainable urban development, government agencies role and authority in urban development, for example, Local Administration and other State agency, Land Readjustment law for land development, including with relationship between major law in urban development such as environmental law, Town Planning law and Building Control law, etc.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on legal principles, government roles, and various laws related to sustainable urban development and planning.

eng_name: Introduction to Law and Sustainable Development
eng_desc: This course explores the principles and development of the concept of sustainable development. It includes the influence of the concept of sustainable development both at the international level (e.g. international agreements which embrace the idea of sustainable development and the development of principles of sustainable development by international organizations) and in the national context (e.g. the roles and influence of the principles of sustainable development in Thai legal system, the enactment and enforcement of the law which aims at achieving sustainable development, and other Thai laws which relate to sustainable development).
derived_eng_desc1: Explores legal principles and the development of sustainable development concepts in international and national legal systems.

eng_desc: This course explores the principles of law relating to property under the Civil and Commercial Code, Books I and IV.
derived_eng_desc1: Explores principles of property law under the Civil and Commercial Code.

eng_desc: This course explores the relationship between the State and public authorities of varying categories such as civil servants, officials of State Enterprises and officials of public organisations, with regard to the formation, modification and annullation of legal relations, rights and duties of State officials as well as disciplinary action and the initiation of legal proceedings for compensation.
derived_eng_desc1: Explores law concerning the State and public authorities, including legal relations, rights, duties, and proceedings.

eng_desc: This course explores the structure and system of Courts of Justice and a study of the law of civil procedure with regard to general provisions, procedure in courts of first instance, appeal to the Court of Appeal and to the Supreme Court.
derived_eng_desc1: Explores the law of civil procedure, court structure, and appeal processes.

eng_desc: This course explores theories underlying international criminal law and absolute international criminal offences including laws concerning genocide, crime against humanity, war crime, agression, together with the International Criminal Court's procedure under the Rome Statute of 1999.
derived_eng_desc1: Explores theories and offences of international criminal law, including genocide, war crimes, and ICC procedures.

eng_desc: This course focuses on key characteristics of business and entrepreneurialapproaches, covering basic business functions such as operation, marketing, finance,accounting, management information system, and human resource management. Anunderstanding of these key functions will provide a solid foundation for developing a corporatesocial responsibility business plan drawing on the UN Human Rights and SustainableDevelopment Goals framework.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on business functions, entrepreneurial approaches, and corporate social responsibility within a sustainable development framework.

eng_desc: This course focuses on the skills required for working in multicultural environments and sustainable businesses. The course will teach students about human values and cross-cultural differences along with tools to help them communicate, lead, persuade, make decisions, and give and receive feedback in environments where they are working across organisations and cultures. The course will also help students build practical strategic marketing skills in the context of sustainable business practices.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on sustainable business practices, multicultural environments, communication, leadership, and strategic marketing skills.

eng_desc: This course gives a theoretical and historical account, in a comparative dimension, of common law and civil law traditions, principles concerning the application and interpretation of written law, analogy of law, the application of customary law and the application of “general principles of law” under section 4 of the Civil and Commercial Code. In addition, the course also embraces the application and interpretation of specific laws such as the criminal law, public law, contract law, etc. For these purposes, selected practical problems as well as theoretical problems will be explored.
derived_eng_desc1: Explores theoretical and practical application and interpretation of various laws, including common, civil, criminal, and public law.

eng_desc: This course gives an account of economic theory for analysis of competition law, concepts, principles and exceptions in competition law, the means used to regulate or supervise activities which will affect free and fair competition, the state's role in law enforcement and problems pertaining to international trade and international investments.
derived_eng_desc1: Explores competition law, economic theory, regulation, and its impact on international trade and investments.

eng_name: Law of Public Finance and Taxation 1
eng_desc: This course gives an account of finance law in relation to finance, fiscal affairs, budgetary procedures, taxation and institutions involved in financial and fiscal affairs. In addition, economic theories related to financial and fiscal affairs in the light of public administration will also be grasped.
derived_eng_desc1: Explores finance law, public finance, taxation, budgetary procedures, and related economic theories.

eng_desc: This course gives an account of general principles in the Civil and Commercial Code in the following Titles: (1) Persons (2) Property (types of property and proprietary rights) (3) Juristic acts (general principles, declaration of will, void and voidable acts) (4) Obligations and contracts
derived_eng_desc1: Explores general principles of Civil and Commercial Law, including persons, property, juristic acts, and contracts.

eng_name: Introduction to South East Asian Legal Systems
eng_desc: This course gives an account of historical backgrounds, the contents and the reception of western laws and legal institutions of particular importance in private law, criminal law and procedural laws in countries in the Southeast Asian region e.g. Myanmar, Laos, Cambodia, Vietnam, the Philippines, Malaysia, Singapore, Brunei and Indonesia.
derived_eng_desc1: Introduces historical backgrounds and contents of legal systems in Southeast Asian countries, including private and criminal law.

eng_name: Introduction to the Thai Legal System
eng_desc: This course gives an account of historical backgrounds, the contents and the reception of western laws, juristic methods and legal institutions of particular importance into Thai law and also revisits peculiar features of the existing Thai legal system in public law, private law and other branches of law.
derived_eng_desc1: Introduces the historical background, contents, and features of the Thai legal system, including public and private law.

eng_desc: This course gives an account of legal concepts in relation to the conservation, management, exploitation and sustainable development of natural resources and the environment. It also aims to address methods deployed in controlling pollution in land, water and air, as well as environmental impact assessments and other environmental enhancement and promotion laws. Related legislation is also covered.
derived_eng_desc1: Explores environmental law concepts for business, focusing on conservation, pollution control, and sustainable development legislation.

eng_desc: This course gives an account of principles of law, important socio-legal issues and psychological aspects in relation to juvenile offenders, administration of justice for juveniles, the Juvenile and Family Court system, juvenile offender correction and juvenile protection according to Juvenile and Family Court law.
derived_eng_desc1: Explores principles of law, socio-legal issues, and the administration of justice within the juvenile justice system.

eng_desc: This course gives an account of the history and substance of the Roman legal system which provides a foundation of legal systems of civil law jurisdictions at present.
derived_eng_desc1: Introduces the history and substance of the Roman legal system, foundational for civil law.

eng_name: Law of the Maintenance of Peace and International Security
eng_desc: This course gives an account of the legal systems and the operations of the League of Nations and the United Nations in respect of the maintenance of peace and international security. Also, legal issues surrounding important events or crises in international relations from the past up to present will be grasped.
derived_eng_desc1: Explores law concerning international peace and security, including UN operations and international legal issues.

eng_desc: This course gives an account of the overall concepts of international commercial arbitration, the nature of cases brought to arbitration, arbitration clauses, applicable laws in to arbitration, the composition, competence and roles of arbitral tribunals and arbitral procedures. The scope of the course is extended to the role of the judiciary related to arbitration, including the recognition and enforcement of awards and their annulment.
derived_eng_desc1: Explores concepts of international commercial arbitration, procedures, tribunals, and the role of the judiciary.

eng_desc: This course intends to explore the history of Thai cultures and society as the foundation of important legal institutions of Thailand. The study also covers influences of thinking, legal principles and legal systems of India and western countries on the evolution of Thai law. In addition, this course provides an account of the evolution of Thai law from the ancient times to the present time, in particular, from the period of codification of law upwards, based upon the comparative law approach with a view to due comprehension of the legal system of Thailand.
derived_eng_desc1: Explores the history and evolution of Thai legal institutions and law, including influences from other legal systems.

eng_desc: This course introduces concepts of project management and techniques for planning, utilizing, and controlling of resources to accomplish specific goals. While the focus is on technically-oriented projects, the principles discussed are applicable to the management of any project. Topics include estimation of project duration, time-cost consideration, workforce allocation, cash flow forecasting, financial and performance control, and documentation.
derived_eng_desc1: Introduces project management concepts, techniques for planning, resource control, and financial aspects.

eng_desc: This course introduces international income tax law with an emphasis on the problems of double taxation and methods to eliminate it. The course also includes the developments in international cooperation on anti-tax avoidance measures.
derived_eng_desc1: Introduces international income tax law, focusing on double taxation and anti-tax avoidance measures.

eng_desc: This course introduces law students to legal study. It guides and trains them to understand and classify sources of significant information used for legal study. Its objectives include improving students' reading and analyzing skills, legal argumentation and criticism, and research. It provides students with writing and presenting skills expressing the application of legal concepts and ethics.
derived_eng_desc1: Introduces legal communication skills for law students, focusing on analysis, argumentation, research, writing, and ethics.

eng_desc: This course introduces law students to models and theories of business communication and negotiation, with focus on practice and application of specific negotiating skills and conflict resolution.
derived_eng_desc1: Introduces business communication and negotiation models, focusing on practical skills and conflict resolution.

eng_desc: This course introduces students to the legal framework and practical implementation of business compliance. Based on a critical reflection of its origins and development, participants explore the goals and challenges of compliance management in domestic and multinational settings. The main regulatory, procedural, psychological and strategic aspects are addressed with references to interdisciplinary links. The course combines general and sector-specific elements of business compliance. From a general perspective, students discuss relevant issues of corporate governance, risk management, organizational psychology and cross-cultural compliance. Key issues related to internal investigations and whistleblower protection are also covered. Sector-specific topics include anti-bribery compliance, cyber and privacy compliance, anti-money laundering, labor and human rights compliance and other suitable areas.
derived_eng_desc1: Introduces business compliance, legal frameworks, compliance management, corporate governance, and various sector-specific compliance topics.

eng_desc: This course introduces students to the principles of innovation and entrepreneurship and will provide an understanding of the social, ethical and policy implications of technology by focusing on the human impact of information systems, technology-oriented products, and their intended and unintended consequences. The course covers various kinds and forms of entrepreneurship including startups, growth ventures, social and corporate entrepreneurship and will look at various types of technological innovation through real life cases. Readings will include main textbooks, book chapters, journal articles, and online resources. This interactive course will include guest lectures by individuals involved in technology, innovation, and entrepreneurship and/or engaged in the study and practice thereof. Students will engage in team and/or individual activities and assignments and are expected to apply everything they have learned in the GSSE program towards creating their own project. Some of the course objectives include developing an entrepreneurial mindset in an increasingly diverse and dynamic global environment and being able to understand the dynamics of technological innovation and be able to articulate the impact of innovation and entrepreneurship on economic development.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on entrepreneurship, business, and the economic impact of technology.

eng_desc: This course introduces the importance of digital marketing in social enterprise projects. Students will learn concepts, techniques, and methods necessary for a successful marketing campaign. International cases, examples, and practices will be introduced. Moreover, a strong emphasis will be placed on ethical issues behind digital marketing.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on digital marketing and social enterprise, which falls under business and administration.

eng_desc: This course introduces the methods of argument used in common law legal cultures, such as the United States. Common law argument is distinguished by the authoritative value of judicial precedent. We will use the signature U.S. legal text – the judicial opinion to survey the U.S. court system, consider the weight of differing kinds of legal authority and strategize how we can form a successful common law argument. The course equips student with intentional learning strategies to help them design, craft and evaluate their own legal documents. First principles of good writing will be emphasized, with special focus on the writing process and writing for a legal audience. Readings from legal theory will frame our in-class discussions.
derived_eng_desc1: Clearly about legal studies, common law, and legal documents.

eng_name: Project Conceptualization and Grant Proposal Writing
eng_desc: This course introduces the student to the process of developing projects that provide benefits to disadvantaged individuals and communities. Specifically students will learn how to identify social problems in need of resolution and how to develop effective and sustainable strategies to solve or mitigate the impact of such social problems. Importantly, students will also learn the basics of drafting a grant proposal for funding to successfully implement their designed projects, including drafting a compelling mission statement, creating a realistic budget, reporting back to funders, and measuring outcomes.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on project development, grant writing, budgeting, and administration for social projects.

eng_desc: This course introduces various types of taxes and their challenges arising from the digital economy. The focus will be placed on emerging tax-related issues involved in electronic transactions, such as e-commerce, e-services, digital assets, cross-border transactions regarding intellectual properties, and digital platforms.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on taxation and legal/regulatory aspects within the digital economy.

eng_desc: This course is a continuation of GTS451 Intellectual Property Development 1. All students are eligible to earn 6 credits from this course when the registration application of the intellectual property is approved by the related organization or the intellectual property is used by an organization and generates continuous tangible income. This course may be registered after the approval or the tangible income is generated not later than 1 year. The grade of this course is considered by the advisor(s) and a committee member set by the academic program based on the quality of the intellectual property.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on intellectual property, its registration, and generating income, which are legal and business aspects.

eng_desc: This course is a forum for practising English skills in relation to writing and reading English-language legal documents, with particular emphasis on, inter alia, drafting and reviewing contracts, writing legal opinions, legal reports, notice and correspondence in the legal profession and, in addition, writing academic works in English. The scope of this course extends to providing practice on reading the above-mentioned legal documents, academic writings, judgments or decisions of adjudicatory bodies and other English-language documents used in the legal profession.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on legal documents, contracts, and the legal profession, which are legal studies.

eng_desc: This course is a forum for the study of the meaning and significance of human rights and fundamental rights as recognized in the Constitution of the Kingdom of Thailand as well as the historical backgrounds, development, types of rights, and the protection of fundamental rights in various legal systems.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on fundamental rights, human rights, and constitutional law within legal systems.

eng_name: Seminar on Problems in Criminal Law
eng_desc: This course is a practical forum for discussing issues of particular importance in criminal law with a view to a sharper insight into criminal law.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on criminal law and legal issues.

eng_desc: This course is a practical forum for grasping the evolution of the legal profession, functions and works of lawyers in different areas, ethics, disciplines and ideologies of lawyers, and also organisations for overseeing the operation of the legal profession.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on the legal profession, lawyers' ethics, and related organizations.

eng_desc: This course is a practical forum for grasping the evolution of the legal profession, its functions, the work of lawyers in different areas, ethics, disciplines and ideologies of lawyers, and also organizations for overseeing the operation of the legal profession as well as ethical problems in legal practices. This course is rendered utilizing a problem-based learning approach.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on legal ethics, the legal profession, and ethical problems in legal practices.

eng_name: Law Relating to Control of the Exercise of State Power
eng_desc: This course is aimed at a study of such constitutional mechanisms for controlling the exercise of the State powers as used by non-judicial orgainisations under the Constitution and by citizens. For this purpose, this course will discuss the structures, missions and functions of such constitutional organisations, for example the National Counter Corruption Commission, the National Human Rights Commission, the Ombudmen, the State Audit Commission and Auditor General. The study also covers referendum and the mechanism relevant to petitions to initiate bills by citizens.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on constitutional law, state power control, and legal/administrative organizations.

eng_desc: This course is aimed at examining the Constitution of Thailand in comparison with constitutions of other jurisdictions in issues of particular importance.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on comparative constitutional law, a core legal study.

eng_desc: This course is aimed at exploring administrative law and procedure and manner in which the various state agencies are a part of the integral workings of business operations, including, but not limited to, the areas of administrative contracts, public and private partnership (PPP), and environmental operations.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on administrative law, business operations, and public-private partnerships.

eng_desc: This course is aimed at exploring roles and the significance of the law vis-à-vis international economy, in the light of international trade, international finance, and foreign direct investment. The study also covers economic roles played by important international organisations such as the World Trade Organisation (WTO), the United Nations Conference on Trade and Development (UNCTAD), the International Bank of Reconstruction and Development (IBRD), and the International Monetary Fund (IMF).
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on international economic law, trade, finance, and related organizations.

eng_desc: This course is aimed at exploring the history, evolution, theories, conceptions and philosophical thinking in connection with fundamental rights and providing an account of principles and rules of legal nature as well as those which are of moral nature. Means for the promotion and protection of human rights are also discussed.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on international human rights law, fundamental rights, and legal principles.

eng_desc: This course is aimed at providing an overview of the American legal system, including its court structure and procedure, basic substantive legal principles, juristic and legislative methods, and the operation of the legal profession and legal education.
derived_eng_desc1: Provides an overview of the American legal system and legal principles.

eng_desc: This course is aimed at providing the overview of the Chinese legal system, including some basic legal principles, juristic methods, some judiciary bodies, legal profession and legal education.
derived_eng_desc1: Provides an overview of the Chinese legal system and legal principles.

eng_desc: This course is aimed at providing the overview of the English legal system, including some basic legal principles, juristic methods, some judiciary bodies, legal profession and legal education.
derived_eng_desc1: Provides an overview of the English legal system and legal principles.

eng_desc: This course is aimed at providing the overview of the French legal system, including some basic legal principles, juristic methods, some judiciary bodies, legal profession and legal education.
derived_eng_desc1: Provides an overview of the French legal system and legal principles.

eng_desc: This course is aimed at providing the overview of the German legal system, including some basic legal principles, juristic methods, some judiciary bodies, legal profession and legal education.
derived_eng_desc1: Provides an overview of the German legal system and legal principles.

eng_desc: This course is aimed at providing the overview of the Japanese legal system, including some basic legal principles, juristic methods, some judiciary bodies, legal profession and legal education.
derived_eng_desc1: Provides an overview of the Japanese legal system and legal principles.

eng_desc: This course is an introductory class that presents the preliminary type of real estates development project, such as sale and marketing management, investment, regulation, and communication. This course will be taught in Thai and English to set up all the technical terms for architecture for real estate development.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on management, marketing, investment, and regulation aspects of real estate projects.

eng_desc: This course is centered on knowledge, skills, and attitudes that software engineers must possess to practice software engineering in a professional, responsible and ethical manner.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on ethics and professional issues relevant to software engineers, aligning with administration and professional conduct.

eng_desc: This course is dedicated to examining general principles of criminal law under the Penal Code, Part I.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on general principles of criminal law.

eng_desc: This course is dedicated to exploring principles in maritime law e.g. the law on sea liners, the law related to mortgage of vessels and maritime preferential rights, liability and limitation of liability of shipowners, charterparties, carriage of goods by sea, liability for vessel collision, sea salvage, general average and marine insurance.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on principles of maritime law, including liability, contracts, and insurance.

eng_desc: This course is dedicated to exploring the establishment and evolvement of the German constitution and principles of public law. It focuses on political institutions, human dignity, fundamental rights and freedom, equality, rule of law, democracy, federalism, social equity, and other relevant legal theories by analyzing some examples of application and interpretation of the German constitution as appeared in decisions of the German Constitutional Court.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on German public law, constitution, political institutions, and legal theories.

eng_name: Accounting Principles and Financial Statements for Lawyers
eng_desc: This course is dedicated to giving an introduction to fundamental accounting principles, evaluation of assets, concepts regarding net value, and how to understand and analyze financial statements beneficial to the practice of business laws and to cooperation with other professionals concerned.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers accounting principles and financial statements relevant to business law practice.

eng_desc: This course is dedicated to investigating the history, backgrounds and regulations relevant to the State's control and undertaking of economic activities. The study embraces how the State exercises control over economic activities undertaken by individuals and how the State engages in economic activities. Also covered by the exploration are measures exercisable by the State as reflected in relevant legislation. Shortcomings in the law and possible solutions will be canvassed as well.
derived_eng_desc1: Investigates public economic laws, state control over economic activities, and relevant legislation.

eng_desc: This course is designed to serve as the capstone experience to provide students with an opportunity to bring together the various theories, concepts and skills that they have been introduced to in the program. Students will work on a major project that provides them with an opportunity to demonstrate and showcase their capacity to manage the overall management process where multidisciplinary thinking will be stressed.
derived_eng_desc1: Capstone course on service innovation consultancy, focusing on management processes and multidisciplinary thinking.

eng_name: International Law of Diplomatic and Consular Relations
eng_desc: This course is devoted to studying legal principles on diplomatic and consular matters in accordance with the Vienna Convention on Diplomatic Relations of 1961, the Vienna Convention on Consular Relations of 1963, the Convention on Special Diplomats of 1969, and current state practice.
derived_eng_desc1: Studies international law, diplomatic and consular relations, and relevant conventions.

eng_name: Law Concerning Finance in International Business Transactions
eng_desc: This course is devoted to studying the meaning and importance of finance, financial markets and financial contracts in international business transactions, roles of financial institutions and financial markets at both domestic and international levels, financial services, legal principles, regulations and practices in relation to the conclusion of international financial agreements, e.g. loan agreements and guarantees, standby credits, letters of credit and performance bonds issued as security for performance of international debts, principles of contract law and the use of letters of credit, bills of exchange and promissory notes as a means of international payment, trust receipts, currency exchange control and roles of the State in financial control, and international financial markets as well as international finance agreements.
derived_eng_desc1: Studies law concerning finance, financial markets, and contracts in international business transactions.

eng_name: Selected Topics in Law and Sustainable Development Law
eng_desc: This course is instructed in English. It aims to introduce students to a selected body of literature on central topics in law and sustainable development. In addition, it explores the legal issues of many countries which have arisen within the context of law and sustainable development from a comparative perspective. Apart from the comparison of legal issues, the emphasis is laid mainly on the solutions to the problems taken by developed and developing countries. The legal issues concerned will be general problems which have effects on those countries.
derived_eng_desc1: Explores selected topics in law and sustainable development from a comparative legal perspective.

eng_name: Selected Topics in Civil Law (Instructed in English)
eng_desc: This course is instructed in English. The course explores particular selected topics in the area of civil law.
derived_eng_desc1: Explores selected topics in the area of civil law.

eng_desc: This course is instructed in English. The course explores particular selected topics in the area of commercial law.
derived_eng_desc1: Explores selected topics in the area of commercial law.

eng_name: Selected Topics in Criminal Law (Instructed in English)
eng_desc: This course is instructed in English. The course explores particular selected topics in the area of criminal law.
derived_eng_desc1: Explores selected topics in the area of criminal law.

eng_name: Selected Topics in International Law (Instructed in English)
eng_desc: This course is instructed in English. The course explores particular selected topics in the area of international law.
derived_eng_desc1: Explores selected topics in the area of international law.

eng_name: Selected Topics in Public Law (Instructed in English)
eng_desc: This course is instructed in English. The course explores particular selected topics in the area of public law.
derived_eng_desc1: Explores selected topics in the area of public law.

eng_name: Special Study in Business and Supply Chain Analytics I
eng_desc: This course is intended for students who wish to participate in the exchange program. It covers new topics or areas of study related to Business and Supply Chain Analytics, but not presently offered in general basic courses, basic courses in science and mathematics, compulsory courses, or compulsory elective courses of the Business and Supply Chain Analytics curriculum. Topics covered are different from other BAS49x.
derived_eng_desc1: Special study in business and supply chain analytics, covering new topics.

eng_name: Special Study in Business and Supply Chain Analytics I
eng_desc: This course is intended for students who wish to participate in the exchange program. It covers new topics or areas of study related to Business and Supply Chain Analytics, but not presently offered in general basic courses, basic courses in science and mathematics, compulsory courses, or compulsory elective courses of the Business and Supply Chain Analytics curriculum. Topics covered are different from other BAS49x.
derived_eng_desc1: Special study in business and supply chain analytics, covering new topics.

eng_name: Special Study in Business and Supply Chain Analytics I
eng_desc: This course is intended for students who wish to participate in the exchange program. It covers new topics or areas of study related to Business and Supply Chain Analytics, but not presently offered in general basic courses, basic courses in science and mathematics, compulsory courses, or compulsory elective courses of the Business and Supply Chain Analytics curriculum. Topics covered are different from other BAS49x.
derived_eng_desc1: Special study in business and supply chain analytics, covering new topics.

eng_desc: This course is intended to be a hands-on forum for learning and practising skills in drafting contracts and legal documents. In particular, it explores characteristics of legal English, legal phraseology and legalese as commonly used in the legal profession and introduces basics for drafting and reviewing contracts and other legal documents, including notices, correspondence, reports, legal opinions and wills. Students will mainly learn and acquire experience through scenarios specifically prepared and adapted from real situations in the legal practice.
derived_eng_desc1: Teaches skills in drafting contracts and legal documents, focusing on legal English and practice.

eng_desc: This course is intended to deal with principles in the private international law with regard to persons or private individuals having international elements in all forms. The scope of the study embraces the classification of private individuals in an international dimension by reference to nationality and domicile, the determination of rights, duties and legal personality of persons in an international dimension, and conflict of laws rules as well as methods for the settlement of disputes of persons in an international dimension. The law on nationality, the law on conflict of laws, the law on non-nationals and relevant treaties are to be dealt with by this course.
derived_eng_desc1: Deals with principles of private international law, including conflict of laws and dispute settlement.

eng_desc: This course is intended to examine fundamental concepts in connection with the organisation of local administration and local government organisations under legislation currently in force, powers and duties of these organisations as juridical persons, in particular, the power with regard to the issuance of ordinances, the superintendence of such organisations, both in respect of their officials and action performed by their officials, financial procedures of local government organisations and oversight exercisable by the Central Administration.
derived_eng_desc1: Examines fundamental concepts of law concerning local administration and government organizations.

eng_desc: This course is intended to explore fundamental issues and current issues underlying general principles of civil law. It also provides a forum for practicing the giving of legal opinions.
derived_eng_desc1: Explores fundamental and current issues in general principles of civil law.

eng_desc: This course is intended to explore fundamental issues and current issues underlying principles of law related to personality, juristic acts and contracts, obligations, and specific contracts, including problematic issues surrounding the law of wrongful acts, management of affairs without mandate, and endue enrichment.
derived_eng_desc1: Explores fundamental and current issues in civil law, including contracts, obligations, and wrongful acts.

eng_desc: This course is intended to explore institutions of public law, the meaning, elements and forms of the state as well as legal personality and institutions of the State. The compass of the study is also extended to the meaning and need of the Rule of Law, the development and evolution of public law, the scope and peculiar nature of public law. Also embraced by this course are sources of public law and juristic methods in public law.
derived_eng_desc1: Introduces public law, state institutions, rule of law, and juristic methods.

eng_name: Introduction to Law and Legal Systems
eng_desc: This course is intended to explore the scope of legal study, interrelations among laws and other sciences. Legal systems, definition, background, and sources of law will also be examined as well as legal methods, classification of laws, and fundamental concepts of law, such as rights, duties, liabilities, scope of rights, such as abuse of rights, and principle of good faith. General principles of law enshrined in the Civil and Commercial Code Book I, such as those concerning persons, juristic acts, and property, which are fundamental to the Thai legal system are also discussed.
derived_eng_desc1: Introduces legal study, legal systems, sources of law, and fundamental legal concepts.

eng_name: Settlement of Commercial Disputes and Arbitration
eng_desc: This course is intended to give an account of the nature of commercial disputes in varying areas. For this purpose, students are introduced forms, reasons and methods in relation to settlement of commercial disputes, in particular, the settlement of disputes through arbitration. The scope of this course is also extended to legal principles, rules and regulations, arbitration institutions and international agreements of particular importance in relation to arbitration, considerations in concluding contracts, choice of law and means of dispute settlement, rules and problems encountered in litigation, recognition and enforcement of arbitral awards and foreign judgments.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers settlement of commercial disputes and arbitration, including legal principles and international agreements.

eng_name: Business for Lawyers in Sustainable Future
eng_desc: This course is intended to introduce law students to basic business concepts and practices in the changing environment. It focuses on how business operation may affect and contribute to sustainable future. Students will learn from theories and practices about related concepts such as social responsibility, ESG (Environmental, Social and Corporate Governance) framework.
derived_eng_desc1: Introduces business concepts and practices for law students, focusing on sustainability and ESG.

eng_desc: This course is intended to introduce law students to basic business terminology and concepts to prepare students to better understand a broad array of business related law courses.
derived_eng_desc1: Introduces basic business terminology and concepts for law students.

eng_desc: This course is intended to introduce law students to models and theories of business communication and negotiation. It also provides a study of the characteristics and forms of business disputes and the use of negotiation and mediation in resolving disputes, with focus on legal principles, practice, and application of specific negotiating and mediating skills.
derived_eng_desc1: Introduces business negotiation and mediation, focusing on communication, dispute resolution, and legal principles.

eng_desc: This course is intended to investigate the evolution and history of the parliamentary institution, the importance of Parliament vis-à-vis the democratic regime of government, forms of parliament in western democratic regimes, principles of independence in the operation of parliament in various jurisdictions, rules of procedure of parliament, the legal nature of rules of procedure of parliament, sittings of parliament, powers and duties of the President of the Houses and Secretary-General of each House in respect of the general administration, parliamentary officials, work systems and the operation of work of standing committees and ad hoc committees of the Houses, agenda for sittings and agenda scheduling within the Houses, and legislative procedures of the Houses. The study is based upon the comparative approach under which positions in Thailand will be compared and contrasted with those in foreign jurisdictions. Parliamentary mechanisms for scrutinizing the Executive is a matter of discussion as well.
derived_eng_desc1: Investigates the law of parliaments, parliamentary institutions, legislative procedures, and administration.

eng_desc: This course is intended to provide a study of historical backgrounds of the law of the sea, sources of the law of the sea, the legal status of waters falling within jurisdiction of the State e.g. internal waters, territorial seas and contiguous zones, exclusive economic zones, continental shelves, archipelagic waters, straits, bays as well as the legal status of waters not falling within jurisdiction of the State e.g. high seas and deep sea-beds, technical legal principles applicable to the delineation of the territorial area of the sea and the settlement of international disputes in the law of the sea.
derived_eng_desc1: Studies the law of the sea, including legal status of waters and international dispute settlement.

eng_desc: This course is intended to provide skills in the use of legal English and, to this end, concentrated upon the creation of knowledge and understanding of meanings and essential substances of legal terminologies and expressions in different areas of law, with a view to establishing a crucial foundation for reading, writing and understanding English-language legal documents as used in the pursuit of legal scholarship or in the legal profession, including legal textbooks or articles, judgments, decisions, contracts, notice and correspondence.
derived_eng_desc1: Provides skills in legal English, focusing on terminology and drafting legal documents.

eng_desc: This course looks at the duties, effects and responsibilities of committees and managers towards and on the aims of wealth creation and protecting organizational stakeholder interests. The course covers design of appraisal systems and management of different types of risks that may affect the above aims, based on development of internal organizational management systems that are both transparent and accountable.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on governance, risk management, organizational management, and stakeholder interests, core to business administration.

eng_desc: This course looks at the thinking and the concept of Microeconomics and Macroeconomics, The price mechanism, demand and supply of goods. The concepts of management economics, marketing and strategic management in order to analyse the structure, development and different environmental conditions that impact on changes in industry and competition will also are discussed. This is to be achieved by focusing on developing knowledge and understanding and analytical skills, which are the fundamentals of determining strategy within a complex and highly uncertain business environment.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers micro/macroeconomics, management, marketing, and strategic analysis for business competition.

eng_desc: This course looks into definitions and characteristics of taxation within the scope of public law. It also explores legal and economic principles concerning financial and fiscal administration directed by the government, tax systems and structures, tax policies, and the relationship between taxation and socio-economic structures.
derived_eng_desc1: Explores taxation, public law, financial administration, and tax policies, aligning with business and law.

eng_desc: This course navigates the business landscape of Thailand looking at the possibilities and potential for enterprise given Thailand's business culture of management, leadership and work, business-related legal infrastructure, taxation, human capital, domestic and established foreign markets, given resources and its technological stage. Students will therefore acquire knowledge in both the contemporary situation and a variety of practical technical skills that will assist them in a future career in entrepreneurship in Thailand. By the end of the course students will have improved their skills in critical thinking, data analysis, researching via digital means, argumentative reasoning, persuasive writing, presentation skills and rhetoric using a wide variety of media. This course introduces students to the intellectual and physical resources required for life-long learning in a wide-range of related fields. It fosters individual responsibility and initiative taking. This course allows students to design and execute their own research projects.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on the business landscape, management, legal infrastructure, and entrepreneurship in Thailand.

eng_desc: This course offers the learning that is needed to develop electronic business. Topics include: developing a strategy; business-to-consumer (B2C) and business-to-business (B2B) marketing; pricing; customer relationship management (CRM); supply chain management; bar codes and radio frequency identification (RFID) for inventory management system; planning, developing, and maintaining websites and supporting information systems; business processes; online payments and international, legal, privacy, and security issues. A unique feature is an ongoing project within the course that provides an opportunity to develop electronic commerce implementation plans.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on developing electronic business strategies, marketing, CRM, supply chain, and related legal issues.

eng_desc: This course prepares students to communicate effectively in various types of business situations. Students learn how to write professional letters and emails with an emphasis on tone, format, and formality. Students also make a resume and cover letter, and give a business style presentation. By expressing ideas in a thoughtful and professional manner, students gain important skills that are necessary for success in the business world.
derived_eng_desc1: Teaches effective communication, writing, and presentation skills essential for business success.

eng_desc: This course provide student with chances to develop their practical legal skills. Students who enroll in this course will take a traineeship programme with designated or approved governmental or private organizations for 225 hours. At the beginning of the course, an orientation programme will be arranged to provide student with necessary information and professional ethics. Each student is to submit a report of his/her training as a part of the assessment of this course.
derived_eng_desc1: Provides practical legal skills through a traineeship program in legal organizations.

eng_desc: This course provides a comparative study of corporate laws and development of commercial law in common law and civil law jurisdictions. Issues concerning the conflict of laws in this area are also attempted.
derived_eng_desc1: Compares corporate and commercial laws across different legal jurisdictions.

eng_desc: This course provides a practical forum for discussing fundamental issues and current issues in the laws on Property, Family and Succession.
derived_eng_desc1: Discusses fundamental and current issues in civil law, specifically property, family, and succession.

eng_desc: This course provides a seminal forum for discussing issues of particular importance in the constitutional law, administrative law and finance law with a view to having greater in-depth understanding in public law.
derived_eng_desc1: Discusses important issues in constitutional, administrative, and finance law within public law.

eng_desc: This course provides a study of both domestic and international aviation law and roles of international organisations pertaining to monitoring civil aviation standards. It also discusses issues in relation to freedoms of the air, open skies agreements, and environmental issues from civil aviation. International legal issues from sovereign rights over land and territorial jurisdiction of the State, such as undue forfeiture of aircraft and the commission of offences on board the aircraft are addressed.
derived_eng_desc1: Studies domestic and international aviation law, including civil aviation standards and international legal issues.

eng_desc: This course provides a study of fundamental concepts and historical backgrounds of social security law, schemes for insuring against illness, infirmity, agedness, death and unemployment. Problems, obstacles and the development of social security schemes in Thailand will be examined.
derived_eng_desc1: Studies fundamental concepts and historical backgrounds of social security law and schemes.

eng_name: Law of Public Finance and Taxation 2
eng_desc: This course provides a study of fundamental concepts in, and the evolution of, public finance and taxation law. The correlation of this course with other subjects will be canvassed in the light of public law and private law, including the correlation with other disciplines.
derived_eng_desc1: Studies fundamental concepts and evolution of public finance and taxation law.

eng_desc: This course provides a study of important offences under the Penal Code, Parts II and III.
derived_eng_desc1: Studies important offenses under the Penal Code, focusing on criminal law.

eng_desc: This course provides a study of insurance law theories, insurance business, and legal principles related to insurance under the Civil and Commercial Code, Book III, including car insurance under special legislation and the role of the public sector in supervising the insurance business.
derived_eng_desc1: Studies insurance law theories, insurance business, and legal principles under civil and commercial code.

eng_desc: This course provides a study of legal principles and practices in maritime law, including conceptual analyses and solutions to problems encountered. The scope also embraces practices in the carriage of goods by sea, principles related to charterparties, marine insurance, legal issues related to litigation, legal proceedings, competence of courts, concepts underlying practical problems and solutions to those problems.
derived_eng_desc1: Studies legal principles and practices in maritime law, including carriage of goods and marine insurance.

eng_desc: This course provides a study of legal principles related to the incorporation, powers and duties, operation and termination of partnerships and companies.
