The course also gives an account of principles related to selected specific contracts of particular importance as well as recently promulgated legislation related to certain prominent businesses.
derived_eng_desc1: Studies legal principles concerning partnerships, companies, contracts, and business-related legislation.

eng_name: Wrongful Acts, Management of Affairs Without Mandate and Undue Enrichment
eng_desc: This course provides a study of principles of civil and commercial law relating to wrongful acts, management of affairs without mandate, and undue enrichment under the Civil and Commercial Code, Book II. Other relevant laws, such as product liability law, environmental protection law, and contemporary concerns regarding the application of laws, will also be discussed.
derived_eng_desc1: Studies civil and commercial law principles related to wrongful acts, undue enrichment, and product liability.

eng_desc: This course provides a study of principles of labour law and the historical backgrounds of labour law of Thailand, contracts of employment, the law on labour relations, the law on labour protection and other related laws.
derived_eng_desc1: Studies principles of labour law, employment contracts, labour relations, and protection.

eng_desc: This course provides a study of principles of law related to partnerships and companies under the Civil and Commercial Code, Book III. The concept of public companies under the public company act as well as other business organizations are also explored
derived_eng_desc1: Studies legal principles related to partnerships, companies, and other business organizations.

eng_desc: This course provides a study of tax theories and policies. It seeks to take students through critical analyses and discussions regarding the roles of such theories and policies in selected social issues.
derived_eng_desc1: Studies tax theories and policies, analyzing their roles in selected social issues.

eng_desc: This course provides a study of the Military Penal Code, the Charter of the Military Court and martial law.
derived_eng_desc1: Studies military law, including the Military Penal Code and martial law.

eng_desc: This course provides a study of the basic concepts and fundamental principles of law on the management of debt enforcement of natural and juristic persons. The course studies the liquidation of juristic persons, debt restructuring, business reorganization, both within and outside the formal dispute settlement forums, as well as international insolvency procedures.
derived_eng_desc1: Studies insolvency law, debt enforcement, liquidation, and business reorganization procedures.

eng_desc: This course provides a study of the characteristics and forms of business disputes, and the methods and legal principles related to alternative dispute resolution, for instance, negotiation, mediation, arbitration, other alternative dispute resolutions associated with courts, and mixed resolution. In addition, the study includes designation and determination of appropriate dispute resolution forums.
derived_eng_desc1: Studies alternative dispute resolution methods like negotiation, mediation, and arbitration for business disputes.

eng_desc: This course provides a study of the concepts and principles of family and family-member relationships. It covers the legal principles enshrined in the Civil and Commercial Code, Book V, and other relevant laws.
derived_eng_desc1: Studies concepts and principles of family law and family-member relationships.

eng_desc: This course provides a study of the historical development of international law, theories in international law, sources of international law such as treaties and customary international law, general principles of international law, and acts with binding force in international law. It includes a study of the relationship between international law and municipal law, participants in international law including the state, classification of states, the rights and obligations of the state, principles concerning jurisdiction, international organizations and other forms of juridical persons in international law, and the status of individuals under international law. In addition, this course also gives an account of the consequences of the recognition of a state and the recognition of a government, the succession of rights of the state, responsibilities of the state, and diplomatic and consular relations. It also covers international law applicable to various areas, for example, international seas, rivers, canals and air space, legal relations in international economics, international law with respect to human rights, international law in connection with the environment, and the settlement of international disputes, wars and armed conflicts in international relations, and allocation of jurisdiction.
derived_eng_desc1: Studies historical development, theories, sources, and principles of public international law.

eng_desc: This course provides a study of the history and substance of the Islamic legal system, sources of Islamic law and principles enshrined in the Islamic law.
derived_eng_desc1: Studies the history, substance, sources, and principles of the Islamic legal system.

eng_desc: This course provides a study of the history of international law, principles in international law, sources of international law e.g. treaties, international customary law, general principles of international law, acts with binding force in international law, the relationship between international law and municipal law, personality in international law e.g. the State, classification of States, rights and obligations of the State, principles concerning jurisdiction, international organisations and other forms of juridical persons in international law, and the status of individuals under international law. In addition, this course also seeks to give an account of consequences of the recognition of the State and the recognition of the government, succession of rights of the State, responsibility of the State, diplomatic and consular relations, international law applicable to varying areas e.g. international seas, river, canals and air space, legal relations in international economics, international law with respect to human rights, international law in connection with the environment, settlement of international disputes, wars and armed conflicts in international relations.
derived_eng_desc1: Studies history, principles, sources, and application of public international law.

eng_name: Law of Civil Procedure Provisional Measures and Execution of Judgments
eng_desc: This course provides a study of the law of civil procedure with respect to pre-judgment provisional measures and the execution of judgments or orders under the Civil Procedure Code).
derived_eng_desc1: Studies civil procedure law, focusing on provisional measures and execution of judgments.

eng_desc: This course provides a study of the law of evidence and embraces general principles of the law of evidence and provisions embodied in the Civil Procedure Code and the Criminal Procedure Code.
derived_eng_desc1: Studies the law of evidence, including principles from civil and criminal procedure codes.

eng_desc: This course provides a study of the laws related to creating a security interest to secure performance in the forms of guarantee, mortgage, and pledge under the Civil and Commercial Code, business security agreement and project finance.
derived_eng_desc1: Studies laws related to secured transactions, including guarantee, mortgage, pledge, and project finance.

eng_desc: This course provides a study of the legal histories of interesting economic integrations. Comparative analyses of these economic blocs will also be conducted.
derived_eng_desc1: Studies legal histories and conducts comparative analyses of economic community law and integrations.

eng_desc: This course provides a study of the legal principles of monetary and financial law and the role of important international institutions, for example, the International Monetary Fund (IMF) and the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD).
derived_eng_desc1: Studies legal principles of international monetary and financial law and related institutions.

eng_desc: This course provides a study of the meaning and formation of international organisations, legal personality of international organisations, acquisition and termination of membership of an international organisation, legal consequences of resolutions of international organisations, privileges and immunities of international organisations, legal issues surrounding the United Nations and specialised agencies of the United Nations, and selected legal issues of regional international organisations.
derived_eng_desc1: Studies the law of international organizations, including their formation, legal personality, and issues.

eng_desc: This course provides a study of the principles of civil and commercial law relating to torts, management of affairs without mandate, and undue enrichment under the Civil and Commercial Code. Other relevant topics encompassed in this course are product liability law, environmental protection law, and contemporary problems regarding the application of these laws.
derived_eng_desc1: Studies principles of tort law, civil and commercial law, product liability, and environmental protection.

eng_desc: This course provides a study of the principles of labor law, the historical development of labor law in Thailand, contracts of employment, the law of labor relations, the law of labor protection and other related laws.
derived_eng_desc1: Studies principles of labor law, employment contracts, labor relations, and labor protection.

eng_desc: This course provides a study, in a comparative dimension, of concepts and principles of particular importance in the Japanese and Thai legal systems. In this connection, emphasis is placed on practice in reading, translation and drafting contracts in Japanese.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on Japanese and Thai legal systems, principles, and contract drafting practice.

eng_desc: This course provides an account of criminal procedure under the Criminal Procedure Code.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on criminal procedure and the Criminal Procedure Code.

eng_desc: This course provides an account of important rules applicable to the setting up of a law office and the administration of a law office as well as techniques in legal consultancy. The study also extends to legal advocacy, preparation of briefs and, in addition, provides practices in drafting plaints and motions, the taking of evidence. For this purpose, the practice will be based upon the moot court model, with a view to building expertise in advocacy in courts of law.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers legal consultancy, advocacy, law office administration, and practical legal skills like drafting and evidence taking.

eng_desc: This course provides an account of principles of law concerning succession under the Civil and Commercial Code, Book VI.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers principles of succession law under the Civil and Commercial Code.

eng_desc: This course provides an account of principles of law on copyright, trademark and patents.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on principles of intellectual property law, including copyright, trademark, and patents.

eng_desc: This course provides an account of the history backgrounds of the French legal system, the emergence of the French Civil and Criminal Code, important legal institutions, juristic methods, principles of law in, for example, contract, torts, property, family law, law of succession and also procedural law, for instance code of criminal procedure. Moreover, this course will overview legal institutions, and the organisation of juristic methods for French legal studies and also explore more on recent development in the French legal system. In addition, this course discovers new laws which enacted by the French parliament
derived_eng_desc1: Introduces the French legal system, its history, codes, institutions, and principles of law.

eng_desc: This course provides an account of the legal principles applicable to the operation of international business transactions. It focuses on law relating to international sales, international carriage, insurance, and payment.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers legal principles for international business transactions, including sales, carriage, insurance, and payment.

eng_desc: This course provides an further study of power and duties of associations formed by employers and employees, legal consequences of a demand of a negotiation over conditions of employment, the legal status of employment agreements, powers and duties of the Executive and the Judiciary in relation to the mediation and settlement of labour disputes, labour procedure as compared with civil procedure, and provisional measures as well as reliefs for the prevention of loss to parties to labour disputes.
derived_eng_desc1: Further study of labour law, focusing on employer/employee associations, employment agreements, and dispute resolution.

eng_desc: This course provides an in-depth study of copyright law. It includes the topics of subject matter of copyright protection, acquisition of copyright, rights of copyright owners, duration of copyright protection, copyright infringement, exceptions of copyright infringement, remedies for infringement and copyright litigation. The issues concerning neighboring rights are also discussed. Approximately two thirds of the class time will be devoted to the Thai copyright law while the remainder will be devoted to the major relevant multilateral treaties and to the laws pertaining to copyright in other countries.
derived_eng_desc1: In-depth study of copyright law, including protection, infringement, remedies, and international treaties.

eng_desc: This course provides an in-depth study of patent law. It includes the topics of subject matter of patent protection, process of patent application and registration, right of patentee, duration of patent protection, patent infringement, exceptions of patent infringement, remedies for infringement and patent litigation. Approximately two thirds of the class time will be devoted to Thai patent law while the remainder will be devoted to the major relevant multilateral treaties and to the laws pertaining to patent in other countries.
derived_eng_desc1: In-depth study of patent law, covering protection, application, infringement, and litigation.

eng_desc: This course provides an in-depth study of trademark law. It includes the topics of subject matter of trademark, process of trademark application and registration, right of registered and unregistered trademark owner, duration of trademark protection, trademark infringement, exceptions of trademark infringement, remedies for infringement and trademark litigation. Approximately two thirds of the class time will be devoted to Thai trademark law while the remainder will be devoted to the major relevant multilateral treaties and to the laws pertaining to trademark in other countries.
derived_eng_desc1: In-depth study of trademark law, including protection, application, infringement, and litigation.

eng_desc: This course provides an introduction to tax accounting concepts and methods, such as cash and accrual basis, the concepts of revenue and expense, the calculation of depreciation, the amortization of bad debt, and the valuation and pricing for tax purposes. This course also aims to cover preparing financial statements such as tax invoices.
derived_eng_desc1: Introduces tax accounting concepts, methods, financial statements, and tax invoices.

eng_name: Comparative Study of Mekong Region Legal Systems
eng_desc: This course provides an introduction to the legal systems of Cambodia, Laos, Myanmar, Thailand and Vietnam, providing a comparative perspective on the various ways that legal systems develop. Students will learn the sources of law for each country and each country's institutional framework for both the formation and implementation of law. Emphasis is on common problems affecting all these countries and different methods for solving social conflict.
derived_eng_desc1: Compares legal systems of Mekong Region countries, focusing on sources of law and institutional frameworks.

eng_desc: This course provides and introduction to the law of trusts and discussion of the fundamental principles of trusts law. Topics covered include the history, development, and uses of trusts in different legal systems, as well as the foundational principles and doctrinal debates within the law. This course takes a comparative approach, examining trusts in traditional common law jurisdictions such as England, some civil law jurisdictions, and Thailand, which has adopted a limited use of trusts in investment by way of the Trusts for Transactions in Capital Markets Act BE 2550 (2007).
derived_eng_desc1: Introduces trusts law, its principles, history, and comparative uses in different legal systems.

eng_desc: This course provides opportunities for students to practice using legal resources, analyzing legal issues and addressing legal arguments. The students will have the opportunity to equip themselves with research skills and write a research paper to prepare them for legal research in their future professional or academic career as well as their future graduate study.
derived_eng_desc1: Develops legal research skills, analyzing legal issues, and addressing legal arguments using legal resources.

eng_desc: This course provides students basic concepts of the law and regulation systems of various governing bodies that directly or indirectly apply the planning and land use control. Laws and regulations that are relevant to urban and environmental development, planning and management such as Land Subdivision Law, Building Code, Urban Planning Law, central, and local regulations serve as key topics for the course.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers planning law and regulations, including land use control, urban planning, and building codes.

eng_desc: This course provides students with an overview of corporate risk management that includes classifying, measuring and managing various types of risks. Topics include financial risk, operational risk, technological risk, sovereign risk, environmental risk, legal risk.
derived_eng_desc1: Overview of corporate risk management, covering financial, operational, technological, environmental, and legal risks.

eng_name: Laws and Standards on Occupational Safety and Working Environment
eng_desc: This course provides the development of occupational health, and safety and work environment, national and international standard, Occupational Safety, Health and Environment ACT B.E. 2554 (A.D. 2011), ministerial regulations, notification of the ministry, and other related laws including main idea implementation inspection and compliance.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers laws and standards on occupational safety, health, and working environment, including regulations and compliance.

eng_desc: This course provides: an overview and discussion of Design Thinking Principles, Service Science concepts for developing better products, services, processes, strategies, spaces, architecture, and experiences for customers-centric organization. Design Thinking helps organization to develop practical and innovative solutions for their problems. Design Thinking and Service Science are essential knowledge for transforming traditional business to human-focused. Prototype-driven. Service-oriented business. This course provides: develop a solid understanding of the fundamental concepts of Design Thinking, Service Science, „Service Dominant Logic (SDL), how to apply multi-disciplinary knowledge for service-oriented business innovation.
derived_eng_desc1: Overview of business innovation, Design Thinking, and Service Science for customer-centric and service-oriented businesses.

eng_desc: This course provides: an overview and discussion of the principles, concepts and techniques required to transform business from a traditional, functional organization to a process-centric organization. The course introduces: a systematic approach, methodology for planning, monitoring, measuring and managing organizational business process performance, redesigning, improving specific processes. The students will understand: the value and benefits of business process management, the principles of business process management, how to apply them. Business Process Model and Notation (BPMN) will be used as a standard language for process analysis and design. Process reengineering. Process improvement and process automation. Examples and exercises of process model and process management. This course includes: financial, accounting, human resource management, CRM processes, etc.
derived_eng_desc1: Overview of business process model and management, focusing on transforming organizations to process-centric structures.

eng_name: Problems in the Law of Civil Procedure
eng_desc: This course seeks to discuss vital issues of civil procedure to equip student with greater insights into the law of civil procedure, for example, the problems relevant to the procedures of Courts of first instance, the Court of Appeal and the Supreme Court, the problems regarding the enforcement of judgements, the issues relevant to petty cases, simplified procedure rules, arbitration procedures, class actions, the problems pertaining to the interactions between civil procedure and consumer case procedure as well as the issues relevant to the application of accusatorial system and inquisitorial system.
derived_eng_desc1: Discusses vital issues in civil procedure law, including court procedures, judgment enforcement, and arbitration.

eng_desc: This course seeks to examine principles of law under the land Code, law on land reform for agricultural purposes, law on land development, law on escrow account law on condominium law on state property and other related laws.
derived_eng_desc1: Examines principles of real estate law, including land code, land reform, and condominium law.

eng_desc: This course seeks to examine the funding systems and fund raising schemes of companies through issuance of securities. Embraced by the study are types of securities, issuance of securities, public offering of securities, securities businesses, unfair practices related to securities trading and business domination, measures for promoting, regulating and supervising such practices, and theories related to the protection of investors. The scope of the study is also extended to securities exchanges, securities trading centres outside securities exchanges, futures trading centres, organisations pertinent to securities and other securities businesses, and the supervision of securities and securities exchanges as well as such supervisory bodies.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on securities law, business regulation, and investor protection within commercial and legal frameworks.

eng_desc: This course seeks to examine the funding systems and fund raising schemes of companies through issuance of securities. Embraced by the study are types of securities, issuance of securities, public offering of securities, securities businesses, unfair practices related to securities trading and business domination, measures for promoting, regulating and supervising such practices, and theories related to the protection of investors. The scope of the study is also extended to securities exchanges, securities trading centres, futures trading centres, organisations pertinent to securities and other securities businesses, and the supervision of securities and securities exchanges as well as such supervisory bodies.
derived_eng_desc1: Examines securities law, company funding, business practices, and investor protection within legal and commercial contexts.

eng_desc: This course seeks to explore issues of importance in business law in the light of changes or the development in domestic and international economic systems, with particular emphasis on the analysis of problems and possible solutions to problems encountered e.g. issues related to joint ventures, franchising, leasing, licensing and technological transfer agreements.
derived_eng_desc1: Explores issues in business law, focusing on economic systems, joint ventures, franchising, and commercial agreements.

eng_desc: This course seeks to grasp the historical backgrounds and the general nature of the Administration and Administrative Law, sources of administrative law in varying legal systems, fundamental concepts, application and interpretation of administrative law, the organisation of public administration, the formation and legal status of juridical personality in public law, theories concerning administrative action, rules with regard to administrative procedure, administrative contracts and concepts underlying and the necessities for mechanisms for scrutinizing state administrative bodies.
derived_eng_desc1: Studies administrative law, public administration, legal systems, and state administrative bodies and procedures.

eng_desc: This course seeks to provide students with fundamental knowledge in relation to the protection of “creation of the mind of human-beings”, justifications and needs for the protection and benefits to be derived from the protection of this kind of property, the enforcement of rights flowing from the protection. For this purpose, examples will be drawn from existing intellectual property law, in particular, such legislation most central to the daily life of students e.g. the copyright law and the trademarks law.
derived_eng_desc1: Introduces intellectual property law, focusing on protection of creations, copyright, and trademarks.

eng_name: Law and the Development of the Creative Economy
eng_desc: This course seeks to study a post-industrial economy namely economics of innovation, the sharing economy and the creative economy which affect the proper application of laws. For this purpose, the scope of this subject includes the definition and common characteristics of the creative economy, features of goods and services, laws protecting creative products which are different from the existing legislations (Intellectual Property and Information Technology Law) as well as the activities concerning the creative economy.
derived_eng_desc1: Studies law's application to the creative economy, innovation, intellectual property, and information technology law.

eng_desc: This course seeks to study the history of the Anglo-American legal system and explores its legal doctrines embodied in common law, equity, statutes and local customs. Emphasis is on a detailed survey of juristic methods used in different types of law. In this connection, relevant theories are to be canvassed at a philosophical level. The scope of the study is also extended to the exploration of the judicial practice in juristic methods, with a view to giving a proper insight into the Anglo-American legal system.
derived_eng_desc1: Introduces the Anglo-American legal system, common law, statutes, and judicial practices.

eng_desc: This course seeks to take students through the history and evolution of the European Union (EU), objectives and sources of EU law, the structural characteristics of the European Union, legal systems of the European Union, the structure, powers, duties and operations of the European Union, namely, the European Commission, the European Council and the European Court of Justice. The study also embraces economic law of the European Union e.g. the single market law, the relations between the European Union and Member States and between the European Union and other States or other international organisations.
derived_eng_desc1: Studies European Union law, its legal systems, institutions, and economic law like the single market.

eng_desc: This course studies Law on Business Reorganization as a tool to resolve the problems relevant to debtors who are insolvent or unable to pay their debts with an aim both to prevent discontinuations of businesses of debtors who have capacity to continue their business operations and to protect equal rights to repayments of all creditors based on the principles of business reorganization according to Bankruptcy Law. This course studies legal proceedings of Law on Business Reorganization and as functions, authorities, rights and duties of relevant actors.
derived_eng_desc1: Studies business reorganization law, focusing on insolvency, debtor-creditor relations, and bankruptcy proceedings.

eng_desc: This course studies bankruptcy law as a tool to allocate assets of insolvent debtors to fulfill repayments to relevant creditor which requires a special legal mechanisms based on equal rights to repayments of all creditors according to Bankruptcy Law. Fundamental concepts, principles, legal procedures of bankruptcy law as well as functions, authorities, rights and duties of relevant actors are addressed in the course.
derived_eng_desc1: Studies bankruptcy law, focusing on insolvent debtors, creditor rights, and legal procedures.

eng_desc: This course studies international law governing foreign investment, particularly investment treaties concluded to encourage and regulate foreign investment, as well as investment treaty arbitration and awards concerning the settlement of investment disputes resulting from the application of these treaties.
derived_eng_desc1: Studies international law governing foreign investment, treaties, arbitration, and dispute settlement.

eng_desc: This course studies missions and functions of law-making bodies, as well as principles and techniques employed in law-making processes. It also discusses interactions between law drafting and legislative processes. Specifically, this course discussed the missions and functions as well as legislative processes and legislation commencement processes of National Assembly through the relevant law, regulations as well as law-making theories.
derived_eng_desc1: Studies law drafting, legislative processes, law-making bodies, and relevant theories and regulations.

eng_name: Taxation of International Trade and Investment
eng_desc: This course studies the connections between international trade, investment, and tax laws. For instance, matters concerning customs law, such as important characteristics, aims, contexts, and the implementation of the Harmonized System, will be discussed. In accordance with investment promotion legislation, special economic zones, and free trade agreements, the course will also examine tax privileges as a strategy for promoting investment and stimulating economic growth. Lastly, the course will review key tax disputes in the international trade and investment field.
derived_eng_desc1: Studies taxation of international trade and investment, including customs law and tax privileges.

eng_desc: This course studies the development of International Humanitarian Law (IHL) and its present relevance. Principles and rules relating to the protection of individuals during armed conflict, as well as rules relating to the means and methods of warfare, including weapons issues. The relevant international legal framework established for implementation and enforcement of IHL, and the various actors involved, including UN and ICRC. The relationship of IHL to other areas of law such as international human rights, the law governing use of force and international criminal law.
derived_eng_desc1: Studies International Humanitarian Law, protection during armed conflict, and international legal frameworks.

eng_desc: This course studies the objectives of auditing, auditing standards, professional ethics, the audit process, starting with planning the audit, obtaining audit evidence, recording and summarizing the audit results and preparing the audit reports.
derived_eng_desc1: Studies auditing objectives, standards, ethics, the audit process, and preparing audit reports.

eng_name: Seminar in Business Policy and Strategy
eng_desc: This course studies the principles and processes involved in developing, determining and altering business policies and strategies by integrating abilities in different business roles in order to build competitive advantage. The focus will be on learning through exchange of opinions, case studies and practice via an enterprise modeling programme.
derived_eng_desc1: Studies business policy and strategy development, competitive advantage, and enterprise modeling.

eng_desc: This course studies the relationship between innovation and technology that influences laws, rules, policy, and regulation through case studies, problems, challenges. Also, it explores an appropriate regulatory framework, including self-regulation, co-regulation, and applying regulatory tools in the form of regulatory sandbox. Some specific issues that would be discussed comprise law and digital economy, law and artificial intelligence, laws and digital asset, laws and blockchain technology (smart contract and decentralized autonomous organisations, intellectual property and legal rights in metaverse, competitiveness of digital businesses, laws and innovative banking and finance (open banking, open finance, virtual bank), Regtech, and opportunities and risks.
derived_eng_desc1: Studies law, innovation, and technology, covering digital economy, AI, blockchain, and financial regulations.

eng_desc: This course studies theories of criminal law and those of criminalization with the purpose to equip students with understandings towards philosophies, legal rationales as development of such theories in hope that this will provide the foundation for students to evaluate contents of current criminal law and offer legal opinions on the modifications and interpretations of current criminal law.
derived_eng_desc1: Studies criminal law theories, criminalization, legal rationales, and interpretations of current criminal law.

eng_desc: This course studies theories relevant to the separation between private property and state property, the special legal characters of state properties, law relevant to administration and utilization of state property as well other legal issues relevant to state property.
derived_eng_desc1: Studies law on state property, its administration, utilization, and legal issues.

eng_desc: This course takes students through the administration of criminal justice at stages involving the police. This embraces the conduct of investigations and inquiries with regard to the commission of criminal offences. Constitutional rights of the alleged offenders will also be grasped.
derived_eng_desc1: Studies law on criminal investigation, criminal justice administration, and constitutional rights of offenders.

eng_desc: This course takes the form of seminars. For this purpose, topics of seminars vary as appropriate, with particular emphasis on one or more selected areas of law e.g. the trade secret protection, plant varieties protection, geographical indications protection and the protection of topographies of integrated circuits. International agreements related to intellectual property will also be discussed.
derived_eng_desc1: Seminar on intellectual property law, covering trade secrets, plant varieties, and international agreements.

eng_desc: This course will cover an in-depth examination of accounting treatment for Insurance, Agriculture, Petroleum, Hotel, Bank, and other specific industries.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers accounting treatment for specific industries like insurance, agriculture, petroleum, and banking.

eng_desc: This course will discuss juristic acts, general principles of contracts, legal capacity of persons, legal effects of voidable and void acts as stipulated in the Civil and Commercial Code, fundamental doctrines of contracts as appeared in unfair contract terms law, consumer protection law, electronic transaction law, or other specific laws. Attention will also be paid to contemporary problems in contract laws.
derived_eng_desc1: Discusses juristic acts, contract principles, legal capacity, and various contract-related laws.

eng_name: International Aspects of Consumption Tax Law
eng_desc: This course will examine the consumption taxes, primarily the value-added tax (VAT) and excise tax, that influence international trade and investment decisions. The origins, principles, and application of these taxes under Thai law, including the registration procedure, compliance requirements, and the calculation and payment of these taxes. Their effects on businesses and consumers will also be discussed. In addition, the course will discuss recent developments and trends in VAT and excise tax, as well as potential future modifications to these taxes.
derived_eng_desc1: Examines international consumption tax law, VAT, excise tax, and their impact on trade and investment.

eng_desc: This course will give students an overview of the operation of new media and communications services under Australian law, examining both the legal requirements and the policy reasoning behind the way in which media and communications are regulated. It will cover five broad areas: 1. How laws are made, changed, interpreted and enforced, with cybercrime among the examples 2. Laws governing licensing, ownership and control of telecommunications, radiocommunications and broadcasting enterprises, and whether these laws are appropriate and effective to deal with new technologies and services; 3. Electronic commerce and what it means for business, consumers and the community; 4. Restrictions on media and online content, including classification and censorship, and regulation of content; and 5. Protecting intellectual property and reputation, covering copyright, trademarks, and defamation.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers Australian law, media regulation, cybercrime, electronic commerce, and intellectual property in the information age.

eng_desc: This course will have the same instruction methods as Business Communication in German 3, with practice in writing business documents, conversation using business related vocabulary and studying and understanding the cultural context of business contact.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on business communication in German, including business documents, vocabulary, and cultural context.

eng_name: Extended Business and Supply Chain Analytics Training
eng_desc: This extended Business and Supply Chain Analytics Training provides students with intensive on-the-job training at selected industrial or service organizations. The training period must not be less than 16 weeks (640 hours). This intensive training enables students to work with company personnel to solve real problems, not simulated ones. Students gain hands-on experience on how various modern technologies are applied to manage facilities and systems. Moreover, they will learn how to collaborate with colleagues, coordinate project activities, and develop self-responsibility. In addition to a designated supervisor in the company, a faculty member is assigned to co-supervise a student's training program. An approved industrial project is expected to be carried out by the student. At the end of the training period, the student must give an oral presentation of his/her work and submit a written report of the assigned project to the company and the Business and Supply Chain Analytics Program.
derived_eng_desc1: Provides intensive on-the-job training in business and supply chain analytics within industrial or service organizations.

eng_name: Leaderships for Social Innovation and Social Entrepreneurship
eng_desc: This foundation course is intended to provide the students with a body of knowledge in this field of study e.g., different styles of leadership, leadership and vision as well as effective and transformative leaders, and a body of practice e.g., negotiation & confliction resolution and leading against the headwind. By blending together the two bodies along with a series of case studies that they will work on throughout the course, the students will be well equipped with an ability to comprehend, critically examine and grapple with leadership's issues. Additionally, some contemporary issues in leadership e.g., legitimacy and woman & leadership are also part of a classes' discussions.
derived_eng_desc1: Provides knowledge and practice in leadership for social innovation and social entrepreneurship, including negotiation and conflict resolution.

eng_desc: This is a compulsory module for Mechanical Engineering students. Studentsfrom other courses and faculties, seeking a good understanding of a wide range ofmanagement topics, will find this module to be useful.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on a wide range of management topics, relevant for engineering students.

eng_desc: This module introduces a diverse set of topics that a graduate engineer islikely to encounter upon entering employment. This will equip them with the knowledgeto be able to write and assess rudimentary business plans and make informed decisionsabout product and business development. It includes various models, tools and conceptsthat are common within the business community including: Belbin’s model of teamformation, the appropriate use of PEST and SWOT analysis, the basics of marketing, theproduct life cycle, technology audits, sources of finance, intellectual property, ethics andproduct design. The generation of an idea for a new product and its development into aBusiness Plan serves as both the primary means of assessment and a way of discussing theabove topics in a meaningful context.
derived_eng_desc1: Introduces business planning, marketing, finance, and intellectual property for engineers, focusing on product development.

eng_desc: This module introduces a diverse set of topics that a professional graduate engineer is likely to encounter upon entering employment in the modern sustainable, risk conscious, commercial socio-economic environment Particular topics include: Company and project management dynamics how businesses operate, projects are managed including quantitative considerations and how decisions are made in order to achieve objectives Awareness of relevant legal requirements governing engineering activities, including personnel, health & safety, contracts, intellectual property rights, product safety and liability issues Nurturing technology - how new technology is adopted by industry Professional conduct and ethical issues
derived_eng_desc1: Covers company and project management, legal requirements, intellectual property, and ethical issues for engineers.

eng_desc: This module introduces students to concepts and methods relevant to engineering management, with an emphasis on the commercial engineering context. Topics include introductions to the following: impact of digitisation and automation, operations planning and control, operations management, financial planning, financial accounting, financial analysis, innovation and new technology, quality management, marketing, new business formation, business models, the lean organisation, management of people, and the foundations of contract Law.
derived_eng_desc1: Introduces concepts and methods relevant to engineering management, including operations, finance, marketing, and law.

eng_desc: This module introduces students to modern management methods relevant to the running of a company. Topics include an introduction to basic economics, the essential requirements and aims of a business, preparing a business plan, accounting, the interpretation of accounts, programme management, the essentials of lean manufacture and the management of innovation.
derived_eng_desc1: Introduces modern management methods for running a company, including business planning, accounting, and innovation.

eng_desc: This module introduces students to modern management methods relevantto the running of a company. Topics include an introduction to basic economics, theessential requirements and aims of a business, preparing a business plan, accounting, theinterpretation of accounts, programme management, the essentials of “lean” manufactureand the management of innovation.
derived_eng_desc1: Introduces modern management methods for running a company, including business planning, accounting, and innovation.

eng_desc: This module is designed to focus on the strategic and operational aspects of marketing management. It will examine: understanding the marketing concept; the role of marketing within business and its contribution to business performance and enhancing value; developing marketing strategy; segmentation, targeting and positioning; managing the marketing mix; and planning and implementation.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on strategic and operational aspects of marketing management, including strategy, segmentation, and marketing mix.

eng_desc: This module studies about the system of public law that is interlinked with politics with coverage over both its development in Thailand and worldwide. In particular, this module gives special emphasis to the interaction that the legal system has with the overall government and politics of Thailand, the jurisdiction and process of law that affects governmental implementation at the levels of the administrative structure of the bureaucracy and its administrative process as provided by the constitution as well as to the study of the legal state, the process involved in the separation of powers, the checks and balances needed to circumscribe the exercise of state power including the issue of rights and the political participation of citizens.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on public law, legal systems, government, and politics, strongly aligning with law and administration.

eng_desc: This module will introduce students to the use of accounting information for managerial planning, decision-making, and control within an organisation.
derived_eng_desc1: Introduces accounting information for managerial planning, decision-making, and control, fitting business and administration.

eng_desc: This seminar analyses public financial policy, the role of government in the economic system, government mechanisms and tools and financial institutions, as well as studies the financial system which ties in with the taxation system, government income and expenditure management and incurment of public debt which impacts on the public.
derived_eng_desc1: Analyzes public financial policy, government's economic role, taxation, and public debt, fitting business and administration.

eng_name: Seminar on Strategic Human Resource Management
eng_desc: This seminar focuses on contemporary issues in strategic human capital management (SHCM), human capital management and development transformation, the impacts and trends in human capital management in public and private sectors. The focus also includes the changing perspectives on HR roles for proactive and preemtive actions and the networks in SHCM.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on strategic human resource management, human capital, and HR roles, aligning with business and administration.

eng_desc: This seminar involves the exchange of ideas on various contemporary topics in the field of public administration both nationally and internationally, as well as other issues related to public administration as agreed for discussion by the instructor and students.
derived_eng_desc1: Involves contemporary topics in public administration, clearly fitting business, administration, and law.

eng_name: Seminar of Public Enterprises on Management
eng_desc: This seminar looks at the background, form, status, organisation, structure, personnel management, financial management, the relationship between state bodies and state enterprises as well as the relationship of state enterprises with governmental bodies and control by government. The seminar considers the political, economic and social connections that affect government objectives and policy, the debate to establish standards by which to measure results and the role of state enterprises in national planning and development.
derived_eng_desc1: Examines management, organization, and financial aspects of public enterprises, aligning with business and administration.

eng_desc: This seminar series allows students to explore the business landscape further and microeconomics in the Thai context, selected according to the specialization of the lecturer and the student's own interest. By the end of the course students will have improved their skills in researching their own topics of interest, researching via digital means, quantitative data analysis, critical thinking, argumentative reasoning, persuasive writing, presentation skills and rhetoric using a wide variety of media.
derived_eng_desc1: Explores the business landscape and microeconomics in Thailand, aligning with business and administration.

eng_desc: Time Value of Money; Continuous Payment; Installments, Estimated Rate of Interest; Depreciation, Cost of Capital; Capital Budgeting; Fund Analysis; Reinvestment Analysis Financial Immunity; Other Interesting Topic.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers quantitative analysis in finance, including time value of money, capital budgeting, and fund analysis, aligning with business.

eng_desc: To learn the alternatives and process of investment in financial market, stock investment foundations started from return, risk, tax on investment as well as stock analysis, trade stocks method and the rights of shareholders in order to prepare before making investment decisions. To learn investment foundation in mutual fund, mutual fund selection techniques and DCA (Dollar Cost Averaging) regular investment in stocks and funds, suitable portfolio management process and learn the important factors that will make investors not successful in investing and mindset guidelines in order to create long-term investment success.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on investment, financial markets, stock analysis, and portfolio management, aligning with finance.

eng_desc: To learn the foundations, principles, importance and guidelines of financial planning for life goals, the uses of financial instruments, together with self-discovery techniques, financial planning techniques including how to earn, collect, use and invest money, savings allocation and DCA investment techniques, debt management techniques, savings increase techniques, personal income tax saving planning techniques as well as the principles and importance of the Sufficiency Economy Philosophy in Thai society in order to be applied in living.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on financial planning, investment, debt management, and personal finance, aligning with business/finance.

eng_desc: To learn the preparation guideline before trading stocks online, the uses of stock and derivatives trading program like Settrade Streaming to be investment helper. To learn the analytical principles of fundamental factors of the economy, industries and companies, reading and interpreting key information in financial statements techniques along with including sustainable investment (ESG) ideas and alternatives. To learn the investment foundation in different types of derivatives both futures and options together with trading mechanism of the derivatives market, collateral, investment strategies and cautions of investment in derivatives. To learn the basics of investment in bonds including return, risk, tax on investment as well as price analysis and bonds trading process in order to prepare before making investment decisions and learn investment foundations in DW (Derivative Warrant), price action mechanism and investment selection method and investment strategy in DW.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on stock market investment, derivatives, bonds, and financial analysis, aligning with finance.

eng_desc: To learn through individual or group practices by working together with an adviser or under supervision of an advisor in order to create a business with innovation with 2 main results, which are, 1) able to raise funds from state agencies, private sectors or international agencies and 2) able to make the substantial income approved by advisor that the business can continuously generate income in the future. However, an instructor must be qualified according to the criteria set by the University and register in“ Learning through Practices and Experiences Course Instructor Lists” of University's Academic Division and the advisor must be approved by the instructor or be the instructor himself.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on creating and managing a startup business with innovation, aligning with business.

eng_desc: To study administrative and management concepts and methods, focusing on building quality service and management in public sector, E-Government concepts in the digital age, as well as the application of modern administrative tools to public administration. To understand the interactions and relationships between technology, innovation, and public management information systems. Study the role and influence of technology and innovation in public administration by learning from both public and private organizations case studies in Thailand and abroad.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on administrative and management concepts, public administration, and E-Government.

eng_desc: To study general aspects of law as correct patterns of human conduct in society. To equip learners with basic principles of public law (rules of law), and its values which are associated with citizens' moral core. To provide basic knowledge in public law and private law, involving the issues of rights and duties, dispute settlement, Thai Justice procedures, the usage and interpretation of law principles, with an emphasis on case studies in our daily lives.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on general aspects of law, public and private law, and legal principles.

eng_desc: To study theories, concepts and principles of sport marketing, analyzing environmental factors influencing sport marketing, studying consumers' behavior, applying market mix for formulating strategies and creating sport marketing plans.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on theories and principles of sport marketing, consumer behavior, and marketing strategies.

eng_desc: To understand the role of design, basic business planning and developing strategies. analyzing styles to develop products to meet consumers requirement. Study consumer's behavior through the product development process. Understanding the different strategies in branding and administration. Conducting and presenting product to the market, communicating, and conveying the image of product and organization, via various channels including digital platforms.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on business planning, strategies, branding, and marketing for design products.

eng_desc: Tools and techniques applicable for cost analysis and control. Financial analysis of the accounting system. Standard costs. Variance analysis. Cost-volume-profit relationships. Cost estimation. Utilization of accounting data for control of operations.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on industrial cost analysis, control, financial analysis, and accounting data utilization.

eng_desc: Topics and various strategies related to building, measuring, and managing a brand. Direct and indirect measures of brand equity. Structures of desired brand knowledge. Choice of brand elements. Development of supporting marketing programs and management of brands over time.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on strategic brand management, including building, measuring, and managing brands and marketing programs.

eng_name: Special Topics in Business and Supply Chain Analytics
eng_desc: Topics related to Business and Supply Chain Analytics, but not presently offered as either a required or technical elective.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on business and supply chain analytics.

eng_desc: Transformation of marketing; digital channels for reaching target customers; successful management strategies for customer engagement; planning and execution of digital marketing strategies; the future of digital marketing.
derived_eng_desc1: Clearly about strategic and digital marketing.

eng_desc: Types and application of online data; online advertising and marketing creativity; online advertising effectiveness evaluation.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on online advertising and marketing.

eng_desc: Understand and be able to find cash flow, discount rate, present value, future value, rate of return, depreciation, cost and benefit to be able to choose appropriate methods to assess the feasibility of the project and compare projects to select a project that is suitable for the objectives.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on financial and economic analysis methods to assess project feasibility and compare investment options.

eng_desc: Understanding in strategic management for information technology and data innovation; national and overseas case studies; concepts for application in strategic development process and evaluations, and data science insights as management tools.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on strategic management, applying information technology, data innovation, and data science insights as management tools.

eng_desc: Understanding of business value chains and key stakeholders of business in various industries, Revenue generating models, Financial reporting of businesses in various industries: Manufacturing, Merchandising, Service, and others, Analysis of financial information of businesses in various industries.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on business value chains, revenue models, financial reporting, and financial information analysis across industries.

eng_name: Accounting and Financial Information for Decision Making
eng_desc: Understanding of theory and application for accounting and finance in innovative business and industry to achieve appropriate decision making that meets physical, economical, cultural, sociological conditions.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on accounting and finance theory and application for decision-making in innovative business and industry.

eng_desc: Understanding the role and significance of human resource management. Comprehensive review of key human resource management concepts, processes, techniques, and issues including human resource planning, job analysis and design, recruitment and selection, compensation and benefits, training and development, performance and evaluation etc. Critically understanding the application of human resource management concepts and principles through contemporary human resource management cases in both state and private sectors.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers human resource management concepts, processes, techniques, including planning, recruitment, compensation, and performance evaluation.

eng_desc: Usage of a customer database to analyze customer information, to help create strategies for marketing. Application of marketing schemes aimed at consumers, using digital channels from general advertising to closing a sale. Introduction of direct, database, and digital marketing. Using direct and database marketing to analyze market situation. Setting objectives and strategies within direct and database marketing. Creating segmentation using database, direct, and database marketing. Implementation and control. Introduction to digital marketing technology: Internet, Social media, Customer databases. Information systems such as CRM and Demand Generation Systems.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on digital marketing strategies, customer databases, and digital channels for sales.

eng_desc: Use of cost information for planning, controlling under certainty and uncertainty events, cost behavior, cost estimation, cost-volume-profit analysis, differential cost analysis for short-term decision making, cost of quality, budgeting system, profit variance analysis, responsibility accounting, performance measurement of units in organization, transfer pricing, and capital budgeting.
derived_eng_desc1: Uses cost information for planning, control, decision-making, and performance measurement.

eng_desc: Using Digital strategies in applied ways; focusing on real world issues from both advertising and journalistic points of view. Strategic approaches for digital media projects from digital marketing & storytelling to measurable techniques.
derived_eng_desc1: Applies digital strategies to advertising, marketing, and storytelling for measurable results.

eng_desc: Value creation using advanced financial management strategies and tactics of both financing and investing activities; lectures and case studies.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on advanced financial management strategies for value creation and investment.

eng_desc: Various aspects in financial institutions management especially commercial banks, risk management, capital and liquidity management, asset and liabilities management, profit and cost analysis, stability and investment strategies analysis, principles of credit management, regulation and compliance.
derived_eng_desc1: Manages financial institutions, focusing on risk, capital, liquidity, and credit management.

eng_desc: Various financial tools used in financial analysis for performance evaluations of firm strategies based on profitability relative to risks, applications of financial analysis for better prediction of future cash flows for valuation and credit analysis
derived_eng_desc1: Uses financial tools for performance evaluation, cash flow prediction, and credit analysis.

eng_desc: Various tools and techniques used in financial viability study; principles of and practice in developing business plans, feasibility studies of projects including new projects, expansions, non-current-asset replacements, project delays, and terminations of projects; real options and evaluations of long-term investments, a group project on a business feasibility study.
derived_eng_desc1: Teaches financial viability tools, business plan development, and project feasibility studies.

eng_desc: Wellness business integrating local wisdom into wellness products and services; SDG (Sustainable Development Goals) product development; wellness community
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on wellness business entrepreneurship, integrating local wisdom into products and services, and SDG product development.

eng_desc: White collar crime is a global phenomenon and can bring adverse consequences far worse than those harms caused by street crimes. Not only are companies and participants in business affected by white collar crime but states and individuals are set back both directly and indirectly by this branch of offences. This course covers how and why companies commit such offences and how they can be criminally liable. Students will explore how states, including but not limited to Thailand, prevent, detect, and suppress this kind of activities conducted by business organizations and their executives.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers business crime, white collar crime, corporate criminal liability, and state strategies for prevention and suppression.

eng_desc: Work culture, etiquette for work in a Japanese organization or with Japanese people; to prepare for internships and future a workplace in Japanese-based context.
derived_eng_desc1: Prepares students for internships and workplaces by teaching Japanese business culture, work etiquette, and organizational practices.

eng_desc: Workshop: Concept discussion and operation guideline from qualifiers in the content of management science related to business sectors in production logistics and other service sectors by using data or case studies from real problems including, the integration of technology and management.
derived_eng_desc1: Applies management mathematics and science concepts to business sectors, production logistics, and service operations using real-world case studies.

eng_name: Writing and Presenting for Communication Administration
eng_desc: Writing for business purposes, both internal and external: bidding documents, project proposals, business reports, and organizational overviews.
derived_eng_desc1: Teaches writing and presentation skills for communication administration, focusing on business documents like proposals and reports.

eng_desc: Writing skill for business purposes, writing resumes, meeting reports, daily reports, and business emails.
derived_eng_desc1: Develops Korean writing skills for business purposes, including resumes, meeting reports, and business emails.

eng_desc: meaning and significance communication element Communication for management in various forms, communication in crisis situations. writing, speaking, listening, reading, communication skills, nonverbal and verbal skills Communication Skills for Public Relations Communication skills for human relations corporate communication.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on communication skills essential for management, corporate settings, and public relations within organizations.

eng_desc: Applications of organisms and their products, technologies, and philosophy of sufficiency economy in agriculture, industry, medicine, environment and bioinformatics for prosperity and sustainability of communities (intensive case studies and field trips).
derived_eng_desc1: Covers applications of organisms and their products in agriculture, industry, medicine, environment, and bioinformatics.

eng_desc: National or International academic presentations in Biotechnology such as research article writing and submission, patent or pretty patent application (invention contests, poster or oral presentation in academic conferences, publication or manuscript submission in scientific journals, notification number or application number of patent or pretty patent, or start up participation can be used. Accreditation decision on credit transfer is taken by Department committee).
derived_eng_desc1: Develops scientific communication skills in biotechnology, including research article writing, patent applications, and academic presentations.

eng_desc: A study and analysis of information emphasizing quantitative and spatial data with tools such as models, graphs, satellite images etc.
derived_eng_desc1: Studies quantitative and spatial data analysis using various tools for sustainability applications.

eng_desc: A summer training in an appropriate organization or a factory approved by the Physics department. A minimum of 180 hours is required for each student in the training. Students will participate in relevant practical works and gain hands on experiences in real situations. Assessment : each student is required to submit a written report on the acquired training and gives an oral presentation. Grades : S or U.
derived_eng_desc1: A summer training approved by the Physics department, implying practical experience in natural sciences.

Basics of pattern recognition for data science include least squares methods, Gaussian distributions, linear classification, linear regression, maximum likelihood, exponential family distributions, Bayesian networks, Bayesian inference, mixture models, the EM algorithm, graphical models, hidden Markov models, and kernel methods. Feature selection methods.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers data science methods for signal processing, pattern recognition, and machine learning algorithms.

eng_desc: A basic of quantum computer, qubits and quantum gates, quantum circuits, quantum Fourier transform and its applications, quantum algorithms, quantum optimization, error correction and error mitigation, quantum cryptography.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers the fundamentals of quantum computing, algorithms, and related digital technologies.

eng_desc: A brief history of Al; the fundamentals of Al and Al tools associated with everyday life; data collection and Al development; application of Al techniques for social good for instances, data analytics and predictoin of social, agricultural, and environmental issues; data visualization; effects of Al operation; examples of using Al as case studies.
derived_eng_desc1: Explores AI fundamentals, development, and applications for social, agricultural, and environmental issues.

eng_desc: A brief introduction to digital logic. Implementation of arithmetic logic unit. Binary numbers. Representation of negative numbers in a computer. Floating-point numbers. Basic machine instructions for a RISC-type computer. Assembly language programming. Implementations of basic computer under various clocking assumptions. Pipelining. Memory hierarchy: caches and virtual memory. Brief survey of input/output issues.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers the fundamental design and components of computer systems and architecture.

eng_desc: A broad introduction to machine learning and statistical pattern recognition. Topics include supervised learning, support vector machines, deep learning, convolutional neural network. Application in energy management.
derived_eng_desc1: Introduces machine learning, deep learning, and AI applications, including energy management.

eng_desc: A cloud application, or cloud app, is a software program where cloud-based and local components work together. Cloud-based Application Development is a project based learning where students will learn the latest cloud computing technologies and integrate the technologies for a software or an app., Introduction to cloud based technology, latest cloud technology, cloud storage, cloud server, cloud API, cloud API consumption, cloud-based authentication, data transfer security.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on developing software applications using cloud computing technologies and services.

eng_desc: A continuation of preparation for Co-Operative Education in Computer Engineering by working in companies or industries related to computer engineering for at least 560 hours under supervision of industrial supervisors and the faculty staffs. Students are required to submit a complete summary report and give an oral presentation.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on computer engineering, involving computing systems and digital technologies in industry.

eng_desc: A primer on Web and data technologies: HTML, XML and JSON, XPath, HTTP, AJAX. Scraping the web: retrieval scenarios, extraction strategies. Statistical text processing: processing textual data, supervised learning techniques, unsupervised learning techniques. Managing data projects. Hand-on experience using case studies.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers web and data technologies, text processing, and machine learning techniques, core to ICT.

eng_desc: A subfield of artificial intelligence and computational linguistics. Topics include the problems of automated generation and understanding of natural human languages. Techniques emerged in statistical methods for language technologies and natural language processing (NLP) are introduced. Topics include the source-channel paradigm from information theory, predictive language models, hidden Markov models, the EM algorithm, maximum entropy methods, and classification and regression techniques.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on artificial intelligence, computational linguistics, and statistical natural language processing techniques.

eng_desc: Advanced database management system design principles and techniques. Topics may be selected from: access methods, query processing and optimization, transaction management: concurrency control, recovery, and data security; distributed database systems: concepts, design and transaction management, and introduction to object-oriented database systems.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on advanced database management system design, query processing, and distributed databases, aligning with ICT.

eng_desc: Advanced knowledge and hands-on experience in computer communications and networking, basic router, switch, and end-host configurations, internet protocol version 6 (Ipv6). IP addressing, network address translation (NAT), dynamic host configuration protocol (DHCP), switched networks, virtual LAN (VLAN), inter VLAN routing, routing protocols, basic network security, access control List (ACL).
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on advanced computer networking, including router/switch configurations, IP addressing, and network security.

eng_desc: Advanced relational database design; data warehouse modeling, using Microsoft Power BI for extracting, transforming, and loading process (ETL process) to prepare data model for planning and decision making reports; physical database design; SQL statements and functions for database control; database management with modern database management system (Oracle Database); Cloud database management; and NoSQL database model.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on advanced database management, including relational, cloud, and NoSQL databases, aligning with ICT.

eng_desc: Advanced routing and switching concepts and techniques. Security issues. VLANs. Inter- VLANs routing. Spanning Tree Protocol (STP). Etherchannel. Dynamic routing concepts and protocols. RIP. OSPF. BGP. LAN security concepts. Switch security configuration. Port Security. Firewalls. Ensuring network availability. SNMP. Network device logs. Organizational and physical security concepts. Explaining disaster recovery and high availability concepts. Applying network hardening techniques. Supporting and troubleshooting secure networks.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on advanced IP networking, routing, switching, and network security concepts and techniques.

eng_desc: Algorithm Complexity Analysis. Simple Sorting Algorithms: Bubble, Selection, and Insert Sorts. Abstract Data Types. Searching Techniques: Linear and Binary Searches. Data Structure Design. Dictionaries. Stacks. Queues. Linked Lists. Binary Search Trees. Recursions.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers algorithm complexity, sorting, searching, data structures, and abstract data types in computer science.

eng_desc: Algorithm Design & Flowcharts. Problem Solving with Object-Oriented Concepts. Introduction to Object-Oriented Programming Languages and Tools. Data Types. Variables and Constants. Expressions and Operators. Objects, Classes & Methods. Strings. Static Variables & Static Methods. Control Structures: Selection and Iteration. Inheritance. Polymorphism. Abstract Classes & Interfaces. Arrays. Array Lists. Exception Handling. Files.

eng_name: Problem Solving Basics and Computer Programming

eng_desc: Algorithmic problem solving. Structural design and programming. Variables. Data types. Control structures. Functions and parameter passing. Recursive functions. Testing and debugging. Security issues related to programming.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on algorithmic problem solving, programming fundamentals, data types, control structures, and debugging.

eng_desc: Algorithms for supervised learning, including classification(e.g., decision tree, support vector machines, and artificial neural networks) and regression (e.g., linear regression and nonlinear regression). eng_desc: An importance of digital technology, information technology, information and information management; structure of data, design and development of information system management; innovative technology in information management.

eng_desc: An introduction to the engineering of computer software emphasizing modern software engineering principles: object-oriented design, decomposition,encapsulation, abstraction, and testing.

eng_desc: An overview of networking and internetworking technologies. Open Systems Interconnect (OSI) reference model. Internet Protocol suite. Standards. Design concepts of protocols. Routing algorithms. Applications of networks.

derived_eng_desc1: Covers data communications, network protocols, data transmission, and switching networks, central to ICT.

eng_name: Data Structures and Algorithms for Data Analytics
eng_desc: Analysis of running time and memory requirements. Data structures: arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues, trees, hash, graph. algorithm techniques: brute force, divide-and-conquer, greedy algorithms, and dynamic programming. Space and time tradeoffs. Algorithm design and implementation for business problems. Testing and debugging.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers fundamental data structures and algorithms, including design, implementation, and analysis for data analytics.

eng_desc: Analyze system requirements in order to perform system design. Introduce the basic concept of software architecture and principle of software design by applying design patterns and architectural styles through team-based project. Understand concerns impacting the design decisions such as performance, scalability and security. Explain design solutions to address those design concerns. Practice system analysis and design method through project.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on software system analysis and design, including architecture, design patterns, and addressing performance and security.

derived_eng_desc1: Covers architecture, design, and programming of embedded systems and IoT, including networking and security.

eng_name: Artificial Intelligence in Smart Technology for Sustainable Development

derived_eng_desc1: Covers AI theory, machine learning, and applications in smart technologies for sustainable development.

derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on Linux system programming, including file systems, process control, and inter-process communication.

eng_name: Introduction to Computer Programming using Python

Python built- in data structures: lists, tuples, sets, dictionaries, and ranges. Numerical processing library. Arrays and matrices. Data analysis library. Dataframes. Basic Python library for Computer Network and Cybersecurity.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on Python programming, data structures, data analysis, computer networks, and cybersecurity.

derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on information and computer security, privacy, and design of trusted systems, aligning with ICT.

Constructions, analyses, and security definitions of basic cryptographic primitives such as encryption schemes and message authentication codes based on block ciphers, such as DES and AES, and those based on number-theoretic constructs, such as the discrete logarithm function. eng_desc: Basic concepts of machine learning and deep learning; Perceptron; Artificial Neural Network; Various types of neural network: Convolution Neural Networks (CNN), Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN), Multilayer Perceptron (MLP), Long-short Term Memory (LSTM), Auto Encoder (AE); Implementing deep learning-based applications in both supervised and unsupervised learning using libraries to solve a selected problem.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on machine learning, deep learning, neural networks, and their applications, aligning with ICT and AI.

eng_desc: Basic concepts of object-oriented programming, data structures: stacks, queues, linked list, trees, graphs; recursion, sorting and searching algorithms.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers object-oriented programming, data structures, and fundamental algorithms, aligning with computer science and ICT.

eng_desc: Basic concepts of operating systems. Processes. Interprocess communication and synchronization. Input-output. File systems. Memory management.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on operating systems, processes, file systems, and memory management, core concepts in ICT.

eng_desc: Cities are at the forefront of sustainable development.
