This course further extends to the behavioural science as well as drugs used in the nervous system and drugs for the psychological problem.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers neuroanatomy, neurophysiology, biochemistry of the nervous system, pathology, and drugs for neurological/psychological problems.

eng_desc: Skills for reading and analyzing English research articles in medical science under supervision of an advisor: information search and analysis, writing an abstract in Thai, oral presentation, discussion and suggestion/opinions, summation of research article, response to questions; participation in scientific forum.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on research skills within medical science, including article analysis and presentation, aligning with health.

eng_desc: Social theories on sex, gender, and sexuality related to health, sexual reproductive health rights programs, sexual diversity, sexually explicit material, sexually transmitted diseases and HIV, unplanned pregnancy, abortion, sexual violence and sexual ethics.
derived_eng_desc1: Examines gender, sexuality, and health, including reproductive health, STDs, and sexual violence, aligning with health.

eng_desc: The basic skills for access, manipulate, and computational analysis of health data sets, and how to perform, and customize data analysis using computer programs; statistical methods; skills to apply computer software to health data.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on computational and statistical analysis of health data using computer software.

eng_desc: The functions of human eye associated with binoculary visual perception. The principles involved in seeing and the various factors affecting the visual process. visual accommodation, visual sensation, mechanism & physiology of vision, Duplicity theory, fusion and vergence. Characteristics, control, and deficits of the somatic eye movement system, Strabismic, Pseudo-myopia, visual field and visual field defect.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on binocular vision, visual perception, physiology of vision, eye movement systems, and visual field defects.

eng_desc: The functions of human eye associated with visual perception. It also includes the principles involved in seeing and the various factors affecting the visual process. Dioptrics of the eye, entoptic phenomena, pupil and its optical function, abnormal pupillary conditions, visual accommodation, retinal stimulation, visual sensation, characteristics of photopic vision and scotopic vision, nyctalopia.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on monocular vision, visual perception, human eye functions, optical properties, and various visual processes and conditions.

eng_name: Occupational Health and Safety in Sport
eng_desc: The historical evolution of Occupational Health and Safety both internationally and in Thailand. The fundamentals of labor law, the concept and types of employment contracts, There will be physical, mental, social health, chemical, and biological risk factors provided including the occupational health prevention. Personal protective equipment, locations, and risk assessment will emphasize in the sport occupational health and safety.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on occupational health and safety, including risk factors, prevention, protective equipment, and risk assessment in sport.

eng_name: Principle of Physics for Medical Science
eng_desc: The physical principles applying for medical students. Focusing on the classical mechanics and topics including matter, motion, force, work, energy, power, fluids, principle of thermodynamic, principle of physic in daily life in human physiological related topics and the example in the applications of physics to medical research, diagnosis and treatment.
derived_eng_desc1: Applies physics principles to medical science, human physiology, diagnosis, and treatment, fitting health.

eng_name: Principle of Physics for Medical Science
eng_desc: The physical principles applying for medical students. Focusing on the classical mechanics and topics including matter, motion, force, work, energy, power, fluids, principle of thermodynamic, principle of physic in daily life in human physiological related topics and the example in the applications of physics to medical research, diagnosis and treatment.
derived_eng_desc1: Applies physics principles to medical science, human physiology, diagnosis, and treatment, fitting health.

eng_desc: The psychological, scientific, and cultural aspects of death and dying; the grieving process and diverse coping strategies for loss; stages and theories of grief; the role of science, psychology, rituals, cultural practices, and spiritual practices in bereavement care and end-of- life experiences; life and death planning; ethical considerations in palliative care, hospice care, death preparation, business of death, euthanasia, and death penalty; strategies for supporting individuals and families facing terminal illness or bereavement; critical reflections on mortality, legacy, and meaning-making within the contexts of death and grief.
derived_eng_desc1: Examines psychological, scientific, and cultural aspects of death, dying, and bereavement, including palliative and hospice care.

eng_desc: The theory behind spectacle lenses and frames, their materials, types, advantages and disadvantages, calculations involved, when and how to prescribe spectacle. It will impart construction, design, application and development of lenses, particularly the methods of calculating their power, effect and needs to manage customer in the optical set up, the physical and optical characteristics if ophthalmic single vision and multifocal lens design, ophthalmic prisms, absorptive lenses.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers ophthalmic optics, including spectacle lenses, materials, design, calculations, and prescription for vision correction.

eng_desc: The types of information used in clinical care; text, structured data, images and sounds, clinical vocabularies, generated clinical information. Methods for information storage and retrieval; departmental systems, organizational systems, regulatory problems of EHRs.
derived_eng_desc1: Studies Electronic Health Records (EHRs), including information types, storage, retrieval methods, and regulatory issues in clinical care.

eng_desc: This course explores the relationship between built environment and public health in term of all contributing factors that affect health behaviors and outcomes. The social, economic and environmental factors are considered to establish the linkage of health equity and healthy cities with an integrating of measures, analysis and design of policy strategies in public health. It is also intended to emphasize a role of urban planning in a health lens to policymaking and planning in multilevel for improving urban health.
derived_eng_desc1: Explores the relationship between built environment, public health, and urban planning for improving urban health outcomes.

eng_desc: This course focuses on basic principles of medical microbiology. It emphasizes on the common infectious diseases found in Thailand in the following aspects: causative agents; pathogenesis; epidemiology; clinical features; immune responding; laboratory diagnosis; and treatment and prevention. The course allows learners to practice on the basic microbiology.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on medical microbiology, parasitology, infectious diseases, their diagnosis, treatment, and prevention.

eng_desc: This course is integrated into the curriculum throughout the fifth year of study This course is continuing study from Medical Law and Ethics 1. The course provides common topics in medical law and ethics, with a focus on their application in clinical practice. Students will learn and apply knowledge of medical law and ethics to promote professionalism and maintain professional standards. Evaluation will be satisfied (S) and unsatisfied (U)
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on medical laws and ethics, applying legal principles to clinical practice and professionalism.

eng_desc: This course is integrated into the curriculum throughout the fourth year of study Study and apply knowledge of ethics in medical practice, while promoting professional skills, the characteristics of a good physician, and living a happy life. Evaluation will be satisfied (S) and unsatisfied (U)
derived_eng_desc1: Applies medical law and ethics to medical practice, promoting professional skills for physicians.

eng_name: Basic Satir for growth and change
eng_desc: Understanding the Satir Model; inner transformation; practicing questioning techniques to facilitate change; applying the Satir Model in life for personal growth, change and providing psychological support to others.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on the Satir Model for personal growth, change, and providing psychological support.

eng_desc: Understanding traditional Chinese physical education by learning and practicing basic movement of Tai Chi. Students will learn 16 Tai Chi moves by themselves which will teach them about respect in moral between teachers and students.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on traditional Chinese physical education, learning and practicing Tai Chi movements for health and wellbeing.

eng_desc: Visual information processing testing, organizing approach, uses to identify vision problems related to children with learning difficulty and special needs, including tests and measurements taken by optometrists. An overview of learning disabilities, the role of the optometrist in conjunction with the parents, teachers, and psychologists in assisting children, multidisciplinary approach in management of vision related learning problems. Sequential management plans for treating patients with special need.
derived_eng_desc1: Addresses visual perception, learning disabilities in children, and multidisciplinary management involving optometrists for special needs.

eng_name: Professional Law and Thai Public Health System
eng_desc: laws governing TCM professions, medical ethics, ethical issues exemplary to the profession, ethical questions that prompts discussion from many angles and Thai public health system.
derived_eng_desc1: Examines professional law, medical ethics, and the Thai public health system, including laws governing TCM professions.

eng_desc: An introduction to social work practice and ethics in an international context. Practical guidelines of theuniversal declaration of human rights as customary international law, United Nations Conventions, andregional declarations, focusing on social work practice in a global context, social work organizations inshaping welfare policy and services. Specific topics cover critical phenomenon social issues, multiculturaland cross-cultural collaboration, and cultural competence of social workers. Activities and roles of socialworkers in different countries are also explored to recognize social work as a global profession.
derived_eng_desc1: Introduces global social work practice, ethics, human rights, welfare policy, and multicultural collaboration.

eng_desc: Concepts of information technology; data collection; data management; database; data mining; health information laws and ethics; basic data management and analysis skills with computer program (datatype, data clearing, data analysis); information resources and retrieval skills; tools and techniques for data visualization; applying health information for health care promotion, disease prevention and control.
derived_eng_desc1: Applies information technology and data management specifically for health care promotion, disease prevention, and control.

eng_name: Occupational Healthy and Safety in Community
eng_desc: Occupational health and safety in workplace environment. Occupational health surveillance, injury and accidence at workplace. Occupational diseases and health impact from accidents and those occupational diseases. Assessment, management and Investigating of accident and occupational diseases. Fundamental principle of ergonomics. Principle of prevention from occupational diseases and hazards. Control and prevention occupational health and safety by involved organizations. Standard and applicable laws in occupational health and safety.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on occupational health and safety, workplace hazards, disease prevention, accident investigation, and relevant laws.

eng_desc: Occupational health and safety management in industrial sector, organization, planning and implementation monitoring and evaluation, investigation on injury, disease and incident at work. Roles and responsibilities of safety officers in all levels. Occupational health and safety management system of Labor Ministry (ILO-OSHMS 2001). ISO 45001 Occupational health and safety standard. Occupational health services for agriculture sector, service sector, informal sector and migrant workers. Occupational health information system in Thailand. Application of psychology to solve occupational health and safety problems in the industrial
derived_eng_desc1: Covers occupational health and safety management systems, standards (ISO 45001), and services across various sectors.

eng_desc: One Health challenges especially in emerging and reemerging infectious disease detection, prevention and response, antimicrobial resistance and ecosystem health changes are redesigning of more integrative multidiscipline for One Health workforce not only to have the technical skills and competencies to work well within their own discipline and sector but also to possess the skills to work across sectors to promote coordination and communication among all the stakeholders within the response sphere of emerging health threats of such global scale. One Health core competencies include One Health principles and concepts, ecosystem health, infectious disease management, risk analysis, epidemiology, outbreak investigation and response, and One Health research.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on One Health challenges, infectious disease management, epidemiology, outbreak investigation, and ecosystem health.

eng_desc: Psychosocial aspects of chronic illness affect individuals, families, and communities. Developing thetherapeutic relationship; application of contemporary psychosocial interventions and approach in a socialwork context with individuals facing mental or substance use/ abuse problems, and traumatized personappropriately of all ages based on professional ethics; developing a basic psychosocial interventions programfor implementing and evaluating change at the individual, group and family levels, including developingholistic self-care skills as a service provider (Field study required)
derived_eng_desc1: Covers psychosocial interventions for chronic illness, mental health, substance abuse, and social work, directly fitting health and welfare.

eng_desc: Quality control of the raw herbs, production of the herbal drugs, herbal drug preparation in several forms, storage of Thai traditional herbal drugs and products, quality assessment on herbal products.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on quality control, production, and storage of Thai traditional herbal drugs, directly related to pharmacy and health.

eng_desc: Quality improvement in health care, risk management, hospital accreditation, national public health administration, good governance, national health policy, health economic, health care financing, health promotion and disease prevention.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers quality improvement in healthcare, public health administration, health policy, and health economics, fitting health and welfare.

eng_name: Assessment on Well-being and Well-being Project Evaluation
eng_desc: Quantitative and qualitative health assessment tools and their applications in various contexts; principles and processes of developing well-being assessment tools; evaluating the validity of conclusions drawn from the usage of assessment tools; approaches to evaluating different types of well-being project; principles and techniques of systematic project evaluation; advantages, limitations, and appropriateness of different project evaluation models; evaluating the validity of conclusions drawn from well-being project evaluations.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers quantitative and qualitative health assessment tools and well-being project evaluation, directly related to health and welfare.

eng_name: Multidisciplinary Field Training for Public Health Development
eng_desc: A community-based training using multidisciplinary among students, community assessment using proper tools, identification of health problems or topics of concern, community diagnosis, cause analysis by using evidence-based support, planning of programs to solve the identified problems or topics, community participation, proposing well-planned programs for implementation to community and responsible local authorities.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on community-based public health development, assessment, and program planning.

eng_desc: A comprehensive review of common and compelling neuro-ophthalmic disorders encountered in clinical practice of optometry and ophthalmology. To provide ophthalmic practitioners with the appropriate knowledge and case examples of common neuro-ophthalmic disorders, appropriate training pursuant to the utilization of appropriate diagnostic studies to evaluate this group of patients such as neuroimaging (CT, MRI), retino-choroidal angiography, echography, etc., understanding of case management strategies related to neuro-ophthalmic disorders.
derived_eng_desc1: Reviews neuro-ophthalmic disorders, diagnostic studies, and management strategies in optometry and ophthalmology.

eng_desc: A subject includes how organs of human body adapt to healthy life style of individuals in daily life. This course focuses on basic biomedical sciences of cells and organs in human body systems. Various factors including microorganisms, drugs, toxins, and chemicals, which are involved in individual health, are discussed for awareness and prevention. There will not be only lecture, but also exchanging experience. A small group of students will develop a challenging activity to work out by research such as literature reviews, and research that shows the use of knowledge that benefits oneself or those close to them.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on human body systems, biomedical sciences, and factors affecting individual health and prevention.

eng_desc: Abnormal functions and mechanisms of cells, tissues and organs of each system in the disease state that leads to loss of body homeostasis.
derived_eng_desc1: Studies abnormal functions and mechanisms of the body in disease states, a core aspect of medicine.

eng_desc: Additional practice with inpatients and outpatients of internal medicine and psychiatry, to improve skills and capabilities in patient assessment, treatment planning and holistic health care, laboratory and radiology investigation and result interpretation, data gathering and medical record; cooperative working with medical personnel; communication, counseling with patients and their families; practice with professional ethics and moral.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on internal medicine and psychiatry practice, including patient assessment, treatment, and holistic healthcare.

eng_desc: Additional practice with women both inpatients and outpatients, to improve skills and capabilities in patient assessment, treatment planning and holistic health care for women patient and pregnant women, laboratory and radiology investigation and result interpretation, data gathering and medical record; cooperative working with medical personnel; communication, counseling with patients and their families; practice with professional ethics and moral.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on obstetrics-gynecology practice, including patient assessment, treatment, and holistic healthcare for women.

eng_desc: Advance knowledge of health, diseases and common important symptoms in gynaecological diseases, or more complicated problems in Obstetrics-Gynecology by integration and application many fields of related knowledge; focusing on clinical reasoning, diagnosis, differential diagnosis, evidence-based medicine, critical thinking, rational drug use, holistic health care included health promotion and diseases prevention, rehabilitation based on professional virtues and ethics.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on advanced knowledge in obstetrics-gynecology, including diagnosis, treatment, and holistic health care.

eng_desc: Advance knowledge of health, epidemiology, causes, symptomatology, pathogenesis, pathophysiology in common and important symptoms in Pediatrics especially in neonate to 15 year-old, growth and development including physical, mentality and sociality; nutritional status; immune promotion; normal and abnormal behaviour; symptoms and common recognised and neonatal care by integration and application many fields of related knowledge; focusing on clinical reasoning, diagnosis, differential diagnosis, evidence-based medicine, critical thinking, rational drug use, holistic health care included health promotion and diseases prevention, rehabilitation based on professional virtues and ethics.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on advanced knowledge in pediatrics, including growth, development, diagnosis, treatment, and holistic health care.

eng_desc: Advance knowledge of health, epidemiology, causes, symptomatology, pathogenesis, pathophysiology in common surgical problems and patients who need operation; patient assessment and care in pre-operative, peri-operative and post-operative stage, prevention side effect of operation by integration many related medical fields; focusing on clinical reasoning, diagnosis, differential diagnosis, evidence-based medicine, critical thinking, holistic health care included health promotion and diseases prevention, rehabilitation based on professional virtues and ethics.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on surgical problems, patient care, diagnosis, treatment, and rehabilitation, aligning with health and welfare.

eng_desc: Advance ocular examining equipments and technique knowledge in optometric science. The recent invention of medical equipments and technologies for diagnosis and treatment of abnormal vision, practice and understanding the clinical guideline, interpretation of clinical test, advantage and disadvantage of of the eqiupment. Optometric technologies, spectacles, contact lenses, intraocular lenses
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on optometric science, medical equipment for vision diagnosis and treatment, aligning with health.

eng_desc: Advanced diagnostic and therapeutic procedures, providing an overview of disorders of the anterior and posterior segments of the eye. Develop the skills covered in the Optometric Clinic I, addition with the advance instruments, the use of diagnostic pharmaceutical agents. Additional diagnostic testing to determine appropriate testing procedures, analyze and formulate treatment plans. Spectacle prescription guidelines for senior and junior population.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on advanced optometry clinic procedures, diagnosis, and treatment of eye disorders, aligning with health.

eng_desc: Advancing knowledge of 11 topic-based, patient safety program based on “The Multi-professional Patient Safety Curriculum Guide (2011)” by WHO which included; 1) What is patient safety?, 2) Why applying human factors is important for patient safety, 3) Understanding systems and the effect of complexity on patient care, 4) Being an effective team player, 5) Learning from errors to prevent harm, 6) Understanding and managing clinical risk, 7) Using quality improvement methods to improve care, 8) Engaging with patients and carers, 9) Infection prevention and control, 10) Patient safety and invasive procedures, 11) Improving medication safety. This subject will be focused on basic practice of patient care by using various teaching methods such as ward round-based teaching, small group learning, case-based discussions, independent studies, patient tracking, role-playing, simulation and undertaking improvement projects.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on patient safety, clinical risk management, infection prevention, and medication safety in patient care.

eng_desc: Although there are numerous indicators and targets for SDG 3: Global Health and Well being, it can be simplified by Ecological Model Perspective. This course will provide the highlights of global achievements in 20th century by the collective efforts of global health and academics organizations. Moreover, students will learn case studies of Universal Health Coverage (UHC) adoption by different countries and how Thailand become a role model for UHC among developing countries. Additionally, the students will foresee 21st Century challenges of global health and well-being and what will the feasible and practical solutions for the country and global community.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on global health, well-being, Universal Health Coverage, and public health challenges.

eng_desc: Ambulatory care with patient-centered and family-oriented care, clinical communication skills with difficult patients, occupational health and occupational medicine, health economic evaluation, Healthcare system Site visit and clinical practice required in this course.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers ambulatory care, family medicine, occupational health, and healthcare systems with clinical practice.

eng_desc: Ambulatory care, clinical communication skills, patient-centered approach, principle of family medicine, Basic concept of preventive medicine, health economics, health system and healthcare system Site visit and clinical practice required in this course.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on ambulatory care, family medicine, preventive medicine, health systems, and clinical practice.

eng_desc: An overview of qualitative research methods used in health-related fields; theoretical underpinnings of qualitative research and the different types of qualitative research methods such as ethnography, grounded theory, phenomenology, and case studies; the process of designing qualitative research studies, including how to formulate research questions, select participants, and collect and analyze data; The various qualitative data analysis techniques and how to interpret research findings. The ethical considerations in conducting qualitative research studies in health-related fields. The process of design and conduct high-quality qualitative research studies, analyze data, and interpret findings effectively, the necessary skills to contribute to the advancement of knowledge in health-related fields through qualitative research.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on qualitative research methods specifically applied to health-related fields.

eng_desc: An understanding of the theory, principles, basic techniques, and applicationsof Proprioceptive Neuromuscular Facilitation (PNF), Motor Relearning Program, Bobathtechniques, William and McKenzie exercises, and relaxation exercises. It also includes theassessment and management of vestibular system.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on therapeutic exercise techniques and assessment/management of the vestibular system, related to health.

eng_desc: An update on rapidly developing innovation and technologies in medicine & healthcare; assisting medical professionals in using these technologies in an efficient and secure way along the stage of the delivery of healthcare and the practice of medicine i. e. prevent &prepare; data input &diagnostics; therapy &follow-up; and outcomes &consequences. The topics include: 1) Introduction to exponentials medicine: an update on rapidly developing technology, 2) Information & data driven health, 3) Personalised medicine & Omits, 4) Stem cells & regenerative medicine, 5) Nano-medicine and future of intervention, 6) Future oncology & cancer technology 7) Future psychiatry and neuromedicine, 8) MedTech/ biotech & entrepreneurship, and 9) Post genomic era and modern molecular genetics; the potential of genetics and genomics for providing new paradigms for prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of disease; personalized medicine and precision medicine; ethical, legal, and social issues associated with genetic testing of individual
derived_eng_desc1: Covers innovations and technologies in medicine, healthcare, diagnostics, therapy, and disease treatment.

eng_desc: Analysis and synthesis of high-value academic research in the field of physicaltherapy under the guidance of an academic advisor. Students will present research findings,critically evaluate studies, respond to inquiries, and provide principled and evidence-basedopinions.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on academic research and critical evaluation in the field of physical therapy.

eng_desc: Analysis and synthesis of specific issues or knowledge related to social welfare and/or social work in anarea of interest as agreed by the student and advisor. (The course is coordinated by the B.S.W. ProgrammeCommittee).
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on social welfare and social work issues, directly aligning with health and welfare.

eng_desc: Analysis in clinical chemistry laboratories: method evaluation; analysis and interpretation of biomolecules, focusing on functions of liver, kidney, heart, pancreas, gastrointestinal and endocrine systems; automated clinical chemistry analyzer; and special tests in clinical chemistry laboratories.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on clinical chemistry analysis, biomolecules, and organ system functions in a laboratory setting.

eng_desc: Analysis in clinical chemistry laboratory: instrument operation; specimen collection and preparation; analysis and interpretation of biomolecules, including glucose, proteins, enzymes, lipids, urea, creatinine, uric acid, electrolytes, and acid-base; quality control in clinical chemistry laboratory; factors affecting pre-analytical, analytical, and post-analytical process.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on clinical chemistry laboratory analysis, biomolecules, and quality control for health diagnostics.

eng_desc: Analyze and laboratory practice in blood group genetics, immunology of blood groups, clinically significant blood group typing, antiglobulin testing, antibody screening test and antibody identification, pretransfusion testing, blood donation and blood component preparation, hemapheresis, administration of blood and blood components, hemolytic disease of the newborn, quality assurance in blood bank; case studies on transfusion science.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers laboratory practice in transfusion science, including blood group genetics, immunology, testing, and blood component preparation.

eng_desc: Anatomy (gross and histology), embryology, physiology of the genitourinary system. Biochemistry, physiology and functions of kidney and glomerulus units including controlling of water, acid- base balancing, urine production. Mechanism and controls of the micturition process. Common abnormal conditions of the urogenital system and their pathology. Pharmacology (drugs used in the genitourinary system) including mechanism of drug actions and the adverse reaction.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers anatomy, physiology, pathology, and pharmacology of human body systems, clearly health and medicine.

eng_desc: Anatomy (gross and histology), growth, structure, function of the genitourinary and reproductive system. Biochemistry, physiology, and functions of kidney and glomerulus units including controlling water, acid-base balancing, and urine production. Mechanism and controls of the micturition process. Histology, physiology, and molecular aspects of gametogenesis and fertilization. Physiological and biochemistry changes during the menstruation cycle. Common abnormal conditions of the urogenital system and their pathology. Drugs used in the genitourinary and reproductive system.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers anatomy, physiology, biochemistry, pathology, and drugs for human body systems, clearly health and medicine.

eng_name: Midwifery for Applied Thai Traditional Medicine 1
eng_desc: Anatomy and physiology of female genital organs, physical and psychological conditions of pregnant women, antenatal care, mechanism of labors and delivery, principle and methods of delivery, both of Thai Traditional and Modern Medicine including out-patients and in- patients department. Start at primary care until to tertiary care, complications of pregnancy-delivery- postpartum, postnatal care and newborn - either normal or abnormal cases, appropriate referral decision, family planning.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on midwifery, antenatal care, delivery, and postnatal care, encompassing both traditional and modern medicine.

eng_desc: Anatomy, including gross anaomy and histology, and physiology of ogans of the digestive systm which include alimentary track, liver, gall bladder, and pancreas. Growth, structure and function of the digestive system, the molecular mechanism and biochemistry of functions of the alimentary system (i.e. digestion and absorption); synthesis, storage and functions of digestive enzymes and their controlling mechanism; and synthesis and metabolism of bile. The fundamentals of metabolism: nutritional metabolism (including protein, carbohydrate, fat, vitamin, and mineral metabolisms); energy consumption and expenditure. Abnormalitis (both anatomic and physiologic abnormalities) and pathology of the digestive system; nutritional problems (i.e. malnutrition or over-weiht); food toxicology; and pharmacology or drugs commonly used in this digestive system. Related biostatistics.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers anatomy, physiology, biochemistry, pathology, nutrition, and pharmacology of the digestive system.

eng_desc: Anatomy, including gross anatomy and histology, and physiology of organs of the digestive system which include alimentary tract (mouth and oral cavity, oesophagus, stomach, small and large intestine, rectum and anus), liver, gall bladder, and pancreas. Scopes of this subject include the molecular mechanism and biochemistry of functions of the alimentary system (i. e. digestion and absorption); an embryonic development of the digestive system; synthesis, storage and functions of digestive enzymes and their controlling mechanism; and synthesis and metabolism of bile. The subject also extends to the fundamentals of metabolism: nutritional metabolism (including protein, carbohydrate, fat, vitamin, and mineral metabolisms); energy consumption and expenditure; and body temperature. Abnormalities (both anatomic and physiologic abnormalities) and pathology of the digestive system; nutritional problems (i.e. malnutrition or over-weight); food toxicology; and pharmacology or drugs commonly used in this digestive system are also included.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers anatomy, physiology, biochemistry, pathology, nutrition, and pharmacology of the digestive system.

eng_desc: Application of concepts and research principles for community health development. Conducting both quantitative and qualitative research process. Implement various data gathering techniques. Analyze and validate data effectively. Write-up researched findings and present its results.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on research principles for community health development, including data gathering and analysis.

eng_name: Industrial Hygiene, Safety and Ergonomics Practice
eng_desc: Application of industrial hygiene, safety and ergonomic theories to practice in real workplaces. Development of skills in predicts anticipation, recognition, evaluation and control in various health hazards by using industrial hygiene instruments and occupational health, safety and ergonomic tools. Practical skills in data interpretation, writing report and presentation are also included.
derived_eng_desc1: Applies industrial hygiene, safety, and ergonomics to workplace health hazards and occupational health.

eng_desc: Application of medical principles in criminal investigations and legal proceedings. Medical students will acquire the necessary knowledge and skills in medico-legal autopsy, practice with forensic patient, collecting evidence for investigation, basis knowledge in forensic laboratory testing, performing as witness at court and also applied legal and ethical issues with medical profession. Providing study tour at related institution and field work training
derived_eng_desc1: Applies medical principles to criminal investigations, legal proceedings, and medico-legal practices.

eng_desc: Application of orthoptic training to advance visual performance. The use of other therapeutic devices and methodologies for rehabitation and management of visual and ocular related symptoms. Ocular hygenic, prosthetic eye, computer vision syndrome and headache. The nutrition for ocular health and vision and its application.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on ocular therapeutics, visual performance, rehabilitation, and nutrition for eye health.

eng_name: Practical Experience in Applied Thai Traditional Medicine Professional skill
eng_desc: Apprentice in Applied Thai Traditional medicine services, which are covered all aspects of the curriculum, to reach the goal of proficiency of therapeutic in particular branch of Applied Thai Traditional medicine by practice in hospital, clinic, primary health care center, school, temple, medical factory, and pharmacy where an Applied Thai Traditional Medicine practitioner with the license working there.
derived_eng_desc1: Practical experience in Applied Thai Traditional Medicine services, including therapeutic practice in various healthcare settings.

eng_name: Practical Experience in Applied Thai Traditional Pharmacy
eng_desc: Apprentice in Thai traditional pharmacology, quality control, analysis, drug formulation design.
derived_eng_desc1: Practical experience in Thai traditional pharmacology, quality control, analysis, and drug formulation design.

eng_name: Practical Experience in Applied Thai Traditional Massage
eng_desc: Apprentice in medical health care service at the hospital level to improve diagnosis skills, treatments, health promotion and rehabilitation of the patients by integration of Thai traditional and western knowledge, health education, investigation of medical history of the patients, physical examination by using the knowledge of applied Thai traditional medicine, emphasizing on Thai massage.
derived_eng_desc1: Practical experience in medical healthcare, focusing on diagnosis, treatment, and rehabilitation using Thai traditional massage.

eng_name: Practical experience in Applied Thai Traditional Medicine
eng_desc: Apprentice in medical health care service at the hospital level to improve the diagnosis skills, treatments, health promotion, and health rehabilitation to the patients by integration of Thai traditional and western knowledge, health education, investigation medical history of the patients, physical examination in applied Thai traditional medicine.
derived_eng_desc1: Practical experience in medical healthcare, focusing on diagnosis, treatment, and rehabilitation using applied Thai traditional medicine.

eng_desc: Assess and choose appropriate research methodologies both quantitative and qualitative research to explore research questions. Understand key ethical research and its process.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on research methodologies and ethical processes for community health research.

eng_desc: Astringent formulas, tranquillizing formulas, orifice-opening formulas, qi-activating formulas, blood-activating formulas, wind-dispelling formulas, dryness-moistening formulas , dampness-dispelling formulas, phlegm-dispelling formulas, digestant formulas, worm-expelling formulas, emertic formulas.
derived_eng_desc1: Studies various Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) formulas and their therapeutic applications.

eng_desc: Background of environmental health. Relationship between environmental factors and health with an emphasis on health effects from physical, chemical, and biological hazards; exposure pathways, vulnerability and media including water, air, soil and food. Major environmental health issues and situations toward case study.
derived_eng_desc1: Directly addresses environmental factors impacting health, hazards, and public health issues.

eng_desc: Background, principle, concept and scope of occupational health and safety, factors affecting occupational health and safety, occupational diseases and accidents in various occupational sectors including industrial, services, informal sectors and migrant workers, recognition of work hazards, prevention and control of occupational diseases and accidents, quality of work life as well as occupational health and safety services under both the government and employers responsibilities.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on occupational health, safety, disease prevention, and accident control in various work sectors.

eng_desc: Basic Theory of Medical Psychology, factors Affecting Mental Health, the relationship between mental health and disease occurrence, healthcare and therapeutic psychology analysis.
