eng_desc: Collection of basic knowledge for conducting research; design research methodology by using various techniques and resources under a guidance of an advisor; preparation of a research proposal; conducting experiments; data analysis, discussion and conclusion; report writing and oral presentation of the research in class.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on research methodology and experiments within the field of medical technology.

eng_desc: Common parasitic diseases and problems caused by the arthropods in Thailand including clinical manifestations, basic knowledge of host immune response, diagnosis, treatment, epidemiology, prevention and control of parasitic infection.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers diagnosis, treatment, epidemiology, prevention, and control of parasitic diseases.

eng_desc: Community medicine, health needs assessment and gap analysis in community, good service delivery, people- centered care and holistic care, health promotion and disease prevention, national health policy, health promotion project, interprofessional collaboration.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on community medicine, public health, health promotion, disease prevention, and national health policy.

eng_desc: Community survey and analysis of community health problems; planning and implementation of community health program; health counseling, in coroporation with other health care professionals. Integration of medical technology knowledge and skills for the health assessment, community health surveillance, and health promotion in the community.
derived_eng_desc1: Integrates medical technology with community health assessment, surveillance, and health promotion programs.

eng_desc: Concept and fundament of public policy; Type of health public policy; Public policy process: problem identification, policy formulation, policy adoption, policy implementation and policy evaluation. Apply health public policy; national health assembly, national health system constitution, and Health in All Policy.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers the concepts, processes, and application of public policy specifically within the health sector.

eng_desc: Concept and introduction of the social epidemiology, socioeconomic status and health, discrimination and health Inequality, income inequality, work condition and health, labor markets, employment policies, and health, social network epidemiology, social capital, social cohesion and health, affective states and health, and changing health behaviors in a social context.
derived_eng_desc1: Introduces social epidemiology, examining the social determinants of health, health inequality, and health behaviors.

eng_desc: Concept of normal physical, mental, and social growth and development; nutritional status; immune promotion; normal and abnormal behavior; and common and recognized diseases in infants, children, and adolescents. The course will integrate all related aspects of child health care to let students understand: etiology, epidemiology, symptoms and signs, diagnosis, and holistic health care/approach for the common illnesses in infants, children, and adolescents to give appropriate treatment, prevention, and rehabilitation for individuals. Moreover, this course also aims to promote health maintenance in children at both family and community levels.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers normal child development, common diseases, diagnosis, treatment, prevention, and holistic health care for infants, children, and adolescents.

eng_name: Health Care and Rehabilitation with Traditional Thai Medicine and Alternative Medicine
eng_desc: Concepts and principles regarding alternative medicine for health care and rehabilitation, herbs in primary health care and the list of herbal medicines, health care and rehabilitation with the Thai traditional medicine, massage, steaming, compresses, physical exercise, and other health care methods using alternative medicine.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers health care and rehabilitation using traditional Thai and alternative medicine.

eng_name: Research and Knowledge Management on Health Social Work
eng_desc: Concepts and research methodology under Health social work contexts, the application of research findings,knowledge and direct experiences for knowledge management and synthesizing to develop approachesand tools in health social work in response to the needs of clients and organizations under all healthpromotion scheme
derived_eng_desc1: Covers research and knowledge management in health social work and health promotion.

eng_desc: Concepts and theories in social welfare for older persons, principles, laws, social welfare policies related toolder persons. Lessons in social welfare management for older persons nationally and internationally.Models, principles and process of primary care, intermediate care and long-term care and end of life carefor older persons, working with the family, community and institution. Roles of the multidisciplinaryprofessions in older persons’ care. (Field study required)
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on social welfare, policies, and management of care for older persons, including primary, intermediate, and long-term care.

eng_desc: Concepts principles of empirical evidence, Information Query, Implementation of evidence-based health promotion, Field Study.
derived_eng_desc1: Directly concerns health promotion and evidence-based practices in health.

eng_desc: Concepts, Principles, and practices of the community in managing various types of community welfare inresponse to the community’s way of life in Urban communities, Semi-rural communities and Ruralcommunities based on integrated local wisdom that can keep up with changes in communities and societyas well as establishing mechanisms, processes, and networks to encourage cooperation between thegovernment and private sectors and to support sustainable community welfare. (Field study required)
derived_eng_desc1: Directly concerns community welfare, social care, and wellbeing in various communities.

eng_name: Social Welfare and Social Protection Systems
eng_desc: Concepts, principles, and the development of Social Welfare, Human Security, Social Justice, Human rightsand Basic Rights under the Constitution, Social Security, Social Protection System, Social Safety Nets andWelfare State. With the study at three main levels; international, regional and local, and the significant impactson the Social Welfare systems and the Human Security Development.
derived_eng_desc1: Directly concerns social welfare, social protection systems, and human security.

eng_desc: Concepts, principles, formats, processes, techniques and tools for project assessment. Conceptualization,design and application of social innovations for improving the quality of life for the older persons; assessmentand development of social innovations for the older persons (Field study and internship required)
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on social innovations to improve quality of life for older persons, aligning with welfare.

eng_name: Social Work Methodology in Group Work
eng_desc: Concepts, theories and perspectives applied to group work, sociometry and group dynamic concept, socialwork principles for groups, group process and characteristics, various types of group work, paradigm andmodels of group work, evaluation and planning, conduct of group work, follow up and evaluation of groupwork, instruments and skills for social group work, interesting case studies and groups
derived_eng_desc1: Directly concerns social work methodology, group dynamics, and social care principles.

eng_desc: Concepts, theories, principles, ethics, processes, skills, and techniques of social work counseling to targetgroups of social work who face social and psychological problems, under social work ethics and relatedlegislative framework, aiming at their realization and understanding of their own social function, self-development, or effective coping with life challenges.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on concepts, theories, and techniques of social work counseling for individuals facing social and psychological problems.

eng_desc: Conducts research on a self-chosen subject in the field of medical science. The student participates in the research project of the supervising staff or the group of students with the supervising staff member, and contributes to ongoing research of the research group, by carrying out research, and writing a research report. Students have learning research experience in research unit at Chulabhorn International College of Medicine, Thammasat University or other research units in Thailand or other countries.
derived_eng_desc1: Research project in medical science, involving participation in ongoing research and writing a research report.

eng_desc: Consultation and care for patients who present with systemic illnesses, with or without ocular manifestations. Many of ocular disorders appear as a direct consequence of some systemic diseases. Moreover, treatment given for various eye conditions could have systemic side effects that should be recognized by optometrists. Provide students with basic understanding of the most common systemic diseases and their presentations, as well as their relationship to the abnormal ocular conditions.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers systemic diseases, their ocular manifestations, patient care, and treatments, relevant for optometrists.

eng_desc: Cytology and anatomy of immune system, immune response, humoral and cell-mediated immunity, antigen and antibody, complement, hypersensitivity, immunohematology, transplantation immunology, autoimmunity, tumor immunology, immunity to infection, immunodeficiency, immunization, applications, and field trips.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers the immune system, immune response, antigens, antibodies, and related medical applications.

eng_name: Seminar in Global Issues and trend in Occupational Health
eng_desc: Define and scope of interesting topics in occupational health and safety within the current situation and in national, regional and global strategies. Students are required to research, analysis, conclusion and presentation of the issues. Brain- storming, co-operations to solving problems.
derived_eng_desc1: Explores global issues and trends in occupational health and safety, including research and problem-solving.

eng_desc: Definition and components of communication. Principles and concepts of health communication applying to community health works. Health communication process and communication channels. Health communication skills development using of information technology in health communication, media production, applied theatre and health campaigning and policy driving. Health Promotion and Behavioral Sciences, Health education, health behavior modification, and health literacy
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on health communication, health promotion, behavioral sciences, and health education.

eng_desc: Definition and components of physical activity; The importance of physical activity in holistic health; Current situation and policy about physical activity promotion; Physical activity screening and assessing tools; Indicators and assessment of physical activity; Determinants of physical activity promoting; Physical fitness test; Physical activity for age group and health condition; Examples of physical activity promotion innovation; Simulation and real-life situation practice.
derived_eng_desc1: Explores physical activity, its importance for holistic health, promotion, and assessment.

eng_desc: Definition and concept of innovation; Type of innovation; Definition and concept of health innovation; Concept of innovation for health promotion in Thai and international contexts; History and the importance of innovation for health promotion practice; Forms of innovation in health promotion; Principle and model of innovation process; Diffusion of innovation principle; Evaluation of health innovation principle; Intellectual property; and field study.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on health innovation, its concepts, processes, and importance for health promotion.

eng_desc: Definition and importance of Health Impact Assessment (HIA) and Community Health Impact Assessment (CHIA); relevant laws in health and HIA; quality of life; data collecting, screening, scoping, methodology and monitoring and all of public policy and projects or activities that may cause serious consequences to the environment and natural resources, health risk assessment and report, health impact assessment and suggestion for health impact mitigation, health surveillance and risk communication.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on Health Impact Assessment (HIA) and Community Health Impact Assessment (CHIA) methodologies and applications.

eng_name: Disaster and Management in Social Work
eng_desc: Definition and types of disaster, principles, concepts, methods and guildelines for disaster management,disaster management cycle, disaster managments standards; roles of social workers and the authority incharge of disaster management, post- disaster restoration and development under the principles ofempowerment and social work practice (Field study required)
derived_eng_desc1: Covers disaster management principles, methods, and the role of social workers in post-disaster restoration.

eng_name: Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points
eng_desc: Definition of food safety. Good hygienic practices (GMP). Sanitation standard operationprocedure preparation. Prerequisite program management. Implementation steps of Hazardanalysis critical control point (HACCP) system. Hazard analysis. Establishment of critical controlpoints and critical limit. Indicating of methods for monitoring, verification, recording andreporting. System audit. Field trips.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on food safety, hygienic practices, and HACCP system implementation, crucial for public health.

eng_desc: Definition, concepts and related theories of Community Health Work, Primary Health Care System, SocialWork Practice in Community-based Health Care; applying the concepts in social ecology based on theunderstanding in psychosocial and culture dimension and community-based integrated care. Includingchanges related to or influences holistic health and health justice with roles of community health socialworkers. (Field study required)
derived_eng_desc1: Explores social ecology, community health work, primary health care, and social work practice in health.

eng_desc: Definition, principles and scopes of massage for sports and health. Techniques and basic skills of massage. Application of massage for exercising and competition.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers principles, techniques, and applications of massage for sports and general health and wellbeing.

eng_desc: Definition, significance and scope of family health. Basic knowledge of family, development and family health care, health promotion, diseases prevention and control, curative care and rehabilitation for family members, family planning, birth control, nutrition assessment and nutrition promotion throughout the life span.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers family health, health care, promotion, disease prevention, and rehabilitation for family members.

eng_desc: Definition. Absorption of toxicants. Toxicity. Biotransformation. Toxin present inenvironment. Natural toxins present in food: phytotoxins, animal toxins and microbial toxins.Chemical toxicant used in industry and agriculture. Food additives, residues andcontaminants. Risk assessment and food safety.
derived_eng_desc1: Studies food toxicology, absorption of toxicants, natural toxins, chemical contaminants, risk assessment, and food safety.

eng_desc: Definition; Importance; Scope and situation of toxicology and environmental health; Basic principle of toxicology and environmental health; types source and properties of toxicants; environmental transport and transformation; environmental pathways and exposure routes; Dose response relationship; Toxicokinetic; Dose-response assessment and toxicity testing; Ecotoxicological risk assessment; Environmental health risk assessment; Case studies, application of toxicology in health risk assessment and environmental health surveillances
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on toxicology, environmental health, risk assessment, and public health implications.

eng_desc: Definitions and meanings of Latin roots that make up basic medical terms; terms involving basic biomedical sciences, human anatomy, and human physiology; terms involving symptomatology; terms involving medical treatment and clinical procedure.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on medical terminology, biomedical sciences, anatomy, physiology, and clinical procedures.

eng_desc: Detection and management of chronic and acute complications induced by contact lenses. Advanced contact lens applications for special conditions such as dry eye, aphakia, high and irregular astigmatism, keratoconus, presbyopia, post-surgical and irregular corneas, corneal reshaping, and ocular prosthetics. Disposable lenses and replacement regimens. Extended wear options. Alternative management of refractive errors such as orthokeratology and refractive surgery.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on contact lens complications, advanced applications for special conditions, and alternative refractive error management.

eng_name: Disease Prevention and Control in community
eng_desc: Determinants of health and diseases, disease prevention and control on important communicable diseases and non-communicable diseases (NCD), emerging/ reemerging Infectious diseases, one health approach including environmental and occupational diseases with their impact on population, economy and society. The subject explores causes, symptoms and primary care. It also discusses etiology and distribution of disease including immunization. The strategies on disease prevention and control in normal situation and emergency at national, regional and global level are discussed.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on disease prevention and control, communicable/non-communicable diseases, public health, and immunization strategies.

eng_desc: Development of cells into tissues and body organs. Concept of homeostasis and autonomic nervous system. Membrane potential and transport. Cells of the immune system, immune response to microbes. Metabolic disorders. Mutation and inherited disorders. Genetic engineering technology. Basic pathological process, neoplasia. Pharmacokinetics, pharmacodynamics, and pharmacogenetics. Related biostatisics.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers fundamental biomedical sciences, including cell biology, immunology, genetics, pathology, and pharmacology.

eng_desc: Development of structures and expressions for communication skills in the area of social work. Practice in reading, writing, listening and speaking relevant to the fundamentals of social work as well as social work issues.
derived_eng_desc1: Develops English communication skills, structures, and expressions relevant to social work and its issues.

eng_desc: Develops and enhances clinical diagnostic and treatment procedures taught in the previous courses, which will be emphasized together with fostering the student's ability to solve clinical problems through critical thinking, utilizing evidence-based medicine and scientific knowledge. To assess and verify the optometry student's level of competency in primary care optometry patient care skills. Students need to pass a comprehensive clinical skills proficiency examination to enter the externship programs in the final year.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on optometry clinical diagnosis, treatment, and patient care skills, clearly health-related.

eng_desc: Diagnosis and treatment for patients using principle of Chinese Medicine under supervision of instructors.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on clinical diagnosis and treatment using Chinese Medicine, a health practice.

eng_desc: Diagnosis and treatment for patients using principle of Chinese Medicine under supervision of instructors.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on clinical diagnosis and treatment using Chinese Medicine, a health practice.

eng_desc: Diagnosis of common conditions and diseases using ultrasonography emphasizing abdominal ultrasound. Indication, technique, method, differential diagnosis, diagnosis, efficiency, moral and ethic in profession. Evaluation will be satisfied (S) and unsatisfied (U)
derived_eng_desc1: Teaches diagnosis of diseases using ultrasonography in general practice, a health service.

eng_desc: Diagnosis procedures following refractive anomalies, focusing in ocular motility and binocular vision, accommodative system of the eyes, fusion and suppression. Technics and method of diagnosis, criteria and treatment for binocular vision anomalies and refractive anomalies.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers optometry diagnosis and treatment for binocular vision and refractive anomalies, a health topic.

eng_desc: Diseases patterns of the spleen (ingestion, diarrhea, stomachache, conspitation), diseases patterns of the liver (hypochondriac pain, jaundice), diseases patterns of the kidney (edema, spermatorrhea, erectile dysfunction), diseases patterns of the qi-blood-fluid (depression, hidrosis syndrome, diabetes mellitus, malignancy) diseases patterns of the physical body and meridians (low back pain, flaccidity syndrome, arthromyodynia) and clinical practice.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) internal medicine, disease patterns, and clinical practice.

eng_desc: Diseases, pathophysiology, symptoms, and signs related to respiratory andcardiovascular conditions, including planning and summarizing physical examinations, analyzingproblems, and formulating treatment plans. This encompasses treatment methods andproviding physical therapy rehabilitation programs for respiratory and cardiovascular patients,including both pediatric and adult patients, medical and surgical patients, critically ill patientswith brain and spinal cord injuries, and patients requiring pulmonary and cardiac rehabilitation.The approach uses evidence-based information to support clinical decision-making, evaluatepost-treatment outcomes, and adjust treatment plans appropriately for individual patients,considering contraindications and precautions. Additionally, this involves observing physicaltherapy practices for respiratory and cardiovascular conditions in medical and surgical wards.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on physical therapy, rehabilitation programs, and treatment for cardio-pulmonary conditions in patients.

eng_desc: Drug development at laboratory and industrial levels employing protein and genetic informations, important biologically active compounds produced from bioprocesses or plant, and applications of biotechnology in biopharmaceutical.
derived_eng_desc1: Explores pharmaceutical biotechnology, drug development, bioprocesses, and biopharmaceutical applications.

eng_desc: Drugs acting at enzyme and receptor, drug developments, pharmacodynamics, structure-activity relationships, antibacterial agents, drugs acting at cholinergic system, and opium analgesics.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers basic medicinal chemistry, drug development, pharmacodynamics, and structure-activity relationships of drugs.

eng_desc: Early detection and initial prehospital management for commonly encountered medical emergencies. Medical emergencies including: BLS and ACLS for sudden cardiac arrest patients, Cardiovascular emergencies: shock, chest pain, syncope, Severe hypertension, Respiratory emergencies: Dyspnea: pulmonary edema, anaphylaxis, asthma, hyperventilation, airway obstruction. Neurological emergencies: seizure disorders, Acute stroke, severe headache, Diabetic emergencies, Ocular emergencies, Assessment and management of these emergency situation, Safety referral-transfer patients. Assessment and management of these emergency situation, referral-transfer patients and CPR.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on emergency detection and prehospital management for various medical emergencies, including CPR.

eng_desc: Eating for healthy life, food and nutrients needed for maintaining healthy body, inner peace for healthy mind, lifestyle diseases in modern era: obesity, diabetes, cancer, cardiovascular disease, and stress, and how to prevent them.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on healthy eating, nutrition, and preventing lifestyle diseases for overall wellbeing.

eng_name: Fundamental Pathology for Traditional Thai Medical Students
eng_desc: Element and function of cells in human body including changing of cell and tissue; pathology of organic cells that caused by disease and basic pathology.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on pathology, cell function, disease, and human body, directly related to health and medicine.

eng_desc: Emergency surgical conditions that require care given by specialists; basic or initial management to those conditions; appropriate referring. The examples of these conditions include shock, and acute abdomen. Basic methods of wound care, simple sutures, fixation of bone fractures, joint dislocation and muscle injury.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on emergency surgical conditions, wound care, and medical procedures, directly related to health.

eng_desc: Engage with patients having complex conditions or multiple comorbidities toenhance analytical and treatment planning skills, apply theoretical knowledge to real patientcare, developing adaptability in treatment plans as situations evolve, collaborate withinterdisciplinary teams to improve communication and teamwork abilities, research andintegrate evidence-based practices into treatment planning to increase efficacy.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on clinical practice in physical therapy, patient care, treatment planning, and evidence-based practices, clearly health-related.

eng_desc: Enhancing knowledge and skills from Integrated Internal Medicine 1&2 by emphasize on systematic diseases, emergency or more complicated problems in internal medicine by integration and application many fields of related knowledge; focusing holistic care of patient; analysis and decision making related medical ethics issues.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on internal medicine, systematic diseases, patient care, and medical ethics.

eng_desc: Enhancing knowledge and skills from Integrated Pediatrics 1-2 by emphasize on systematic diseases, emergency or more complicated problems in pediatrics by integration and application many fields of related knowledge; such as sick newborn, pediatrics out patients; focusing holistic care of patient; analysis and decision making related medical ethics issues.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on pediatrics, systematic diseases, newborn care, and medical ethics.

eng_desc: Enhancing knowledge and skills from Integrated Pediatrics 1-2 by emphasize on systematic diseases, emergency or more complicated problems in pediatrics by integration and application many fields of related knowledge; such as sick newborn, pediatrics out patients; focusing holistic care of patient; analysis and decision making related medical ethics issues.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on pediatrics, systematic diseases, newborn care, and medical ethics.

eng_desc: Enhancing knowledge and skills from Obstetrics-Gynecology 1&2 by emphasize on gynecological diseases, emergency or more complicated problems in Obstetrics-Gynecology by integration and application many fields of related knowledge; focusing holistic care of patient; analysis and decision making related medical ethics issues.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on obstetrics-gynecology, gynecological diseases, patient care, and medical ethics.

eng_desc: Enhancing knowledge, skills and experience from Integrated Internal Medicine 1, 2, 3 and 4, including review pharmacology and pharmacokinetics that rely on principle of rational drug prescribing by emphasize on applied knowledge to process of problem analysis, differential diagnosis, holistic health care, prevention and health promotion. Providing study tour at related institution and field work training
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on practical internal medicine, pharmacology, diagnosis, holistic health care, and prevention.

eng_desc: Enhancing knowledge, skills and experiences Pediatrics and Practice in Pediatric including review clinical pharmacology and pharmacokinetics that aim to rational drug prescribing with pediatric patients, by emphasise on applied knowledge to problem analysis, differential diagnosis; holistic health care of children, prevention and health promotion. Practice with neonate and child patients as internship doctor both of outpatient and inpatient including newborn unit, by emphasise on professional skills, holistic problem solving in all conditions, patient safety including emergency conditions, communication with patients and their families, team working with medical personnel and other public health authorities, practice to decision making by awareness to professional ethics, virtues and etiquettes that aim to be qualified doctor in the future.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on pediatric clerkship, clinical pharmacology, holistic child care, patient safety, and medical ethics.

eng_desc: Enhancing knowledge, skills and experiences from Integrated Obstetrics-Gynecology 1, 2, 3, and 4 including review clinical pharmacology and pharmacokinetics that aim to rational drug prescribing; by emphasize on applied knowledge to problem analysis process, differential diagnosis, health care for women patient and pregnant women by holistic approach, family planning and infertile problem solving, health prevention and maintenance of women at each age.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on practical obstetrics-gynecology, pharmacology, women's health, family planning, and prevention.

eng_desc: Enhancing knowledge, skills and experiences from Integrated Surgery 1-2 and Special and Emergency Surgery, including review of clinical pharmacology, diagnostic radiology, and clinical pathology that rely on principles of diagnosis, rational drug prescribing, and treating surgical patients by emphasizing applied knowledge to the process of problem analysis, differential diagnosis, holistic health care, disease prevention, and health promotion. Providing study tour at related institutions and fieldwork training
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on practical surgery, pharmacology, diagnosis, holistic health care, and disease prevention.

eng_desc: Enhancing knowledge, skills and experiences from Obstetrics-Gynecology and Practice in Obstetrics-Gynecology including review clinical pharmacology and pharmacokinetics that aim to rational drug prescribing; by emphasise on applied knowledge to problem analysis process, differential diagnosis, health care for women patient and pregnant women by holistic approach, family planning and infertile problem solving, health prevention and maintenance of women at each age. Practice as internship doctor in women patient and pregnant women both of inpatient and outpatient including critical illness by emphasise on professional skills and procedural skill of obstetrics gynecology, delivery practice, assist in the operation; holistic problem solving, patient safety in emergency conditions; appropriate referring; consultation with specialists; communicate with patients and their families; education and consultation for patients and their families; team working with medical personnel; practice and decision making by awareness to professional ethics, virtues and etiquettes that aim to be qualified doctor.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on obstetrics-gynecology clerkship, women's health, delivery, surgery, patient safety, and medical ethics.

eng_desc: Enhancing knowledge, skills and experiences from Surgery and Practice in Surgery including review pharmacology and pharmacokinetics that rely on principle of rational drug prescribing, by emphasise on applied knowledge to process of problem analysis, differential diagnosis, holistic health care, and prevention and health promotion. Practice as internship doctor with surgical patient both of inpatient and outpatient including critical illness, urgent and emergency condition, by emphasise on surgical skills; holistic problem solving, patient safety, appropriate referring, consultation with specialists, communication with patient and their families; education and counselling for patients and their families; cooperative working with medical personnel; practice and decision making by awareness to professional ethics, virtues and etiquettes that aim to be qualified doctor.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on surgical clerkship, pharmacology, surgical skills, patient safety, and medical ethics.

eng_name: Applied Psychology in Clinical Health Care
eng_desc: Examines how psychological, social, and behavioral factors interact with and affect people in maintaining their health, personality development behavioural change, coping with stress, loss and pain, obtaining medical treatment and recovering from serious illness, communication in health care practice, principle and practice of counseling.
derived_eng_desc1: Applies psychological, social, and behavioral factors to clinical health care, focusing on health maintenance, coping, and counseling.

eng_name: Exercise for Good Health and Well-being
eng_desc: Exercise for promoting good health and well-being. Principle of exercise prescription for good health and well-being including exercise format, exercise intensity, responses to exercise, and adverse events that could happen and how to avoid them.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on exercise principles for promoting good health and well-being, including prescription and safety.

eng_desc: Experience in forensic medicine, diagnosis, medical record and medical documents, coordinating with personnel in judicial process, court witnessing in the autopsy cases, physical examination in forensic patients and medical trace evidences, communication with relatives and other clients in forensics works.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on practical aspects of forensic medicine, diagnosis, and legal medical processes.

eng_desc: Explore the morphologic aspects of disease that may be oriented towards specific organ systems: developmental malformation, cell injury, processes to the spectrum of human illnesses, laboratory investigation.
derived_eng_desc1: Explores morphologic aspects of disease, human illnesses, and laboratory investigation, directly related to health and medicine.

eng_desc: Forms of work-social conflict; knowledge about conflict management; conflict management process; conflictmanagement techniques Using negotiation; mediation in social work ; roles of a social workers in conflictmanagement especially the role of multidisciplinary team in protection and advocate of rights with legalprocess and other social processes.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on conflict resolution, management, negotiation, and mediation within the context of social work and welfare.

eng_desc: Fundamental anatomy providing the basis for systemic anatomy: anatomical terminology, gross anatomy of the musculoskeletal system, the circulatory system, the nervous system and introduction to embryology. Principles of light microscopical technique and histology of basic tissues including epithelial, connective, muscular and nervous tissue.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on fundamental medical anatomy, embryology, and histology, providing a basis for health studies.

eng_desc: Fundamental knowledge in physiology encompasses the communication between cells and various tissues, the transmission of nerve impulses, and synaptic signaling. It also includes the regulation of bodily functions by the nervous and endocrine systems, the fundamental principles of the bodily systems' functions, and the mechanisms involved in maintaining homeostasis to ensure the body's equilibrium.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers fundamental medical physiology, including cell communication, bodily functions, and homeostasis.

eng_desc: Fundamental knowledge of clinical low vision care and rehabilitation. Clinical examination techniques, optics lens and low vision devices, applications of low vision devices, low vision training, rehabilitative and psychosocial aspects of low vision care, and low vision treatment associated with specific disease processes. The psycho-social aspects that patients with low vision may experiences the community resources available for visually impaired individuals.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers clinical low vision care, rehabilitation, examination techniques, devices, and psychosocial aspects.

eng_desc: Fundamental knowledge of clinical psychology; the history of clinical psychology in Thailand and overseas; the psychological concepts in research, psychological assessment, diagnosis, and treatment; challenges and controversies in the field of clinical psychology; education and training in clinical psychology.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers clinical psychology, including assessment, diagnosis, and treatment for mental health and wellbeing.

eng_desc: Fundamental knowledge of components of human organs; basic components of human cells, tissues, and organs; basic knowledge of human anatomy; physiology of main organs in skin and musculoskeletal system, respiratory system, gastrointestinal tract, excretory system, reproductive system and hormones, and nervous system.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers fundamental human anatomy and physiology of various organ systems, essential for medical science.

eng_desc: Fundamental knowledge of symptomatological theory, invasion of microbes, and immunology in relation to infection; basic knowledge of human pathology and pathophysiology for non-medical students; basic principles of drug usage and safety.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers symptomatology, microbiology, immunology, pathology, pathophysiology, and drug usage principles.

eng_desc: Fundamental of exercise for maintaining joint range of motion, musclestretching, balance training, coordination enhancement, improvement of muscle functionalperformance, and cardiovascular endurance. It also explores various exercise modalities thatpromote physical health and the use of equipment to support exercise practices.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on therapeutic exercise for joint range, muscle function, balance, coordination, and cardiovascular endurance.

eng_desc: Fundamental principles of ethics, behavior and factors related to human behavior, medical ethics, dilemma in ethics and decision-making in in various situations related to medical students and physicians, and medical professionalism. Evaluation will be satisfied (S) and unsatisfied (U)
derived_eng_desc1: Covers fundamental principles of ethics, human behavior, medical ethics, decision-making, and professionalism.

eng_desc: Fundamental theory of Chinese Medicine: Yin-Yang theory, five phase theory, characteristic of Chinese Medicine knowledge, Internal organ manifestation includes the five zang-organs, the six fu-organs.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on the fundamental theory of Traditional Chinese Medicine, aligning with health and treatment.

eng_desc: Fundamentals of group counseling such as group processes, group dynamics, principles of group arrangement, leadership roles, changes in group members, and basic skills; practicum in group counseling.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on group counseling, group processes, and dynamics, aligning with health and welfare (social care).

eng_desc: Further study of approximately 200 Chinese Medicine terms.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on terminology specific to Traditional Chinese Medicine, indicating a health-related field.

eng_desc: General aspects of the immune system, including components and functions, cells and tissues of the immune system, mechanisms of the immune defense, principles of antigen-antibody interactions and their clinical applications. The roles and importance of immune system in infectious diseases, cancers, and graft rejection as well as fundamental mechanisms underlying immunologic diseases, including immunodeficiency, hypersensitivity, and autoimmunity.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on the immune system, its mechanisms, and its role in diseases, specifically for pharmacists.

eng_desc: General introduction of the source of formulas and a brief history of the development of their uses, formula categories, formula combinations, formula composition and modifications, commonly-used forms of administration, formula decoction methods, factors that influence the efficacy of formulas. Exterior-releasing formulas, purgative formulas, harmonizing and releasing formulas, heat-clearing formulas, summer-heat dispelling formulas, interior-warming formulas, exterior-interior-releasing formulas, tonifying and replenishing formulas.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on the composition, administration, and efficacy of Traditional Chinese Medicine formulas.

To study the factors related to health and to design exercise programmes for sports and exercise to improve performance and to evaluate physical performance for sports and exercise.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on sports, exercise, physical activities, and their benefits for health and physical performance, aligning with health.

eng_name: Social Work Mythology in Organization Administration and Social Welfare Policy
eng_desc: Theories, concepts, principles, and methods in the administration of social welfare and social workorganizations; management processes, strategic management, and a planning process; social and socialwelfare planning; policy formulation at the national and organizational levels; the relationship between socialpolicy and administration; policy analysis; stages in social work administration, monitoring and evaluation;case management; Project design and management development of policy networks and mechanisms; andmanagement of social welfare projects.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on social welfare, social work administration, and policy formulation, directly aligning with health and welfare.

eng_desc: Theories, concepts, principles, and the application of methods, processes, strategies, techniques, and skills invarious modalities of community social work practice; synergy action for communities’ and people’ sorganizations; community organization under the participatory paradigm and community culture; developmentof community and indigenous welfare systems to ensure community security; and social workers’ roles as co-creators of social change for social justice
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on community social work, welfare systems, and social change for justice, aligning with social care and welfare.

eng_name: Theory and Concept of Child, Youth, and Family
eng_desc: Theory and concept of child welfare; child protection and development; violence against children; form andprocess of child protection and development; application of laws in child welfare
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on child welfare, protection, development, and the application of laws in child welfare.

eng_desc: Theory of camera (both film and digital), technique of photographic production, including instrument and process of medical photographic production, related meaning of photograph with pathology of patients and medical procedures
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on photographic production techniques specifically for medical purposes, including patient pathology and procedures.

eng_desc: Theory, principles, and practices in joint examination, movement analysis, andevaluation; indications, contraindications, and precautions; manual therapy techniques,treatment planning, and specialized methods for mobilizing joint of extremities, spine, andnerves in musculoskeletal disorders.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers theory and practice of manual therapy techniques for musculoskeletal disorders, including joint examination and treatment.

eng_desc: This course consists learning about of concepts of health, concepts and principles of health promotion, health promotion theories, developmental psychology, Strategies of health promotion and communication for health behavior change, health education, immunization, nutrition and nutritional assessment, exercises and physical fitness, applying techniques and methods of health promotion for all age groups with normal health status and deviate from normal health status, according to the required learning scenarios.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on health promotion, prevention, education, immunization, nutrition, and physical fitness.

eng_name: Practicum in Nursing Research and Nursing Innovation Development
eng_desc: This course consists of conducting basic research projects or innovations related to health care and nursing care by using the research process, process of innovation development, evidence-based practice and information technology, and academic presentations.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on nursing research, innovation development, and evidence-based practice in healthcare.

eng_name: Laws and Ethics Related to Nursing 2
eng_desc: This course consists of learning about analysis of the legal and ethical issues related to the nursing and midwifery profession, including nursing care of maternal and newborn and midwifery, nursing care of children and adolescents, nursing care of adults and elders, nursing care of mental health and psychiatric nursing, and community health nursing. Application of ethical principles, decision-making based upon the ethics and professional code of ethics, with the concerning of the patient rights and cultural diversity.
derived_eng_desc1: Analyzes legal and ethical issues specifically related to the nursing and midwifery profession and patient care.

eng_desc: This course consists of learning about concept and basic skills for being innovator, design thinking, and process of innovation development. Concept of information technology, information and nursing information system, and informational searching for nursing. Nursing data classification systems. Selection of health information technology, digital technology, and evidence-based practice to design innovations related to healthcare. Concerning laws and ethical issues in the use of information technology, ethical innovation, and intellectual property rights.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on health innovation, nursing informatics, and applying digital technology to healthcare.

eng_desc: This course consists of learning about concept and theory related alternative medicine including Energy Therapies, Manipulative Therapies, Mind-Body-Spirit Intervention, and Natural Therapy. Alternative medical systems focusing on holistic alternative care for the clients at all health status.
derived_eng_desc1: Explores concepts and theories of alternative medicine and holistic alternative care for clients.

eng_name: Nursing Care of the Family and Midwifery 1
eng_desc: This course consists of learning about concepts and principles of family and midwifery, nursing care during premarital and marital life, family planning, the nurse's role in counseling, fertilization and fetal development, fetal health assessment, nursing care during the pregnancy, delivery and post-partum periods, both in normal and low risk clients, newborn nursing care, the promotion of breast feeding, family task and factors related to changes in the family, basic knowledge of childbirth, principles of normal delivery, drugs used in obstetrics. Application of the nursing process, evidence-based practice, and principles of holistic nursing care in required learning scenarios.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on nursing care for families, midwifery, pregnancy, delivery, and newborn care.

eng_desc: This course consists of learning about concepts and principles of nursing care for adult and the elderly clients with chronic and acute illnesses in internal medicine and surgery including clients who have problem with pain, infection, and disorder in hematology and immunity system, digestive system, various types of tumors, and female reproductive system. Application of the nursing process and evidence-based practice for health promotion, disease prevention, nursing therapeutics through holistic care, rational drugs use, rehabilitation, and prevention of complication and recurrence. Concerning of the individuality, promoting self-care and family participation in the care of the clients.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers nursing care for adults and elderly clients with chronic and acute illnesses, including rehabilitation.

eng_desc: This course consists of learning about concepts and principles of nursing care for adult and the elderly clients with chronic and acute illnesses up until crisis and emergency conditions in internal medicine and surgery as well as clients who have complex health problems with the ear, eye, nose, and throat, the musculoskeletal system, the kidneys, the urinary tract system, fluid-electrolyte, and acid-base imbalance, the vasculo-respiratory system, and the neurological system. Application of the nursing process and evidence-based practice for health promotion, disease prevention, nursing therapeutic through holistic care, rational drugs use, rehabilitation, and prevention of complications and recurrence. Concerning of the individuality, promoting self-care, and family participation in the care of the clients.
derived_eng_desc1: Continues nursing care for adults and elderly clients with complex chronic and acute illnesses.

eng_desc: This course consists of learning about concepts and principles of palliative care, palliative care system, guidelines for identification of patients requiring palliative care, and communication in palliative care. Comprehensive palliative assessment enables the evaluation of physical, psychosocial and spiritual needs. Symptoms in palliative care, pharmacologic and non-pharmacologic symptom management in palliative care, nearing death, and end-of-life care. Assessment and management of grief and bereavemen. Law and ethics related to palliative care. Application of the nursing process, principles of holistic nursing care, and evidence-based practice in palliative care in the required learning scenarios.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on palliative nursing, end-of-life care, symptom management, and holistic nursing principles.

eng_name: Nursing Care of Children and Adolescents
eng_desc: This course consists of learning about concepts and principles of pediatric and adolescent nursing, child development, family-centered care, rights and ethical issues in pediatric nursing care. Nursing care of children and adolescents with common health problems in the context of acute and chronic illness. Developing family empowerment to provide care for children. Application of the nursing process and evidence-based practice for health promotion, disease prevention, therapeutic nursing care, rehabilitation, rational drugs use, and prevention of complications and recurrence in the learning scenarios.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers pediatric and adolescent nursing, child development, health promotion, and therapeutic care.

eng_desc: This course consists of learning about concepts and principles of primary medical care and alternative medicine applications through primary medical care. Common illnesses in the primary care service system, differential diagnosis and definite diagnosis, treatment base upon the rational drug use and nursing therapeutics, nursing documentation, health education, and the process of client referral within the scope of legal system and nursing profession. Application of nursing process, evidence-based practice, holistic nursing care, and ethics in primary health care.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on primary medical care, diagnosis, treatment, nursing therapeutics, and health education.

eng_desc: This course consists of learning about concepts and principles of public health, the structure and system of the healthcare services in Thailand. Most significant common public health problems, concept of the community, community health care, communicating with the community, community health process, and strategy for implementation of public healthcare and role of public health personnel, epidemiology, family health nursing, school health nursing, occupational health nursing. Building community capacity and community empowerment. Concepts and principles of disaster management. Laws and ethical issues in community health nursing. Application of the nursing process, evidence-based practice, and principles of holistic nursing care for health promotion and dealing with public health problems in the community in the required learning scenarios.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers public health, community health nursing, epidemiology, and disaster management in healthcare.

eng_desc: This course consists of learning about concepts and theories of geriatric, health policies for the elderly, health assessment, common health problem and needs of the elderly, rational use of drugs and health products in the elderly, promoting independent living, health promotion, rehabilitation and nursing care for the elderly patients. Promoting family participation in the care of the elderly by concerning aspects of related ethic. Learners are able to apply knowledge to design projects or innovations for the elderly.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on gerontological nursing, health policies, assessment, promotion, and rehabilitation for the elderly.

eng_desc: This course consists of learning about concepts of nursing practice and principles of nursing practice in responding to basic needs of an individual, hygiene care and physical comfort, safety, principles of infection control and prevention, vital signs assessment and first aid, positioning and transferring patients, nutrition and hydration care, assisting patients in urinary and bowel elimination, wound care, and administration of medications. Learners are able to practice basic nursing practice in laboratories, concerning of ethics, the patient rights, individualism, and cultural diversity.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers fundamental nursing practices, patient care, infection control, and medication administration.

eng_name: Nursing Care of the Family and Midwifery 2
eng_desc: This course consists of learning about concepts, theories and principles of midwifery, maternal and newborn nursing care for women in high-risk group or obstetric emergencies during antepartum, intrapartum, and post-partum period, nursing care for women with co-morbid disorder, pregnancy complications, antepartum hemorrhage, infectious diseases in pregnancy, abnormality - related delivery factors, Care for mothers and newborn babies who receive obstetric procedures, infertility, and fetal health assessment by using technologies. Application of the nursing process, evidence-based practice in the required learning scenarios.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on advanced maternal and newborn nursing care, high-risk pregnancies, and obstetric emergencies.

eng_desc: This course consists of learning about concepts, theories, and principles of mental health and psychiatric nursing, Therapeutic tools for mental health and psychiatric nursing, assessment and screening for mental health and psychiatric problems, nursing care for individuals with psychosocial problems and substance use disorders, tobacco control, mental illness, therapeutic care and rehabilitation for individual with mental illness and their families, rational drugs use, psychiatric crisis and emergencies, legal and ethical issues in mental health and psychiatric nursing.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers mental health and psychiatric nursing, including assessment, care, and rehabilitation for mental illness.

eng_desc: This course consists of learning about digital understanding, choosing digital technology, access to digital technology for health, security and awareness of digital media use, digital law, and digital technology application in health.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on digital health literacy, applying digital technology for health, and related digital law.

eng_desc: This course consists of learning about general laws and acts related to health professionals. Acts and laws related to the Professional Nursing and Midwifery Act, ethics, professional ethics, and the rights of service recipients. Legal and ethical issues related to nursing and cultural beliefs.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers general laws, acts, and ethical issues specifically related to the nursing profession.

eng_desc: This course consists of learning about health problems and risk behaviors of adolescent in the new era, drug addiction and tobacco control, sexual health and diversity, health promotion and self-care, the development of life skills.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on adolescent health problems, risk behaviors, health promotion, and self-care.

eng_desc: This course consists of learning about nursing research, research process, literature review, the research design, research instruments and validity of instruments, data collection, data analysis, discussion, research ethics, and research utilization and evidence-based practice in nursing. Development of the clinical nursing practice guideline.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers nursing research, research process, design, data analysis, and evidence-based practice in nursing.

eng_desc: This course consists of learning about of mechanisms of physiologic response and the body's adaptation to imbalance. Pathophysiological changes in cell function, body fluids, the immune system, the nervous system, muscles and bones, the cardiovascular system, the respiratory system, the digestive system, endocrine and metabolism, the urinary system, and the reproductive system.
derived_eng_desc1: Explores fundamental pathophysiology, physiological responses, and changes in body systems relevant to nursing.

eng_desc: This course consists of learning about principles and concepts of the nursing process, functional health patterns, assessment, history-taking and professional communication with clients, physical examination, nursing diagnosis, planning, implementation, evaluation, and nursing documentation. Learners are able to apply the nursing process in each required learning scenarios.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on the principles and concepts of the nursing process, including assessment, diagnosis, planning, and evaluation.

eng_desc: This course consists of learning about principles and theory of nursing management, nursing leadership, ward management, conflict management and negotiation, policy regarding the healthcare system, and the national health insurance system, concepts and principles of the health economics, quality assurance of nursing service, contemporary nursing and issue and trends of the nursing profession.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers nursing management, leadership, healthcare system policies, and quality assurance in nursing services.

eng_name: Professional Nursing Development and Nursing Science
eng_desc: This course consists of learning about the development of nursing profession and the characteristics and importance of the nursing profession. The process of preparing for the profession, and the factors that influence the development of the nursing professio. The nursing profession in the health service system, and nursing organizations and health organizations. Career advancement within the professional nursing organization. The concept of holistic nursing care in different cultures, humanized care, and fundamentals of nursing theory and related theories, including the person, the environment, health, and nursing. Nursing theories and theories related to nursing.
derived_eng_desc1: Explores the development of the nursing profession, nursing science, and fundamental nursing theories.

eng_desc: This course consists of nursing practice as a leader and member of the nursing team. Application of knowledge of nursing management, and nursing and midwifery sciences. Providing holistic care continuously with a multidisciplinary team, with the concerning safety, the rational drug use, the human rights and individualism according to professional code of ethics and related laws. Creating a project and planning to improve the quality of nursing service by using evidence-based practice and information technology.
derived_eng_desc1: Practical application of nursing management, leadership, and quality improvement in nursing services.

eng_name: Practicum in Nursing Care of Adults and the Elderly 2
eng_desc: This course consists of nursing practice for acute and chronically-ill adult and elderly clients in the area of internal medicine and surgery including clients who have problems with the eyes, ears, nose, and throat, the musculoskeletal system, the kidneys, the urinary tract system, the vasculo-respiratory system, and the neurological system. Application of principles of holistic nursing care, the nursing process and evidence-based practice for formulating nursing care plan, therapeutic nursing interventions, rehabilitation, and prevention of complications. Concerning of the human rights, the individualism, and cultural diversity according to the professional code of ethics and related laws.
derived_eng_desc1: Practical nursing care for acute and chronically-ill adults and elderly, focusing on holistic care and rehabilitation.

eng_name: Practicum in Nursing Care of Adults and the Elderly 1
eng_desc: This course consists of nursing practice for acute and chronically-ill adult and elderly clients through the application of concepts and principles of holistic nursing care. It covers all aspects of nursing care in the area of internal medicine and surgery including clients who have problems with pain, malfunctions of the digestive systems, endocrine system, blood stream abnormality and immunodeficiency, the infection of female reproductive system and various types of tumor. Application of the nursing process and evidence-based practice for nursing care plan, therapeutic nursing care, rational drugs use, rehabilitation, and prevention of complications and recurrence. Concerning of the human rights, the individualism, and cultural diversity according to professional code of ethics and related laws.
derived_eng_desc1: Practical nursing care for acute and chronically-ill adults and elderly, covering various internal medicine and surgical issues.

eng_name: Practicum in Nursing Care of Children and Adolescents
eng_desc: This course consists of nursing practice for children and adolescents for acute and chronically-ill clients through application of concepts and principles of holistic nursing care, family-centered care, nursing process, and evidence-based practice for health promotion, disease prevention, immunization, therapeutic care, rehabilitation, and prevention of complications and recurrence, performing therapeutic nursing procedures, as well as considering the rational drug use in pediatric patient. Concerning of the rights, the individualism, and cultural diversity. Working as a member of the nursing team according to the professional code of ethics and related laws.
derived_eng_desc1: Practical nursing care for acute and chronically-ill children and adolescents, focusing on holistic and family-centered care.

eng_name: Practicum in Health Promotion and Health Prevention
eng_desc: This course consists of nursing practice for health promotion for clients in all age groups with normal health status and minor health deviation. Applying concepts and principles of health promotion, health promotion theories, developmental psychology, Strategies of health promotion and communication for health behavior change, health education, immunization, nutrition and nutritional assessment, exercises and physical fitness, through a holistic approach to the provision of care to clients. Consideration of ethics and professional code of ethics, the human rights, individualism, and cultural diversity.
derived_eng_desc1: Practical nursing in health promotion and prevention for all age groups, including education and nutrition.

eng_desc: This course consists of nursing practice in community, family health, and school health through the application of the community health, nursing process, and principles of public healthcare, community health assessment, diagnosing community health problems, and needs, planning, implementing, and evaluating in solving the health problems of community, families, and school. Working with interdisciplinary teams and related agency, promoting community participation, resources utilization, integration of local wisdom, lifestyle and community culture, with concerning ethical issues and related laws.
derived_eng_desc1: Practical nursing in community, family, and school health, focusing on public healthcare and assessment.

eng_name: Practicum in Nursing Care of Critical and Emergency
eng_desc: This course consists of nursing practice in providing holistic care for clients in all age groups during critical stages and emergency situations. Application of the nursing process, related medical technology according to the nurse's role, rational drug used, and provide palliative care for patients in the critical ill. Concerning of the rights, the individuality, and cultural diversity, within the professional code of ethics and related laws.
derived_eng_desc1: Practical nursing care for critical and emergency situations, applying medical technology and palliative care.

eng_desc: This course consists of nursing practice in the roles of professional nurses under the supervision of registered nurse professional. Performing duties as registered nurses, leader of the nursing team, in-charge nurse in the clinical settings depending on the area of interest. This course will be graded S (satisfactory) and U (unsatisfactory).
derived_eng_desc1: Practical nursing experience for professional nurses, performing duties in clinical settings.

eng_name: Practicum in Mental Health and Psychiatric Nursing
eng_desc: This course consists of nursing practice regarding mental health and psychiatric nursing for individuals of all ages, both in clinical and community settings through holistic nursing care. Fundamentals of nursing processes will be applied through a wide range of nursing procedures, including nurse-patient relationships, therapeutic communication, and interventions covering individual, group, and/or family levels, the rational drug use, leadership skills for delivering group therapy will be trained, as well as practical strategies for health promotion, prevention, and rehabilitation in mental health and psychiatric fields. In addition, concerning on ethical and legal related issues will be addressed in all nursing procedures to demonstrate clients' confidentiality, anonymity and individuality.
derived_eng_desc1: Practical nursing in mental health and psychiatric care, including therapeutic communication and rehabilitation.

eng_name: Practicum in Nursing Care of the Family and Midwifery 1
eng_desc: This course consists of nursing practice regarding midwifery, maternal and newborn both care for normal and low- risk clients during antepartum, intrapartum, and postpartum periods, antenatal care, fetal health assessment, family planning, normal delivery, newborn care, the promotion of breastfeeding, rational drug used in obstetrics, discharge planning, performing therapeutic procedures in nursing, promoting self-care and family participation. Use of holistic nursing care through the application of the nursing process and evidence-based practice for health promotion, disease prevention, therapeutic care, rehabilitation, and prevention of complications and recurrence, performing therapeutic nursing procedures. Concerning the rights, the individualism, cultural diversity, according to the professional code of ethics and related laws.
derived_eng_desc1: Practical nursing in family and midwifery, covering maternal and newborn care, and health promotion.

eng_name: Practicum in Nursing Care of the Family and Midwifery 2
eng_desc: This course consists of nursing practice regarding midwifery, maternal and newborn care of the women in the high-risk group, pregnancy complications, and obstetric emergencies during antepartum, intrapartum, and post-partum period, nursing care for women with diseases associated pregnancy, antepartum hemorrhage, infectious diseases in pregnancy, abnormality - related delivery factors, nursing care for pregnant women receiving obstetrics procedures, including newborn with complication, using technologies for fetal health assessment, nursing role in taking care of the infertile couple, reasonable drug used. Application of the nursing process, and evidence-based practice, including performing therapeutic nursing procedures, discharge planning, and referral for continuing care. Concerning the principles of holistic nursing care, cultural diversity, the human rights and individualism within the professional code of ethics and related laws.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on nursing practice, midwifery, maternal, and newborn care, aligning with health and welfare.

eng_desc: This course consists of practice for primary medical care by history taking, physical examinations and interpretation of physical examination, interpretation of preliminary laboratory results, differential diagnosis, definite diagnosis, treatment, and the rational drugs use, nursing documentation, health education, and referral patient for continuing care. Concerning the rights, and individualism, performing the role of member of the team within the professional code of ethics and laws related to primary medical care.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers primary medical care, including diagnosis, treatment, and health education, fitting health and welfare.

eng_desc: This course consists of practicing fundamental of nursing procedures and nursing care in providing care for clients with mild to moderate illnesses. Applying the concepts and principles of basic needs of individuals, responding to hygiene care and physical comfort, safety, infection control and prevention, and environmental care, vital signs assessment and first aid, positioning and transferring patients, nutrition and hydration care, assisting patients in urinary and bowel elimination, wound care, and administration of medications by using the nursing process and holistic care. Concerning the patient rights, individualism, cultural diversity, ethics and professional code of ethics.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on fundamental nursing procedures and care for illnesses, aligning with health and welfare.

eng_desc: This course covers the basic principles of structure, function, and organization of the human nervous system. The central nervous system, cerebral spinal fluid and meninges, histology of neurons, neural development, degeneration, and regeneration, basic principles of neurophysiology such as membrane potential and action potential as well as synaptic transmission. Structure and function of sensory systems and motor systems, their pathways and the consequence of pathology are included. The long-term objective is to provide the student of optometry, as a professional health care provider, with the capability to recognize neurological issues in his patients based on an understanding of the relationship of the visual system to the rest of the nervous system.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers neuroscience for optometry, focusing on the nervous system and its relation to health care.

eng_desc: This course covers the principle and concept of workplace health promotion, methodology and models or workplace health promotion, procedure of workplace health promotion programs and plans development, as well as monitoring and evaluation of the programs and plans, integration of workplace health promotion and occupational health and safety programs for worker's total health development.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on workplace health promotion and occupational health and safety for worker wellbeing.

eng_desc: This course examines the rich history and development of traditional Thai medicine, its theoretical concepts, and the various types of treatment using herbs, massage, herbal sauna, and other curative applications. Students also learn how traditional Thai medicine and health care has been integrated into the country's health care system. The course provides the basic knowledge of human anatomy and physiology required for Thai massage, its history, benefits, limitations, steps and postures as well as the place of Thai massage in contemporary culture. Practical demonstrations are included.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers traditional Thai medicine, massage, herbs, and their integration into healthcare.

eng_desc: This course focuses on basic principles of medical virology, mycology and parasitology. These include classification, structure, replication, and mechanisms of pathogenesis of these infectious agents. The course emphasises on common infectious diseases caused by viruses, fungi, protozoa and parasites in the following aspects: clinical features; laboratory diagnosis; epidemiology; pathogenesis; and treatment and prevention. Pharmacology of antiviral, anti-fungal, and anti-parasitic agents is also included in this course.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on medical virology, mycology, parasitology, infectious diseases, diagnosis, treatment, prevention, and pharmacology.

eng_desc: This course includes structure, morphology, and functions of immune system including both in normal condition and in response to infections and inflammation; basic concepts in the immune response (hormonal immune response and cellular immune response); immune responses to infectious agents; concepts of transplantation, concepts of vaccination; concepts of laboratory investigations for immunological diseases. Another part of this course also includes basic principles of medical bacteriology: bacterial classification; bacterial morphology and cellular structure; cell wall synthesis; bacterial metabolism and growth; bacterial genetics; mechanisms of bacterial pathogenesis; pathology of bacterial infections. It also emphasises on the common infectious diseases caused by bacteria in the following aspects: clinical features; laboratory diagnosis; epidemiology; pathogenesis; and treatment and prevention. Pharmacology of antibacterial agents is also included in this course.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers immune system, microbes, medical bacteriology, infectious diseases, diagnosis, treatment, prevention, and pharmacology.

derived_eng_desc1: Covers immune system, infections, medical bacteriology, infectious diseases, diagnosis, treatment, prevention, and pharmacology.

Another part of this course also includes basic principles of medical bacteriology, virology and mycology especially in morphology, risk of infection, pathogenesis and pathology of infections. It also emphasizes on the common infectious diseases caused by microbes in the following aspects: clinical features; laboratory diagnosis, pathophysiology, pharmacology and application for disease management using traditional Chinese Medicine.
derived_eng_desc1: Covers immune system, infections, immunology, medical microbiology, infectious diseases, diagnosis, pharmacology, and disease management.

eng_desc: This course is integrated into the curriculum throughout the second year of study Deep listening; art and self-awareness; communication with empathy; conflict resolutions with understanding; values of give and take; and life reflection. Evaluation will be satisfied (S) and unsatisfied (U)
derived_eng_desc1: Explores humanistic aspects of medicine, focusing on empathy, communication, and self-awareness in practice.

eng_desc: This course is integrated into the curriculum throughout the third year of study Doctor-patient relationship, communication, interviewing patient and family, health promotion, basic medical ethics, principle of analysis and decision making in medical ethics, practice to help people and society. Evaluation will be satisfied (S) and unsatisfied (U)
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on doctor-patient relationships, communication, health promotion, and medical ethics.

eng_name: GREATS Educational Experience for Medical Students 4
eng_desc: This course runs currently with and fully integrated into each system. derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on sustainable tourism concepts, policy, planning, and management, clearly a service field.

derived_eng_desc1: Covers management of food and beverage operations, including concept development, menu design, service styles, and business sustainability.

eng_desc: The course emphasizes on the interconnection and dependency between urban and rural areas in the aspect of natural resources utilization, environmental problems and the change of natural resources in urban and rural areas, the role of administrative organizations in local, provincial, sub-regional, regional, and national level on environmental and natural resources management planning under the concept of sustainable development and other challenges the world is facing.
derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on urban and rural environmental management, natural resources utilization, and sustainable development planning by administrative organizations.

eng_desc: The elements of international trade and commercial shipping, the structures and characteristics of the shipping industry, organizational structures of a transport company, role of the intermediate persons or freight forwarders in the shipping business, the role of government as a policy maker, principles and practices of transport companies, contract, the multimodal transport concept, ports, marine insurance, logistics, transport document, equipment and cargo-handling system.
derived_eng_desc1: Introduces international transport, commercial shipping, logistics, and cargo-handling systems.

derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on group activities, recreational activities, and camp management, aligning with practical services.

derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on digital tourism, smart cities, and managing travel services, aligning with the services sector.

derived_eng_desc1: Focuses on leadership in sports and recreation activities, aligning with practical services for individuals and society.
